q.rw: Ikinyabiziga cyose cyangwa ibinyabiziga bigenda bigomba kugira:
q.en: Every moving vehicle or combination of vehicles must have:

options.rw: A na B ni ibisubizo by’ukuri

options.en: None of the answers is correct

explain.rw: Itegeko riteganya ko ikinyabiziga cyose cyangwa ibinyabiziga bikururana bigenda bigomba kugira umuyobozi. Umuherekeza ntategekwa kuri buri kinyabiziga; asabwa gusa mu bihe byihariye, ni yo mpamvu “A na B” atari cyo gisubizo.
explain.en: The law requires every moving vehicle or combination of vehicles to have a driver. An attendant is not required for every vehicle, only in particular cases, so 'A and B' is wrong.

q.rw: Ijambo “akayira” bivuga inzira nyabagendwa ifunganye yagenewe gusa:
q.en: The term “path” (akayira) means a narrow public road intended only for:

options.rw: A na B ni ibisubizo by’ukuri

options.en: None of the answers is correct

explain.rw: Akayira ni inzira nyabagendwa ifunganye yagenewe gusa abanyamaguru n’ibinyabiziga bigendera ku biziga bibiri. Ni yo mpamvu A na B byombi ari ukuri.
explain.en: A path (akayira) is a narrow public road reserved for pedestrians and two-wheeled vehicles only, so both A and B belong to the definition.

q.rw: Umurongo uciyemo uduce umenyesha ahegereye umurongo ushobora kuzuzwa n’uturanga gukata tw’ibara ryera utwo turanga cyerekezo tumenyesha:
q.en: A broken line announcing the approach of a continuous line may be supplemented by white deflection arrows. These arrows announce:

options.en: The approach of a continuous line

options.rw: Igabanurwa ry’umubare w’ibisate by’umuhanda mu cyerekezo bajyamo
options.en: A reduction in the number of lanes in the direction of travel

explain.rw: Uturanga cyerekezo tw’ibara ryera dushyirwa ku murongo ucagaguye umenyesha ahegereye umurongo udacagaguye tumenyesha abayobozi ko umubare w’ibisate by’umuhanda ugiye kugabanuka mu cyerekezo bajyamo, bityo bakitegura kujya mu gisate gisigaye hakiri kare. Kumenyesha ahegereye umurongo udacagaguye bikorwa n’umurongo ucagaguye ubwawo, si utwo turanga cyerekezo.
explain.en: White deflection arrows added to a broken line before a continuous line warn drivers that the number of lanes in their direction is about to be reduced, so they must move into the remaining lane in good time. Announcing the continuous line is the job of the broken line itself, not of the arrows.

q.rw: Ahantu ho kugendera mu muhanda herekanwa n’ibimenyetso bimurika ibinyabiziga ntibishobora kuhagenda:
q.en: In traffic lanes indicated by light signals, vehicles may NOT travel:

options.en: None of the answers is correct

explain.rw: Iyo ibisate by’umuhanda byerekanwa n’ibimenyetso bimurika, ibinyabiziga bishobora kugenda biteganye (buri kimwe mu gisate cyacyo) kandi bishobora no kugenda ku murongo umwe mu gisate kimwe. Nta na kimwe muri ibyo kibujijwe, ni yo mpamvu nta gisubizo cy’ukuri kirimo.
explain.en: Where lanes are indicated by light signals, vehicles may travel side by side (each in its own lane) and may also travel in single file within a lane. Neither is forbidden, so none of the answers is correct.

q.rw: Ibinyabiziga bikurikira bigomba gukorerwa isuzumwa buri mwaka:
q.en: Which of the following vehicles must undergo a technical inspection every year?

options.rw: Ibinyabiziga bigenewe gutwara abagenzi muri rusange
Ibinyabiziga bigenewe gutwara ibintu birengeje toni 3.5

options.en: None of the answers is correct

explain.rw: Ibinyabiziga bitwara abagenzi muri rusange, ibitwara ibintu birengeje toni 3.5 n’ibigenewe kwigisha gutwara bikorerwa isuzumwa rimwe mu mezi 6, si rimwe mu mwaka. Ni yo mpamvu nta gisubizo cy’ukuri kirimo.
explain.en: Public passenger vehicles, goods vehicles over 3.5 tonnes and driving-school vehicles must be inspected once every 6 months, not once a year. So none of the answers is correct.

q.rw: Ubugari bwa romoruki ikuruwe n’ikinyamitende itatu ntibugomba kurenza ibipimo bikurikira:
q.en: The width of a trailer drawn by a three-wheeled cycle must not exceed:

options.en: None of the answers is correct

explain.rw: Nta na kimwe mu bipimo byatanzwe (cm 75, cm 125 cyangwa cm 265) ari cyo itegeko rishyiraho ku bugari bwa romoruki ikuruwe n’ikinyamitende itatu, ni yo mpamvu nta gisubizo cy’ukuri kirimo. Ntukabyitiranye n’amategeko yihariye agenga romoruki zikuruwe n’igare, velomoteri cyangwa ipikipiki ifite akanyabiziga ku ruhande.
explain.en: None of the figures given (75 cm, 125 cm or 265 cm) is the limit the regulation sets for a trailer drawn by a three-wheeled cycle, so none of the answers is correct. Do not confuse it with the separate rules for trailers drawn by a bicycle, a moped or a motorcycle with a sidecar.

q.rw: Uburebure bw’ibinyabiziga bikurikira ntibugomba kurenga metero 11:
q.en: The length of which of the following vehicles must not exceed 11 metres?

options.rw: Ibifite imitambiko ibiri ikurikiranye mu bugari bwayo
options.en: Vehicles with two axles one behind the other
None of the answers is correct

explain.rw: Metero 11 si cyo gipimo ntarengwa itegeko rishyiraho ku burebure bw’ubwoko bw’ibinyabiziga buvuzwe aha, ni yo mpamvu nta gisubizo cy’ukuri kirimo. Makuzungu, nk’urugero, yemerewe uburebure buruta ubw’ikinyabiziga kimwe.
explain.en: 11 metres is not the maximum length the regulation sets for any of these types of vehicle, so none of the answers is correct. An articulated vehicle, for example, is allowed to be longer than a single rigid vehicle.

q.rw: Ikinyabiziga kibujijwe guhagarara akanya kanini aha hakurikira:
q.en: Parking a vehicle is prohibited in which of the following places?

options.rw: Ahatarengeje metero 1 imbere cyangwa inyuma y’ikinyabiziga gihagaze akanya gato cyangwa kanini
options.en: Less than 1 metre in front of or behind a vehicle that is stopped or parked
Where there are signs specifically prohibiting it

options.rw: Aho abanyamaguru banyura mu muhanda ngo bakikire inkomyi
options.en: Where pedestrians have to walk on the carriageway to get round an obstacle
All of the answers are correct

explain.rw: Guhagarara akanya kanini birabujijwe ahantu hose havuzwe: hafi cyane y’ikindi kinyabiziga gihagaze (ahatarengeje metero 1) kuko byakibuza kuva aho gihagaze, ahari ibimenyetso bibibuza, n’aho abanyamaguru bahatirwa kunyura mu muhanda kugira ngo bakikire inkomyi.
explain.en: Parking is prohibited in all three places: within 1 metre of another stopped or parked vehicle (it would be blocked in), where signs prohibit it, and where pedestrians would be forced onto the carriageway to get round the obstacle.

q.rw: Kunyuranaho bikorerwa:
q.en: Overtaking is done:

options.en: On the right when passing an animal
None of the answers is correct

explain.rw: Ubusanzwe kunyuranaho bikorerwa ibumoso, ariko si igihe cyose: umuyobozi agomba kunyura iburyo ku kinyabiziga cyerekanye ko kigiye gukatira ibumoso kandi cyegereye ibumoso. Ni yo mpamvu “igihe cyose ni ibumoso” atari ukuri, kandi nta tegeko risaba kunyura iburyo ku nyamaswa.
explain.en: Overtaking is normally done on the left, but not always: a vehicle whose driver has signalled a left turn and moved over to the left must be overtaken on the right. So 'always on the left' is wrong, and no rule requires passing animals on the right.

q.rw: Icyapa cyerekana umuvuduko ntarengwa ikinyabiziga kitagomba kurenza gishyirwa gusa ku binyabiziga bifite uburemere ntarengwa bukurikira:
q.en: The plate showing the maximum speed a vehicle must not exceed is fitted only on vehicles whose maximum authorised weight is:

options.en: None of the answers is correct

explain.rw: Icyapa kigaragaza umuvuduko ntarengwa w’ikinyabiziga gishyirwa ku binyabiziga biremereye, ariko urugero rw’uburemere itegeko riteganya si toni 1, toni 2 cyangwa toni 24. Ni yo mpamvu nta gisubizo cy’ukuri kirimo.
explain.en: The maximum-speed plate is required on heavy vehicles, but the weight threshold set by the regulation is not 1, 2 or 24 tonnes. So none of the answers is correct.

q.rw: Ahatari mu nsisiro umuvuduko ntarengwa mu isaha wa velomoteri ni:
q.en: Outside built-up areas, the maximum speed of a moped is:

options.en: None of the answers is correct

explain.rw: Ahatari mu nsisiro velomoteri ntigomba kurenza km 50 mu isaha. Velomoteri ni ikinyabiziga gito kidafite ingufu nyinshi, ni yo mpamvu umuvuduko wayo ntarengwa uri hasi y’uw’imodoka.
explain.en: Outside built-up areas a moped must not exceed 50 km/h. A moped is a low-powered vehicle, so its limit is lower than that of cars.

q.rw: Umuyobozi ugenda mu muhanda igihe ubugari bwawo budatuma anyuranaho nta nkomyi ashobora kunyura mu kayira k’abanyamaguru ariko amaze kureba ibi bikurikira:
q.en: When the width of the road does not allow a driver to overtake without obstruction, he may use the pedestrian path, but only after checking which of the following?

options.en: None of the answers is correct

explain.rw: Igisubizo cyemewe ni uko nta gisubizo cy’ukuri kirimo. Akayira k’abanyamaguru kagenewe abanyamaguru: ukanyuramo agomba kubaha inzira no kwirinda kubashyira mu kaga, uko umuvuduko wabo, umubare wabo cyangwa ubugari bw’umuhanda byaba bimeze kose. Niba udashobora kunyuraho utabangamiye abanyamaguru, tegereza inyuma.
explain.en: The official answer is that none of the answers is correct. A pedestrian path belongs to pedestrians: a driver who uses it must give way to them and must not put them at risk, whatever their speed or number and whatever the width of the road. If you cannot get past without endangering pedestrians, wait behind.

q.rw: Ku byerekeye kwerekana ibinyabiziga n’ukumurika kwabyo ndetse no kwerekana ihindura ry’ibyerekezo byabyo. Birabujijwe gukora andi matara cyangwa utugarurarumuri uretse ibitegetswe ariko ntibireba amatara akurikira:
q.en: Regarding the signalling and lighting of vehicles and the indication of changes of direction: it is forbidden to fit lamps or reflectors other than those prescribed, but this does not apply to the following lamps:

options.en: All of the answers are correct

explain.rw: Ibinyabiziga ntibyemerewe kugira amatara cyangwa utugarurarumuri bitateganywa n’itegeko, kugira ngo bitayobya abandi bagenzi. Amatara ari imbere mu modoka ntamurikira umuhanda, ni yo mpamvu atabujijwe. Amatara ndanga n’amatara ndangaburambarare ni amwe mu matara ateganywa n’itegeko, si yo avugwa hano.
explain.en: Vehicles may not carry lamps or reflectors other than those prescribed, so that other road users are not misled. Interior lamps do not shine onto the road, so the ban does not apply to them. Position lamps and side-marker lamps are themselves prescribed lamps, not exceptions to the ban.

q.rw: Iyo nta mategeko awugabanya by’umwihariko umuvuduko ntarengwa w’amapikipiki mu isaha ni:
q.en: Unless specially reduced by other rules, the maximum speed of motorcycles is:

options.en: None of the answers is correct

explain.rw: Iyo nta mategeko awugabanya by’umwihariko, umuvuduko ntarengwa w’amapikipiki si km 25, km 70 cyangwa km 40 mu isaha, ni yo mpamvu nta gisubizo cy’ukuri kirimo. Ntukawitiranye n’umuvuduko ntarengwa wa velomoteri cyangwa w’imodoka zitwara abagenzi mu buryo bwa rusange.
explain.en: When no special rule reduces it, the maximum speed of motorcycles is not 25, 70 or 40 km/h, so none of the answers is correct. Do not confuse it with the limits for mopeds or for public passenger vehicles.

q.rw: Uburyo bukoreshwa kugirango ikinyabiziga kigende gahoro igihe feri idakora neza babwita:
q.en: The device used to slow a vehicle down when the brakes are not working properly is called:

options.en: None of the answers is correct

explain.rw: Feri yo gutabara ikoreshwa kugira ngo ikinyabiziga kigende gahoro cyangwa gihagarare igihe feri y’urugendo idakora neza. Feri y’urugendo ni yo ikoreshwa buri gihe mu rugendo, naho feri yo guhagarara umwanya munini ifata ikinyabiziga gihagaze.
explain.en: The emergency brake is used to slow down or stop the vehicle when the service brake is not working properly. The service brake is the one used in normal driving, and the parking brake holds the vehicle when it is parked.

q.rw: Nibura ikinyabiziga gitegetswe kugira uduhanagurakirahure tungahe:
q.en: What is the minimum number of windscreen wipers a vehicle must have?

options.en: None of the answers is correct

explain.rw: Ikinyabiziga gitegetswe kugira nibura agahanagurakirahure kamwe, kugira ngo umuyobozi abone neza imbere ye igihe imvura igwa. Kugira tubiri cyangwa dutatu biremewe, ariko icyo itegeko risaba nibura ni kamwe.
explain.en: A vehicle must have at least one windscreen wiper so the driver can see ahead clearly in the rain. Having two or three is allowed, but the minimum required is one.

q.rw: Amatara maremare y’ikinyabiziga agomba kuzimwa mu bihe bikurikira:
q.en: A vehicle's main-beam headlights must be switched off:

options.rw: Iyo umuhanda umurikiye umuyobozi abasha kureba muri metero 20
options.en: When the road is lit so that the driver can see for 20 metres
When the vehicle is about to pass oncoming vehicles
When it is in a built-up area
All of the answers are correct

explain.rw: Amatara maremare agomba kuzimwa igihe ugiye kubisikana n’ibindi binyabiziga, ugacana amatara yo kubisikana kugira ngo udahuma amaso abayobozi muhura. Kuba uri mu nsisiro ubwabyo si cyo gituma uyazimya, kandi kubona muri metero 20 gusa ntibihagije ngo umuyobozi azimye amatara maremare.
explain.en: Main-beam headlights must be switched off when you are about to pass oncoming vehicles, switching to dipped headlights so as not to dazzle their drivers. Being in a built-up area is not by itself the rule, and being able to see only 20 metres is not enough visibility to justify turning main beams off.

q.rw: Ikinyabiziga ntigishobora kugira amatara arenga abiri y’ubwoko bumwe keretse ku byerekeye amatara akurikira:
q.en: A vehicle may not have more than two lamps of the same type, except for the following lamps:

options.en: All of the answers are correct

explain.rw: Amatara ndangamubyimba, amatara yerekana icyerekezo n’amatara ndangaburambarare ashobora kurenga abiri, kuko agomba kugaragaza ikinyabiziga n’icyerekezo cyacyo uhereye imbere, inyuma no ku mpande. Ni yo mpamvu ibisubizo byose ari ukuri.
explain.en: Width lamps, direction indicators and side-marker lamps may number more than two because they must show the vehicle and its intended direction from the front, rear and sides. So all of the answers are correct.

q.rw: Ubugari bwa romoruki ikuruwe n’igare cyangwa velomoteri ntiburenza ibipimo bikurikira:
q.en: The width of a trailer drawn by a bicycle or a moped must not exceed:

options.en: None of the answers is correct

explain.rw: Nta na kimwe mu bipimo byatanzwe (cm 25, cm 125 cyangwa cm 45) ari cyo itegeko rishyiraho nk’ubugari ntarengwa bwa romoruki ikuruwe n’igare cyangwa velomoteri, ni yo mpamvu nta gisubizo cy’ukuri kirimo.
explain.en: None of the figures given (25, 125 or 45 cm) is the maximum width the regulation sets for a trailer drawn by a bicycle or moped, so none of the answers is correct.

q.rw: Ibinyabiziga bikoreshwa nka tagisi, bitegerereza abantu mu nzira nyabagendwa, bishobora gushyirwaho itara ryerekana ko ikinyabiziga kitakodeshejwe. Iryo tara rishyirwaho ku buryo bukurikira:
q.en: Vehicles used as taxis that wait for customers on the public road may be fitted with a lamp showing that the vehicle is not hired. How is this lamp fitted?

options.rw: Ni itara ry’icyatsi rishyirwa imbere ku kinyabiziga
options.en: It is a green lamp fitted at the front of the vehicle
It is a green lamp fitted on the left side
It is a yellow lamp fitted at the rear

options.rw: A na C ni ibisubizo by’ukuri

explain.rw: Itara ryerekana ko tagisi itakodeshejwe ni itara ry’icyatsi rishyirwa imbere ku kinyabiziga, kugira ngo abakiriya bari imbere yayo babone ko ibonetse. Ntirishyirwa ku ruhande rw’ibumoso, kandi si itara ry’umuhondo rishyirwa inyuma.
explain.en: The 'for hire' lamp of a taxi is green and fitted at the front of the vehicle, so customers ahead can see that the taxi is free. It is not placed on the left side, and it is not a yellow lamp at the rear.

q.rw: Za otobisi zagenewe gutwara abanyeshuri zishobora gushyirwaho amatara abiri asa n’icunga rihishije amyasa kugirango yerekane ko zihagaze no kwerekana ko bagomba kwitonda, ayo matara ashyirwaho ku buryo bukurikira:
q.en: Buses intended for carrying schoolchildren may be fitted with two flashing amber lamps to show that they have stopped and that others must take care. These lamps are fitted as follows:

options.en: One at the front and the other at the rear

options.rw: b na c ni ibisubizo by’ukuri

explain.rw: Ayo matara abiri asa n’icunga rihishije amyatsa ashyirwa rimwe imbere irindi inyuma, kugira ngo abayobozi baturutse imbere n’abaturutse inyuma bose bamenye ko otobisi y’abanyeshuri ihagaze, bityo bitondere abana bashobora kwambuka umuhanda.
explain.en: The two flashing amber lamps are fitted one at the front and one at the rear, so that drivers coming from both directions can see that the school bus has stopped and watch out for children who may cross the road.

q.rw: Itara ryo guhagarara ry’ibara ritukura rigomba kugaragara igihe ijuru rikeye nibura mu ntera ikurikira:
q.en: In clear weather, the red stop (brake) light must be visible from at least the following distance:

options.rw: Metero 100 ku manywa na metero 20 mu ijoro
options.en: 100 m by day and 20 m at night

options.rw: Metero 150 ku manywa na metero 50 mu ijoro
options.en: 150 m by day and 50 m at night

options.rw: Metero 200 ku manywa na metero 100 mu ijoro
options.en: 200 m by day and 100 m at night
None of the answers is correct

explain.rw: Nta na kimwe mu bipimo byatanzwe ari cyo itegeko riteganya ku itara ryo guhagarara, ni yo mpamvu nta gisubizo cy’ukuri kirimo. Itara ryo guhagarara rimenyesha abari inyuma ko ugiye guhagarara cyangwa kugabanya umuvuduko, bityo rigomba kugaragara neza ndetse no ku manywa.
explain.en: None of these pairs of distances is the one the regulation sets for the stop light, so none of the answers is correct. The stop light warns drivers behind that you are braking, so it must be clearly visible even in daylight.

q.rw: Iyo umuvuduko w’ibinyabiziga bidapakiye ushobora kurenga km50 mu isaha ahategamye, bigomba kuba bifite ibikoresho by’ihoni byumvikanira mu ntera:
q.en: When the unladen speed of vehicles on level ground can exceed 50 km/h, they must be fitted with a horn audible at a distance of:

explain.rw: Dukurikije igisubizo cyemewe, ibinyabiziga bidapakiye bishobora kurenza km 50 mu isaha ahategamye bigomba kugira ihoni ryumvikanira nibura muri metero 50. Ihoni rigomba kumvikana bihagije kugira ngo abandi bagenzi bamenye hakiri kare ko ikinyabiziga kiza.
explain.en: According to the official key, vehicles whose unladen speed on level ground can exceed 50 km/h must have a horn audible from at least 50 metres. The horn must be loud enough to warn other road users in time.

q.rw: Birabujijwe kugenza ibinyabiziga bigendeshwa na moteri na za romoruki zikururwa nabyo, iyo ibiziga byambaye inziga zidahagwa cyangwa inziga zikururuka zifite umubyimba uri hasi ya cm 4. Ariko ibyo ntibikurikizwa ku binyabiziga bikurikira:
q.en: It is forbidden to drive motor vehicles and the trailers they draw when their wheels are fitted with solid tyres or tracks less than 4 cm thick. However, this does not apply to the following vehicles:

options.rw: Ku binyabiziga by’ingabo bijya ahatarenga km25
options.en: Military vehicles travelling no more than 25 km
None of the answers is correct

explain.rw: Inziga zidahagwa cyangwa zikururuka zifite umubyimba uri hasi ya cm 4 zishobora kwangiza umuhanda, ni yo mpamvu zibujijwe. Dukurikije igisubizo cyemewe, nta na kimwe mu binyabiziga byavuzwe gisonewe kuri iryo bujijwe nk’uko byanditswe, bityo nta gisubizo cy’ukuri kirimo.
explain.en: Solid tyres or tracks thinner than 4 cm can damage the road surface, which is why they are prohibited. According to the official key, none of the listed vehicles is exempt from this ban as worded, so none of the answers is correct.

q.rw: Igice cy'inzira nyabagendwa kigarukira ku mirongo ibiri yera icagaguye ibangikanye kandi gifite ubugari budahagije kugira ngo imodoka zitambuke neza, kiba ari:
q.en: A part of the public road bounded by two parallel broken white lines and too narrow for cars to pass properly is:

options.en: A lane for bicycles and mopeds
None of the answers is correct

explain.rw: Igice cy’umuhanda kigarukira ku mirongo ibiri yera icagaguye ibangikanye kandi gifunganye ku buryo imodoka zitakinyuramo neza ni inzira yagenewe ibinyamitende. Igisubizo cyemewe gikoresha iryo jambo rusange “ibinyamitende” aho kuvuga amagare na velomoteri gusa, kandi ingorofani ntizigenewe icyo gice.
explain.en: A strip of road bounded by two parallel broken white lines and too narrow for cars is the lane reserved for cycles (ibinyamitende). The official answer uses this general term rather than naming only bicycles and mopeds, and handcarts are not meant to use this lane.

q.rw: Ubugari bwa romoruki ntiburenza ubugari bw’ikinyabiziga kiyikurura iyo ikuruwe n’ibinyabiziga bikurikira:
q.en: A trailer must not be wider than the vehicle towing it when it is drawn by:

options.rw: Ipikipiki ifite akanyabiziga kometse ku ruhande rwayo

options.en: None of the answers is correct

explain.rw: Iyo romoruki ikuruwe n’ipikipiki ifite akanyabiziga kometse ku ruhande rwayo, ubugari bwayo ntiburenza ubugari bw’icyo kinyabiziga kiyikurura. Romoruki zikuruwe n’igare cyangwa velomoteri zo zifite igipimo cyihariye cy’ubugari.
explain.en: When a trailer is drawn by a motorcycle with a sidecar, it must not be wider than that towing vehicle. Trailers drawn by a bicycle or moped have their own separate width limit.

q.rw: Iyo hatarimo indi myanya birabujijwe gutwara ku ntebe y’imbere y’imodoka abana badafite imyaka:
q.en: Unless no other seats are available, it is forbidden to carry children on the front seat of a car if they are under the age of:

options.en: None of the answers is correct

explain.rw: Abana batarageza ku myaka 12 ntibemerewe kwicazwa ku ntebe y’imbere y’imodoka, keretse iyo nta yindi myanya ihari. Intebe z’inyuma ni zo zitekanye ku mwana igihe habaye impanuka.
explain.en: Children under 12 must not be carried on the front seat of a car unless no other seat is available. The rear seats are safer for a child in a crash.

q.rw: Icyapa kivuga gutambuka mbere y’ibinyabiziga biturutse imbere gifite amabara akurikira:
q.en: The sign meaning 'priority over oncoming vehicles' has the following colours:

options.en: The symbol is red and black
The symbol is white and black
None of the answers is correct

explain.rw: Icyapa kivuga gutambuka mbere y’ibinyabiziga biturutse imbere ni icyapa cya mpande enye zingana gifite ubuso bw’ubururu, kiriho umwambi wera ugana imbere n’umwambi utukura ugana inyuma. Ubuso si umweru kandi nta mukara ubamo, ni yo mpamvu nta gisubizo cy’ukuri kirimo.
explain.en: The 'priority over oncoming vehicles' sign is square with a blue background, a white arrow pointing up (your direction) and a red arrow pointing down (oncoming traffic). The background is not white and there is no black, so none of the answers is correct.

q.rw: Ni ryari itegeko rigenga gutambuka mbere kw’iburyo rikurikizwa mu masangano:
q.en: When does the priority-to-the-right rule apply at an intersection?

options.rw: Iyo nta cyapa cyo gutambuka mbere gihari
options.en: When there is no priority sign

options.rw: Iyo ikimenyetso kimurika cyagenewe ibinyabiziga kidakora
options.en: When the traffic lights for vehicles are not working

options.rw: A na B ni ibisubizo by’ukuri

options.en: None of the answers is correct

explain.rw: Gutambuka mbere kw’iburyo ni ryo tegeko rusange mu masangano. Rikurikizwa iyo nta cyapa kigena gutambuka mbere gihari, ndetse n’igihe ibimenyetso bimurika bitagikora (keretse hari ibyapa bigena gutambuka mbere). Bityo A na B byombi ni ukuri.
explain.en: Priority to the right is the default rule at intersections. It applies when there is no priority sign, and also when the traffic lights are not working (unless priority signs are in place). So both A and B are correct.

q.rw: Ibimenyetso bimurika byerekana uburyo bwo kugendera mu muhanda kw'ibinyabiziga bishyirwa iburyo bw'umuhanda. Ariko bishobora no gushyirwa ibumoso cyangwa hejuru y’umuhanda:
q.en: Traffic lights controlling vehicles are placed on the right-hand side of the road, but they may also be placed on the left or above the road:

options.en: Depending on the direction in which the road users concerned are travelling

options.rw: Hakurikijwe icyo ibyo bimenyetso bigamije kwerekana
options.en: Depending on what the signals are meant to show
So that they are more clearly visible
All of the answers are correct

explain.rw: Ibimenyetso bimurika bishyirwa ubusanzwe iburyo bw’umuhanda; bishobora kongerwa ibumoso cyangwa hejuru y’umuhanda kugira ngo birusheho kugaragara neza, cyane cyane ku mihanda migari cyangwa ifite ibisate byinshi.
explain.en: Traffic lights are normally placed on the right of the road; they may also be placed on the left or above the road so that they are more clearly visible, especially on wide or multi-lane roads.

q.rw: Iyo itara ry’umuhondo rimyatsa rikoreshejwe mu masangano y’amayira ahwanyije agaciro rishyirwa ahagana he:
q.en: When a flashing amber light is used at an intersection of roads of equal importance, where is it placed?

options.en: In the middle of the intersection
On the right of the intersection

options.rw: a na b ni ibisubizo by’ukuri

explain.rw: Mu masangano y’amayira ahwanyije agaciro, itara ry’umuhondo rimyatsa rishobora gushyirwa kuri buri nzira igera mu masangano cyangwa hagati y’amasangano, kugira ngo abaturutse impande zose baribone. Iryo tara risaba abayobozi bose kwitonda no kubahiriza itegeko ryo gutambuka mbere kw’iburyo.
explain.en: At an intersection of roads of equal importance, the flashing amber light may be placed on each approach road or in the middle of the intersection, so that it can be seen from every direction. It tells all drivers to take care and apply the priority-to-the-right rule.

q.rw: Inkombe z’inzira nyabagendwa cyangwa z’umuhanda zishobora kugaragazwa n’ibikoresho ngarurarumuri. Ibyo bikoresho bigomba gushyirwaho ku buryo abagenzi babibona:
q.en: The edges of the public road or carriageway may be marked with reflective devices. These devices must be placed so that road users see:

options.rw: Babona gusa ibumoso bwabo iby’ibara ritukura
options.en: Only red ones, on their left

options.rw: Iburyo babona iby’ibara risa n’icunga rihishije gusa
options.en: Only amber ones, on their right
None of the answers is correct

explain.rw: Ibikoresho ngarurarumuri byo ku nkombe z’umuhanda bishyirwa ku buryo amabara yabyo afasha umuyobozi gutandukanya uruhande rw’iburyo n’urw’ibumoso bw’umuhanda. Nta na kimwe mu bisobanuro byatanzwe gihuye n’uko itegeko ribiteganya, ni yo mpamvu nta gisubizo cy’ukuri kirimo.
explain.en: Edge reflectors are arranged so that their colours help the driver tell the right-hand edge of the road from the left-hand edge. None of the descriptions given matches what the regulation lays down, so none of the answers is correct.

q.rw: Ibinyabiziga bikurikira bigomba gukorerwa isuzumwa rimwe mu mezi 6:
q.en: Which of the following vehicles must undergo a technical inspection once every 6 months?

options.rw: Ibinyabiziga bigenewe gutwara ibintu birengeje toni 3.5

options.en: All of the answers are correct

explain.rw: Ibinyabiziga bitwara abagenzi muri rusange, ibigenewe gutwara ibintu birengeje toni 3.5 n’ibigenewe kwigisha gutwara bikoreshwa cyane kandi bifite uruhare runini ku mutekano w’abantu benshi, ni yo mpamvu bigomba gusuzumwa kenshi: rimwe mu mezi 6. Ibisubizo byose ni ukuri.
explain.en: Public passenger vehicles, goods vehicles over 3.5 tonnes and driving-school vehicles are used intensively and affect the safety of many people, so they must be inspected more often: once every 6 months. All of the answers are correct.

q.rw: Iyo kuyobya umuhanda ari ngombwa bigaragazwa kuva aho uhera no ku burebure bwawo n’icyapa gifite ubuso bw’amabara akurikira:
q.en: When a diversion is necessary, it is indicated from its start and along its whole length by a sign with a background of the following colour:

options.en: None of the answers is correct

explain.rw: Iyo umuhanda uyobejwe, inzira abayobozi bagomba gukurikira yerekanwa kuva aho itangirira no ku burebure bwayo bwose n’icyapa gifite ubuso bw’ubururu. Umweru n’umutuku si amabara y’ubuso bw’icyo cyapa.
explain.en: When traffic has to be diverted, the diversion route is marked from its start and all along its length by a sign with a blue background. White and red are not the background colours of this sign.

q.rw: Ku mihanda ibyapa bikurikira bigomba kugaragazwa ku buryo bumwe:
q.en: On roads, which of the following signs must be displayed in the same way?

options.en: None of the answers is correct

explain.rw: Ibyapa bibuza n’ibitegeka ni ibyapa by’amabwiriza; byombi bifite ishusho y’uruziga kandi bigomba kugaragazwa ku buryo bumwe ku mihanda. Ibyapa biburira byo ni mpandeshatu, naho ibiyobora ni mpande enye, ni yo mpamvu bitagaragazwa nk’ibibuza n’ibitegeka.
explain.en: Prohibitory and mandatory signs are both regulatory signs: they are circular and must be displayed in the same way. Warning signs are triangular and direction signs are rectangular, so they are not displayed like prohibitory and mandatory signs.

q.rw: Ni iyihe feri ituma imodoka igenda buhoro kandi igahagarara ku buryo bwizewe bubangutse kandi nyabwo, uko imodoka yaba yikoreye kose yaba igeze ahacuramye cyangwa ahaterera:
q.en: Which brake makes the car slow down and stop safely, quickly and effectively, however it is loaded and whether it is going downhill or uphill?

options.en: None of the answers is correct

explain.rw: Feri y’urugendo ni yo feri nyamukuru ikoreshwa mu rugendo rwose; igomba gutuma ikinyabiziga kigenda buhoro kandi gihagarara vuba kandi neza uko cyaba gipakiye kose, cyaba kimanuka cyangwa kizamuka. Feri yo gutabara ikoreshwa gusa iyo feri y’urugendo yanze, naho feri yo guhagarara umwanya munini ifata ikinyabiziga gihagaze.
explain.en: The service brake is the main brake used throughout the journey; it must slow and stop the vehicle quickly and reliably whatever the load and whether going downhill or uphill. The emergency brake is only for when the service brake fails, and the parking brake holds the vehicle when parked.

q.rw: Ibizirikisho by’iminyururu cyangwa by’insinga kimwe n’ibindi by’ingoboka bikoreshwa gusa igihe nta kundi umuntu yabigenza kandi nta kindi bigiriwe uretse gusa kugirango ikinyabiziga kigere aho kigomba gukorerwa kandi nturenze na rimwe km 20 mu isaha, ibyo bizirikisho bigaragazwa ku buryo bukurikira:
q.en: Tow chains or cables and other makeshift links may be used only when there is no other way, solely to bring a vehicle to the place where it is to be repaired, and never at more than 20 km/h. These tow links must be made visible as follows:

options.en: A red cloth at 50 cm from the road surface

options.rw: Icyapa cyera cya mpande enye zingana gifite cm 20 kuri buri ruhande
options.en: A white square plate measuring 20 cm on each side
None of the answers is correct

explain.rw: Gukurura ikinyabiziga ukoresheje umunyururu cyangwa insinga byemewe gusa mu bihe by’ingoboka kandi ntihagomba kurenga km 20 mu isaha; ikizirikisho kigomba kugaragazwa kugira ngo abandi bagenzi bakibone. Dukurikije igisubizo cyemewe, nta na kimwe mu bisobanuro byatanzwe gihuye n’uko itegeko riteganya kukigaragaza.
explain.en: Towing with a chain or cable is allowed only as an emergency measure and never above 20 km/h, and the link must be made visible so that others can see it. According to the official key, none of the descriptions given matches the marking the regulation requires.

q.rw: Uretse mu mujyi, ku yindi mihanda yajyenwe na minisitiri ushinzwe gutwara abantu n’ibintu, uburemere ntarengwa ku binyabiziga bifite imitambiko itatu cyangwa irenga hatarimo makuzungu ni:
q.en: Except in town, on other roads designated by the minister in charge of transport, the maximum authorised weight for vehicles with three or more axles, excluding articulated vehicles, is:

explain.rw: Ku mihanda yagenwe na minisitiri ushinzwe gutwara abantu n’ibintu (uretse mu mujyi), ibinyabiziga bifite imitambiko itatu cyangwa irenga, hatarimo makuzungu, ntibigomba kurenza uburemere ntarengwa bwa toni 16. Uburemere ntarengwa bugenwa kugira ngo imihanda n’ibiraro bitangirika.
explain.en: On roads designated by the minister in charge of transport (outside towns), vehicles with three or more axles, other than articulated vehicles, must not exceed a maximum authorised weight of 16 tonnes. Weight limits protect roads and bridges from damage.

q.rw: Ubugari bw’imizigo yikorewe n’ibinyamitende itatu n’ubwiyikorewe n’ibinyamitende 4 bifite cyangwa bidafite moteri kimwe n’ubw’iyikorewe na romuruki zikuruwe n’ibyo binyabiziga ntibushobora kurenga ibipimo bikurikira:
q.en: The width of loads carried by three-wheeled and four-wheeled cycles, with or without a motor, and of loads carried by trailers drawn by these vehicles, must not exceed:

options.rw: cm 30 ku bugari bw’icyo kinyabiziga kidapakiye
options.en: 30 cm beyond the width of the unladen vehicle

options.rw: Ubugari ntarengwa budakuka ni metero 2 na sentimetero 50
options.en: An absolute maximum width of 2.50 m

options.rw: A na B ni ibisubizo by’ukuri

options.en: None of the answers is correct

explain.rw: Imizigo y’ibyo binyabiziga ntishobora kurenga ubugari bw’ikinyabiziga kidapakiye ho cm 30, kandi uko byagenda kose ubugari bwose ntibugomba kurenga metero 2 na cm 50. Ibyo bipimo byombi bigomba kubahirizwa icyarimwe, ni yo mpamvu A na B ari ukuri.
explain.en: The load on these vehicles may not extend more than 30 cm beyond the width of the unladen vehicle, and in any case the total width may never exceed 2.50 m. Both limits apply together, so A and B are correct.

q.rw: Kunyura ku binyabiziga bindi, uretse icy’ibiziga bibiri, bibujijwe aha hakurikira:
q.en: Overtaking vehicles other than two-wheelers is prohibited in which of the following places?

options.rw: Hafi y’iteme iyo hari umuhanda ufunganye
options.en: Near a bridge where the road is narrow
Near sections of road in poor condition
All of the answers are correct

explain.rw: Kunyura ku binyabiziga bitari iby’ibiziga bibiri birabujijwe aho umwanya cyangwa umutekano ari bike: hafi y’iteme aho umuhanda ufunganye, hafi y’aho abanyamaguru banyura, no hafi y’ibice by’umuhanda bimeze nabi. Ahantu hose nk’aho kunyuranaho byateza impanuka, ni yo mpamvu ibisubizo byose ari ukuri.
explain.en: Overtaking vehicles other than two-wheelers is prohibited where space or safety is limited: near a bridge where the road is narrow, near pedestrian crossings and near sections of road in poor condition. In all these places overtaking could cause a crash, so all of the answers are correct.

q.rw: Iyo nta mategeko awugabanya by’umwihariko, umuvuduko ntarengwa ku modoka zitwara abagenzi mu buryo bwa rusange ni:
q.en: Unless specially reduced by other rules, the maximum speed for public passenger transport vehicles is:

explain.rw: Iyo nta mategeko awugabanya by’umwihariko, imodoka zitwara abagenzi mu buryo bwa rusange ntizigomba kurenza km 60 mu isaha. Umuvuduko wazo ntarengwa uri hasi y’uw’imodoka z’ifasi (km 75) kuko zitwara abantu benshi.
explain.en: When no special rule reduces it, public passenger vehicles must not exceed 60 km/h. Their limit is lower than that of private cars (75 km/h) because they carry many people.

q.rw: Iyo nta mategeko awugabanya by’umwihariko, umuvuduko ntarengwa ku modoka zikoreshwa nk’amavatiri y’ifasi cyangwa amatagisi zifite uburemere bwemewe butarenga kilogarama 3500 ni:
q.en: Unless specially reduced by other rules, the maximum speed for private cars or taxis with a maximum authorised weight not exceeding 3,500 kg is:

explain.rw: Iyo nta mategeko awugabanya by’umwihariko, imodoka z’ifasi n’amatagisi bifite uburemere bwemewe butarenga kg 3500 ntibigomba kurenza km 75 mu isaha. Km 60 mu isaha ni umuvuduko ntarengwa w’imodoka zitwara abagenzi mu buryo bwa rusange.
explain.en: When no special rule reduces it, private cars and taxis with a maximum authorised weight of up to 3,500 kg must not exceed 75 km/h. 60 km/h is the limit for public passenger vehicles.

q.rw: Ikinyabiziga kibujijwe guhagarara akanya kanini aha hakurikira:
q.en: Parking a vehicle is prohibited in which of the following places?

options.rw: Imbere y’ahantu hinjirwa hakasohokerwa n’abantu benshi
options.en: In front of entrances and exits used by large numbers of people

options.rw: Mu muhanda aho ugabanyijemo ibisate bigaragazwa n’imirongo idacagaguye
options.en: On a carriageway divided into lanes marked by continuous lines

options.rw: A na B ni ibisubizo by’ukuri

options.en: None of the answers is correct

explain.rw: Guhagarara akanya kanini birabujijwe imbere y’ahantu hinjirwa hakasohokerwa n’abantu benshi kuko byababuza kwinjira no gusohoka neza, ndetse no mu muhanda ugabanyijemo ibisate n’imirongo idacagaguye kuko ikinyabiziga gihagaze cyahatira abandi kurenga iyo mirongo. Ni yo mpamvu A na B ari ukuri.
explain.en: Parking is prohibited in front of entrances and exits used by many people, because it obstructs them, and on carriageways divided into lanes by continuous lines, because a parked vehicle would force others to cross those lines. So A and B are correct.

q.rw: Iyo bwije kugeza bukeye cyangwa bitewe n’uko ibihe bimeze nk’igihe cy’ibihu cyangwa cy’imvura bitagishoboka kubona neza muri m 200, udutsiko twose tw’abanyamaguru nk’imperekerane cyangwa udutsiko tw’abanyeshuri bari ku murongo bayobowe n’umwarimu, iyo bagenda mu muhanda ku isonga hakaba hari abantu barenze umwe bagomba kugaragazwa ku buryo bukurikira:
q.en: From nightfall to daybreak, or when weather such as fog or rain makes it impossible to see clearly for 200 m, all groups of pedestrians such as processions or columns of pupils led by a teacher, walking on the road with more than one person at the front, must be made visible as follows:

options.rw: Imbere ni itara ry’umuhondo ritwariwe ibumoso
options.en: At the front, a yellow lamp carried on the left

options.rw: Inyuma ni itara ryera ritwariwe ibumoso n’umuntu uri ku murongo w’inyuma hafi y’umurongo ugabanya umuhanda mo kabiri
options.en: At the rear, a white lamp carried on the left by a person in the back row nearest the centre line of the road

options.rw: A na B ni ibisubizo by’ukuri

options.en: None of the answers is correct

explain.rw: Inyuma y’agatsiko k’abanyamaguru hagomba kugaragazwa n’itara ritukura, si itara ryera, kuko itara ryera rigaragaza imbere. Dukurikije igisubizo cyemewe, n’igisubizo a ntikemewe uko cyanditswe, bityo nta gisubizo cy’ukuri kirimo.
explain.en: The rear of a group of pedestrians must be shown by a red light, not a white one, because white lights mark the front. According to the official key, option a is not accepted as worded either, so none of the answers is correct.

q.rw: Utuyira turi ku mpande z’umuhanda n’inkengero zigiye hejuru biharirwa abanyamaguru mu bihe bikurikira:
q.en: Paths along the sides of the road and raised verges are reserved for pedestrians:

options.rw: Iyo hari amategeko yihariye yerekanwa n’ibimenyetso
options.en: When special rules are indicated by signs
When they walk together and are led by a teacher

options.rw: Iyo hatari amategeko yihariye yerekanwa n’ibimenyetso
options.en: When there are no special rules indicated by signs
All of the answers are correct

explain.rw: Ubusanzwe utuyira two ku mpande z’umuhanda n’inkengero zigiye hejuru biharirwa abanyamaguru, keretse iyo hari amategeko yihariye yerekanwa n’ibimenyetso abigena ukundi (urugero, kwemerera amagare kuhanyura). Ntibisaba ko abanyamaguru bayobowe n’umwarimu.
explain.en: As a general rule, side paths and raised verges are reserved for pedestrians unless special rules shown by signs say otherwise (for example, allowing bicycles). It does not depend on pedestrians being led by a teacher.

q.rw: Imburira zimurika zemerewe gukoreshwa kugirango bamenyeshe umuyobozi ko bagiye kumunyuraho aha hakurikira:
q.en: Light warnings (flashing the headlights) may be used to tell a driver that you are about to overtake him in which of the following places?

options.en: None of the answers is correct

explain.rw: Imburira zimurika ntizigenewe gukoreshwa mu nsisiro gusa, kandi hafi y’inyamaswa zikurura cyangwa amatungo si ho zigenewe, kuko zishobora kuzikangaranya zigateza impanuka. Ni yo mpamvu nta gisubizo cy’ukuri kirimo.
explain.en: Light warnings are not restricted to built-up areas, and places near draught animals or livestock are not where they are meant to be used, since they can startle the animals and cause an accident. So none of the answers is correct.

q.rw: Uburemere ntarengwa bwemewe ntibushobora kurenga ½ cy’uburemere bw’ikinyabiziga gikurura nubw’umuyobozi kuri romoruki zikurikira:
q.en: For which of the following trailers may the maximum authorised weight not exceed half the weight of the towing vehicle plus its driver?

options.en: A trailer with a service brake
A trailer without a service brake
None of the answers is correct

explain.rw: Romoruki idafite feri y’urugendo ntishobora kwihagarika ubwayo; ikinyabiziga kiyikurura ni cyo kiyihagarika. Ni yo mpamvu uburemere bwayo ntarengwa butagomba kurenga kimwe cya kabiri cy’uburemere bw’ikinyabiziga gikurura n’ubw’umuyobozi.
explain.en: A trailer without a service brake cannot brake by itself; the towing vehicle has to stop it. That is why its maximum authorised weight must not exceed half the combined weight of the towing vehicle and its driver.

q.rw: Ibinyabiziga bifite ubugari bufite ibipimo bikurikira bigomba kugira amatara ndangaburumbarare:
q.en: Vehicles of the following width must be fitted with side-marker lamps:

explain.rw: Dukurikije igisubizo cyemewe, ibinyabiziga bifite ubugari bwa metero 2 na cm 10 bigomba kugira amatara ndangaburambarare kugira ngo ingano yabyo igaragare neza nijoro. Metero 2 na cm 50 ni ubugari ntarengwa bw’ibinyabiziga, si cyo gipimo gisaba ayo matara.
explain.en: According to the official key, vehicles 2.10 m wide must have side-marker lamps so that their size can be seen at night. 2.50 m is the maximum permitted vehicle width, not the threshold for these lamps.

q.rw: Nta tara na rimwe cyangwa akagarurarumuri bishobora kuba bifunze ku buryo igice cyabyo cyo hasi cyane kimurika kitaba kiri hasi y’ibipimo bikurikira kuva ku butaka igihe ikinyabiziga kidapakiye:
q.en: No lamp or reflector may be fitted so that the lowest point of its illuminating surface is lower than the following height above the ground when the vehicle is unladen:

explain.rw: Dukurikije igisubizo cyemewe, igice cyo hasi cyane kimurika cy’itara cyangwa cy’akagarurarumuri ntigishobora kuba munsi ya cm 40 uvuye ku butaka, ikinyabiziga kidapakiye. Amatara ari hasi cyane ntaboneka neza kandi atwikirwa vuba n’ibyondo n’umukungugu.
explain.en: According to the official key, the lowest point of the illuminating surface of a lamp or reflector must be at least 40 cm above the ground when the vehicle is unladen. Lamps mounted too low are hard to see and are quickly covered by mud and dust.

q.rw: Iyo ikinyabiziga gifite amatara abiri cyangwa menshi y’ubwoko bumwe ayo matara agomba kugira ibara rimwe n’ingufu zingana kandi akagomba gushyirwaho ku buryo buteganye uhereye ku murongo ugabanya ikinyabiziga mo kabiri mu burebure bwacyo. Ariko ibi ntibikurikizwa ku matara akurikira:
q.en: When a vehicle has two or more lamps of the same type, they must be of the same colour and intensity and be fitted symmetrically in relation to the vehicle's longitudinal centre line. However, this does not apply to the following lamps:

options.rw: Itara ribonesha icyapa kiranga numero y’ikinyabiziga inyuma
options.en: The lamp lighting the rear registration plate

explain.rw: Itara ribonesha icyapa kiranga numero y’ikinyabiziga inyuma rigamije kumurikira icyo cyapa gusa, ni yo mpamvu ridategekwa gushyirwa ku buryo buteganye ku mpande zombi z’umurongo ugabanya ikinyabiziga mo kabiri. Amatara ndangamubyimba n’amatara ndangaburambarare yo agomba kuba ateganye kugira ngo agaragaze neza ubugari n’uburebure bw’ikinyabiziga.
explain.en: The rear registration plate lamp only lights up the number plate, so it does not have to be fitted symmetrically about the vehicle's centre line. Width lamps and side-marker lamps must be symmetrical so that they correctly show the vehicle's width and length.

q.rw: Ahari hejuru cyane y’ubuso bumurika h’amatara ndangambere na ndanganyuma ntihashobora kuba aharenze ibipimo bikurikira hejuru y’ubutaka iyo ikinyabiziga kidapakiye:
q.en: The highest point of the illuminating surface of the front and rear position lamps must not be more than the following height above the ground when the vehicle is unladen:

explain.rw: Dukurikije igisubizo cyemewe, igice cyo hejuru cyane cy’ubuso bumurika bw’amatara ndangambere n’amatara ndanganyuma ntikigomba kurenga metero 1 na cm 90 uvuye ku butaka, ikinyabiziga kidapakiye. Amatara ari hejuru cyane ntaboneka neza ku bayobozi bari hafi.
explain.en: According to the official key, the highest point of the illuminating surface of the front and rear position lamps must not be more than 1.90 m above the ground when the vehicle is unladen. Lamps mounted too high are harder for nearby drivers to see.

q.rw: Ni ryari ikinyabiziga gishobora kugenda mu muhanda moteri itaka cyangwa vitesi idakora:
q.en: When may a vehicle move on the road with the engine switched off or out of gear (in neutral)?

options.en: When it is being towed by another vehicle
When it has a service brake
All of the answers are correct

explain.rw: Birabujijwe kugendesha ikinyabiziga moteri itaka cyangwa vitesi idakora, kuko umuyobozi atakaza ubushobozi bwo kugenzura neza umuvuduko. Byemewe gusa iyo ikinyabiziga gikuruwe n’ikindi kinyabiziga. Kumanuka ahamanuka vitesi idakora ni byo biteza akaga kurusha ibindi.
explain.en: Driving with the engine off or in neutral (coasting) is not allowed, because the driver loses engine braking and full control of speed. It is only permitted when the vehicle is being towed by another vehicle. Coasting downhill is exactly the dangerous case the rule is meant to prevent.

q.rw: Umurongo mugari wera udacagaguye ushobora gucibwa ku muhanda kugirango ugaragaze ibi bikurikira:
q.en: A wide continuous white line may be marked on the road to show the following:

options.en: The marked (notional) edges of the carriageway
None of the answers is correct

explain.rw: Umurongo mugari wera udacagaguye ucibwa ku ruhande rw’umuhanda ugaragaza inkombe mpimbano z’umuhanda, ni ukuvuga aho igice kigenewe ibinyabiziga bigenda kirangirira. Igice kiri hakurya yawo gishobora guhagararwamo, ariko umurongo ubwawo ugaragaza inkombe, si aho guhagarara cyangwa inzira y’amagare.
explain.en: A wide continuous white line along the side of the road marks the notional edge of the carriageway, i.e. where the part meant for moving traffic ends. The strip beyond it may be used for stopping, but the line itself marks the edge, not a parking place or a cycle lane.

q.rw: Buri modoka cyangwa buri romoruki ikuruwe n’iyo modoka bishobora kugira itara risa n’icyatsi kibisi bituma umuyobozi yerekana ko yabonye ikimenyetso cy’uwitegura kumunyuraho. Iryo tara rigomba gushyirwa aha hakurikira:
q.en: Every motor car, or every trailer towed by it, may be fitted with a green lamp with which the driver shows that he has seen the signal of someone preparing to overtake him. Where must this lamp be fitted?

options.en: Near the left corner of the vehicle
At the rear, near the right-hand edge of the vehicle
At the rear, close to the right-hand corner
None of the answers is correct

explain.rw: Iryo tara ry’icyatsi kibisi rigomba gushyirwa inyuma, hafi y’impera y’ibumoso bw’ikinyabiziga, kugira ngo umuyobozi witegura kunyuraho (unyura ibumoso) aribone. Igisubizo cya mbere ntikivuga ko riba inyuma, naho icya kabiri n’icya gatatu birishyira iburyo, bityo nta gisubizo cy’ukuri kirimo.
explain.en: The green lamp must be fitted at the rear, near the left-hand edge of the vehicle, so that the driver preparing to overtake (on the left) can see it. The first option does not say it is at the rear, and the second and third put it on the right, so none of the answers is correct.

q.rw: Ibinyabiziga bikurikira bigomba kugira icyerekana umuvuduko kiri aho umuyobozi areba neza kandi kigahora kitabwaho kugirango kigume gukora neza:
q.en: Which of the following vehicles must have a speedometer placed where the driver can see it clearly, and kept in good working order?

options.rw: ibinyabiziga bifite umuvuduko nibura wa km 60 mu isaha
options.en: Vehicles with a speed of at least 60 km/h

options.rw: ibinyabiziga bishobora kurenza km 40 mu isaha
ibinyabiziga bishobora kurenza km 30 mu isaha
ibinyabiziga bishobora kurenza km 25 mu isaha

explain.rw: Ikinyabiziga cyose gishobora kurenza umuvuduko wa km 40 mu isaha kigomba kugira icyerekana umuvuduko kiri aho umuyobozi akibona neza, kandi kigahora gikora neza. Ibi bifasha umuyobozi kumenya niba yubahiriza umuvuduko ntarengwa.
explain.en: Any vehicle that can exceed 40 km/h must have a speedometer within the driver's clear view, kept in good working order, so the driver can check that speed limits are respected. The 25 and 30 km/h figures are not the rule, and 'at least 60 km/h' is not the threshold either.

q.rw: Ubugari bw’imizigo yikorewe n’ipikipiki idafite akanyabiziga ko kuruhande kimwe n’ubwa romoruki ikuruwe na bene icyo kinyabiziga ntibushobora kurenza ibipimo bikurikira:
q.en: The width of the load carried by a motorcycle without a sidecar, and of a trailer towed by such a vehicle, may not exceed:

options.en: None of the answers is correct

explain.rw: Ku ipikipiki idafite akanyabiziga ko ku ruhande, ubugari bw’imizigo yikoreye cyangwa bwa romoruki ikurura ntibushobora kurenza m 1.25. Ntukabyitiranye na cm 30: icyo gipimo kireba ipikipiki ifite akanyabiziga ko ku ruhande, aho imizigo itagomba kurenza ubugari bwayo ho cm 30.
explain.en: For a motorcycle without a sidecar, the load (and any trailer it tows) may be at most 1.25 m wide. Do not confuse this with 30 cm, which is how far the load may extend beyond the width of a motorcycle with a sidecar.

q.rw: Ibinyabiziga bikurikira bigomba kugira itara ry’ubururu rimyatsa riboneka mu mpande zose:
q.en: Which of the following vehicles must have a flashing blue light visible from all directions?

options.rw: ibinyabiziga bifite ubugari burenga m 2 na cm 10

options.en: All of the answers are correct

explain.rw: Itara ry’ubururu rimyatsa riboneka mu mpande zose rigenewe ibinyabiziga ndakumirwa, ni ukuvuga ibinyabiziga bihabwa inzira mbere y’ibindi (nk’ibya polisi, iby’abazimya inkongi n’imbangukiragutabara). Ibinyabiziga bifite ubugari burenga m 2.10 byo bigomba kugira amatara ndangaburumbarare, si itara ry’ubururu, bityo ibisubizo byose si ukuri.
explain.en: The flashing blue light belongs to priority vehicles as a category (such as police, fire-service and ambulance vehicles), not just to police vehicles. Vehicles wider than 2.10 m need side-marker lamps, not a blue light, so 'all of the answers' is wrong.

q.rw: Ibinyabiziga bihinga n’ibindi bikoresho byihariye bikoreshwa n’ibigo bipatana imirimo, iyo bigenda mu nzira nyabagendwa igihe cya nijoro cyangwa bitewe n’uko ibihe bimeze bitagishoboka kubona neza muri m 200 bishobora kugaragazwa inyuma n’amatara 2 atukura, bipfa kuba bitarenza ibipimo bikurikira:
q.en: Agricultural vehicles and other special machinery used by contractors, when travelling on a public road at night or when, because of weather conditions, it is no longer possible to see clearly for 200 m, may be shown at the rear by 2 red lamps, provided they do not exceed the following limits:

options.rw: kutarenza umuvuduko wa km20 mu isaha
uburebure bwabyo habariwemo ibyo bitwaye bukaba butarengeje m6
options.en: A length, including what they carry, of 6 m

options.rw: A na B nibyo bisubizo by’ukuri

explain.rw: Ibinyabiziga bihinga n’ibikoresho byihariye by’ibigo bipatana imirimo byemerewe kugaragazwa inyuma n’amatara abiri atukura gusa iyo bitarenza umuvuduko wa km 20 mu isaha kandi uburebure bwabyo, habariwemo ibyo bitwaye, butarenga m 6. Ibyo bisabwa byombi bigomba kuzuzwa icyarimwe; m 8 si cyo gipimo cyemewe.
explain.en: These slow agricultural and contractors' machines may be marked at the rear with just two red lamps only if they do not exceed 20 km/h and their length, load included, is no more than 6 m. Both conditions apply together; 8 m is not the permitted length.

q.rw: Iyo romoruki iziritse ku kinyamitende, velomoteri n’amapikipiki bidafite akanyabiziga ko kuruhande uretse ikinyamitende na velomoteri bidafite umuyobozi, iyo uburumbarare bwayo cyangwa bw’ibyo yikoreye bituma itara ry’ikinyabiziga gikurura ritagaragara igihe bitagishoboka kubona neza muri m 200 bigomba kugaragazwa ku buryo bukurikira:
q.en: When a trailer is hitched to a cycle, a moped or a motorcycle without a sidecar (other than cycles and mopeds without a rider), and its width or the width of its load hides the light of the towing vehicle when it is no longer possible to see clearly for 200 m, it must be shown as follows:

options.rw: itara ryera cyangwa ry’umuhondo cyangwa risa n’icunga rihishije riri kuri rumoruki inyuma
options.en: A white, yellow or orange lamp on the rear of the trailer

options.rw: itara ry’icyatsi cyangwa ry’umuhondo cyangwa risa n’icunga rihishije riri kuri rumoruki inyuma
options.en: A green, yellow or orange lamp on the rear of the trailer

options.rw: A na B ni ibisubizo by’ukuri

options.en: None of the answers is correct

explain.rw: Iyo romoruki cyangwa ibyo yikoreye bihisha itara ry’ikinyabiziga kiyikurura, romoruki ubwayo igomba kugira itara inyuma ryera, iry’umuhondo cyangwa irisa n’icunga rihishije. Ibara ry’icyatsi kibisi ntiryemewe kuri iryo tara, bityo igisubizo cya kabiri n’icya gatatu si byo.
explain.en: When the trailer or its load hides the towing vehicle's lamp, the trailer itself must carry a lamp at the rear that is white, yellow or orange. Green is not one of the permitted colours, so the second and third options are wrong.

q.rw: Ku kinyabiziga cyangwa ibinyabiziga bikururana igice kirenga ku biziga ntikigomba kurenga ibipimo bikurikira:
q.en: On a vehicle or a combination of vehicles, the part projecting beyond the wheels (the overhang) must not exceed the following:

options.rw: A na B ni ibisubizo by’ukuri

options.en: None of the answers is correct

explain.rw: Igice cy’ikinyabiziga kirenga ku biziga inyuma ntigishobora kurenza m 3 na cm 50. Igipimo cya m 1 na cm 70 cy’imbere si cyo kiri mu itegeko, bityo “A na B” si igisubizo cy’ukuri.
explain.en: The rear overhang (the part of the vehicle projecting behind the wheels) must not exceed 3.50 m. The 1.70 m front figure is not the regulation value, so 'A and B' is wrong.

q.rw: Iyo amatara y’ikinyabiziga agomba gucanwa kandi igihe imizigo isumba impera y’ikinyabiziga ho metero irenga igice gihera cy’imizigo kigaragazwa ku buryo bukurikira:
q.en: When the vehicle's lights must be switched on and the load projects more than one metre beyond the end of the vehicle, the end of the load must be shown as follows:

options.rw: itara ritukura cyangwa akagarurarumuri ku mutuku ku manywa
options.en: A red lamp or a red reflector, by day

options.rw: agatambaro gatukura gafite nibura cm 50 z’uruhande mu ijoro
options.en: A red cloth at least 50 cm square, at night
A yellow lamp or a yellow reflector
None of the answers is correct

explain.rw: Iyo amatara agomba gucanwa, impera y’imizigo irenga ikinyabiziga igaragazwa n’itara ritukura cyangwa akagarurarumuri gatukura; agatambaro gatukura gakoreshwa ku manywa. Igisubizo cya mbere n’icya kabiri byahinduranyije amanywa n’ijoro, naho ibara ry’umuhondo si ryo, bityo nta gisubizo cy’ukuri kirimo.
explain.en: When lights must be on, the projecting end of the load is shown by a red lamp or a red reflector; the red cloth is the daytime marking. The first two options swap day and night, and yellow is the wrong colour, so none of the answers is correct.

q.rw: Iyo imizigo igizwe n’ibinyampeke, ikawa, ipamba idatonoye, ibishara, ibyatsi, ibishami cyangwa ubwatsi bw’amatungo bidahambiriye uretse amapaki afunze, ubugari bwayo bushobora kugera ku bipimo bikurikira:
q.en: When the load consists of grain, coffee, unginned cotton, straw, grass, branches or animal fodder that is not bound (other than closed packages), its width may reach:

options.en: None of the answers is correct

explain.rw: Imizigo nk’ibinyampeke, ikawa, ipamba idatonoye, ibyatsi cyangwa ubwatsi bw’amatungo bidahambiriye ishobora kugira ubugari bugera kuri m 2.75. Ubugari bwa m 3 bwemewe gusa iyo iyo mizigo ijyanwa ahatarenga km 25 uvuye aho yapakiriwe, hatari mu nsisiro.
explain.en: Loose bulky loads such as grain, coffee, unginned cotton, straw or fodder may be up to 2.75 m wide. The wider 3 m limit applies only when such loads are carried within 25 km of the loading point, outside built-up areas.

q.rw: Uretse mu mijyi kuyindi mihanda yagenywe na minisiteri ushinzwe gutwara ibintu n’abantu, uburemere ntarengwa bwemewe ku binyabiziga bifatanye bifite imitambiko itatu ni:
q.en: Except in towns, on other roads designated by the ministry in charge of transport, the maximum authorised weight for coupled vehicles with three axles is:

explain.rw: Ku mihanda yagenwe na minisiteri ishinzwe gutwara abantu n’ibintu, uretse mu mijyi, uburemere ntarengwa bwemewe ku binyabiziga bifatanye bifite imitambiko itatu ni toni 12. Ntukabyitiranye na toni 16 zivugwa ku binyabiziga bifite imitambiko itatu cyangwa irenga, hatarimo makuzungu.
explain.en: On these designated roads outside towns, coupled vehicles with three axles may weigh at most 12 tonnes. Don't confuse this with the 16-tonne figure given for vehicles with three or more axles (excluding articulated vehicles).

q.rw: Buri modoka cyangwa buri romoruki ikuruwe n’iyo modoka bishobora kugira itara rituma umuyobozi yerekana ko yabonye ikimenyetso cy’uwitegura kumunyuraho. Iryo tara rifite amabara akurikira:
q.en: Every motor car, or every trailer towed by it, may be fitted with a lamp with which the driver shows that he has seen the signal of someone preparing to overtake him. What colour is this lamp?

explain.rw: Itara umuyobozi akoresha yereka uwitegura kumunyuraho ko yabonye ikimenyetso cye rifite ibara ry’icyatsi kibisi, kandi rishyirwa inyuma hafi y’impera y’ibumoso bw’ikinyabiziga. Umweru, umuhondo n’umutuku bigenewe andi matara.
explain.en: The lamp that tells an overtaking driver his signal has been seen is green, and it is fitted at the rear near the left-hand edge of the vehicle. White, yellow and red are used for other lamps.

q.rw: Ikinyabiziga cyangwa ibinyabiziga bikururana bifite imitambiko ibiri ikurikiranye mu bugari bwayo ni ukuvuga imitambiko yihindukiza kucyo ifungiyeho, uburebure bwabyo ntibugomba kurenza ibipimo bikurikira:
q.en: A vehicle or combination of vehicles with two successive axles across its width, that is, axles that swivel about their mounting point, must not exceed the following length:

options.en: None of the answers is correct

explain.rw: Ikinyabiziga gifite imitambiko ibiri ikurikiranye yihindukiza ku cyo ifungiyeho ntigishobora kurenza uburebure bwa m 7. Ibipimo binini nka m 10 cyangwa m 11 ntibyemewe kuri ubu bwoko bw’ibinyabiziga.
explain.en: A vehicle with two successive swivelling axles may be at most 7 m long. Longer figures such as 10 m or 11 m are not allowed for this type of vehicle.

q.rw: Bumwe muri ubu bwoko bwa feri ituma imodoka iguma aho iri uko yaba yikoreye kose ku muzamuko cyangwa ku gacuri bya 16%, imyanya ya feri igomba gufata igakomeza kwegera kuburyo bw’ibyuma niyo umuyobozi yaba atarimo:
q.en: Which type of brake holds the vehicle stationary, however it is loaded, on an uphill or downhill gradient of 16%, with its braking parts applied and kept on by a mechanical device even when the driver is not in the vehicle?

options.en: None of the answers is correct

explain.rw: Feri yo guhagarara umwanya munini igomba gufata ikinyabiziga kikaguma aho kiri ku muzamuko cyangwa ku gacuri bya 16%, kandi igakomeza gufata ku buryo bw’ibyuma n’iyo umuyobozi atarimo. Feri y’urugendo yo ikoreshwa mu kugabanya umuvuduko no guhagarara ikinyabiziga kigenda.
explain.en: The parking brake must hold the vehicle on a 16% uphill or downhill slope, kept applied mechanically even when nobody is in the driver's seat. The service brake is the one used to slow down and stop while driving.

q.rw: Utugarurarumuri turi mu mbavu z’ikinyabiziga tugomba kugira ibara rikurikira:
q.en: What colour must the reflectors on the sides of a vehicle be?

options.en: None of the answers is correct

explain.rw: Utugarurarumuri two mu mbavu z’ikinyabiziga tugomba kuba umuhondo. Utw’imbere tuba umweru, naho utw’inyuma tuba umutuku, bityo umuyobozi abasha kumenya uruhande abona rw’ikinyabiziga nijoro.
explain.en: Side reflectors must be yellow (amber). Front reflectors are white and rear reflectors red, so at night other drivers can tell which side of the vehicle they are looking at.

q.rw: Romoruki zifite ubugari ntarengwa bwa cm 80 zishobora gushyirwaho akagarurarumuri kamwe gusa iyo zikuruwe n’ibinyabiziga bikurikira:
q.en: Trailers with a maximum width of 80 cm may be fitted with only one reflector when towed by the following vehicles:

options.en: None of the answers is correct

explain.rw: Romoruki ntoya ifite ubugari butarenga cm 80 ishobora gushyirwaho akagarurarumuri kamwe gusa iyo ikuruwe n’ipikipiki idafite akanyabiziga ku ruhande. Uwo mwihariko ntureba velomoteri cyangwa amavatiri y’ifasi: iyo romoruki ikuruwe na byo, ikurikiza amategeko asanzwe y’utugarurarumuri.
explain.en: A narrow trailer (no more than 80 cm wide) may have just one reflector when it is towed by a motorcycle without a sidecar. This exception does not cover mopeds or private cars: a trailer towed by them must meet the normal reflector requirements.

q.rw: Amatara maremare y’ibara ryera cyangwa ry’umuhondo agomba, nijoro igihe ijuru rikeye, kumurika mu muhanda mu ntera ya m 100 nibura imbere y’ikinyabiziga, ariko ku binyabiziga bifite moteri itarengeje za sentimetero kibe 125 iyo ntera igira ibipimo bikurikira:
q.en: White or yellow main-beam headlights must, at night in clear weather, light the road for at least 100 m ahead of the vehicle; but for vehicles whose engine does not exceed 125 cc, that distance is:

options.en: None of the answers is correct

explain.rw: Ku binyabiziga bifite moteri itarengeje sentimetero kibe 125, amatara maremare agomba kumurika nibura m 75 imbere yabyo, aho kuba m 100. Kubera ko m 75 itari mu bisubizo byatanzwe, nta gisubizo cy’ukuri kirimo.
explain.en: For vehicles with engines of up to 125 cc, main-beam headlights must light the road at least 75 m ahead instead of 100 m. Since 75 m is not among the options, none of the answers is correct.

q.rw: Iyo banyuze iruhande rw’inkomyi abanyamaguru bagomba gukikira banyuze mu muhanda, abayobozi bagomba gusiga umwanya ufite ubugari bwa m 1 nibura hagati yabo nayo. Iyo ibyo bidashobora kubahirizwa kandi umunyamaguru akaba anyura hafi yiyo nkomyi, umuyobozi agomba kuyikikira afite umuvuduko utarengeje ibipimo bikurikira:
q.en: When passing beside an obstacle that pedestrians have to walk around by going into the road, drivers must leave a gap at least 1 m wide between themselves and the pedestrians. If this cannot be done and a pedestrian is walking close to the obstacle, the driver must pass it at a speed not exceeding:

options.en: None of the answers is correct

explain.rw: Dukurikije igisubizo cyemewe, nta na kimwe muri ibi bipimo by’umuvuduko gihuye n’itegeko. Iyo udashobora gusiga nibura m 1 hagati yawe n’umunyamaguru ukikira inkomyi, genda buhoro cyane kandi witeguye guhagarara; bibaye ngombwa, reka umunyamaguru abanze atambuke.
explain.en: According to the official key, none of the listed speed figures is the rule. When you cannot leave 1 m between your vehicle and a pedestrian walking round an obstacle, drive very slowly and be ready to stop; if necessary, let the pedestrian get past first.

q.rw: Guhagarara akanya gato no guhagarara akanya kanini bibujijwe cyane cyane aha hakurikira:
q.en: Stopping and parking are prohibited in particular in the following place:

options.rw: mu ruhande ruteganye n’urwo ikindi kinyabiziga gihagazemo akanya gato cyangwa kanini
options.en: On the side of the road opposite the side where another vehicle is stopped or parked

options.rw: ku mihanda ibisikanirwamo, iyo ubugari bw’umwanya w’ibinyabiziga ugomba gutuma bibisikana butagifite m12
options.en: On two-way roads, where the width left for vehicles to pass each other is less than 12 m
All of the answers are correct

explain.rw: Guhagarara akanya gato cyangwa kanini mu ruhande ruteganye n’urwo ikindi kinyabiziga gihagazemo bibujijwe, kuko ibyo binyabiziga byombi bifunga umuhanda, ibindi bikabura aho binyura. Ku mihanda y’icyerekezo kimwe ntibibujijwe hose, kandi igipimo cya m 12 kivugwa mu gisubizo cya gatatu si cyo cyemewe.
explain.en: You must not stop or park directly opposite another stopped or parked vehicle, because the two together narrow the road and block other traffic. Stopping is not banned everywhere on one-way roads, and the 12 m figure in the third option is not the rule.

q.rw: Amatara ndangambere n’aya ndanganyuma y’imodoka zitarengeje m 6 z’uburebure na m 2 z’ubugari habariwemo imitwaro kdi nta kinyabiziga kindi kiziritseho ashobora gusimburwa n’amatara akurikira, iyo ibyo binyabiziga bihagaze umwanya muto cyangwa munini mu nsisiro bibangikanye ku ruhande rw’umuhanda:
q.en: The front and rear position lights of cars not exceeding 6 m in length and 2 m in width, load included, and with no other vehicle hitched to them, may be replaced by the following lights when these vehicles are stopped or parked in a built-up area parallel to the edge of the road:

options.en: None of the answers is correct

explain.rw: Imodoka itarengeje m 6 z’uburebure na m 2 z’ubugari, idakurura ikindi kinyabiziga, ihagaze mu nsisiro ibangikanye n’uruhande rw’umuhanda, ishobora gucana amatara yo guhagarara umwanya munini mu mwanya w’amatara ndangambere n’aya ndanganyuma. Amatara magufi yo agenewe kugenda, si ukugaragaza ikinyabiziga gihagaze.
explain.en: A small car (up to 6 m long and 2 m wide, not towing) stopped or parked in a built-up area parallel to the kerb may use its parking lights instead of its front and rear position lights. Dipped headlights are for driving, not for marking a parked vehicle.

q.rw: Iyo kuva bwije kugeza bukeye cyangwa bitewe nuko ibihe bimeze nk’igihe cy’igihu cyangwa cy’imvura bitagishoboka kubona neza muri m 200, imirongo y’ingabo z’igihugu zigendera kuri gahunda n’utundi dutsiko twose tw’abanyamaguru nk’imperekerane cyangwa udutsiko tw’abanyeshuri bari ku murongo bayobowe na mwarimu, iyo bagenda mu muhanda ku isonga hakaba hari abantu barenze umwe, bagaragzwa ku buryo bukurikira:
q.en: From dusk to dawn, or when weather such as fog or rain makes it impossible to see clearly for 200 m, how must columns of soldiers marching in formation and all other groups of pedestrians, such as processions or lines of pupils led by a teacher, be shown when they walk on the road with more than one person at the head?

options.rw: imbere ni itara ryera ritwariwe ku ruhande rw’ibumoso n’umuntu uri ku murongo w’imbere hafi y’umurongo ugabanya umuhanda mo kabiri
options.en: At the front, by a white light carried on the left-hand side by a person in the front row, close to the line dividing the road in two

options.rw: inyuma ni itara umuhondo ritwariwe ku ruhande rw’ibumoso n’umuntu uri ku murongo w’inyuma hafi y’umurongo ugabanya umuhanda mo kabiri
options.en: At the rear, by a yellow light carried on the left-hand side by a person in the back row, close to the line dividing the road in two

options.rw: A na B ni ibisubizo by’ukuri

options.en: None of the answers is correct

explain.rw: Imbere y’itsinda ry’abanyamaguru hagaragazwa n’itara ryera ritwariwe ibumoso n’umuntu uri ku murongo w’imbere, hafi y’umurongo ugabanya umuhanda mo kabiri, kugira ngo abayobozi b’ibinyabiziga bababone. Inyuma ho hakoreshwa itara ritukura, si iry’umuhondo, bityo igisubizo cya kabiri n’icya gatatu si byo.
explain.en: The front of the group is shown by a white light carried on the left by someone in the front row, nearest the centre line, so that drivers can see them. The rear must be shown by a red light, not a yellow one, so the second and third options are wrong.

q.rw: Imizigo yikorewe n’amagare, velomoteri, amapikipiki, ibinyamitende by’ibiziga bitatu nibyo ibiziga bine bifite cyangwa bidafite moteri inyuma ntishobora kurenza ibipimo bikurikira:
q.en: Loads carried by bicycles, mopeds, motorcycles, and three- or four-wheeled cycles, with or without an engine, may not project at the rear by more than:

explain.rw: Imizigo yikorewe n’amagare, velomoteri, amapikipiki n’ibinyamitende by’ibiziga bitatu cyangwa bine ntishobora kurenga inyuma yabyo ho cm 50. Imizigo irenze ibyo ibangamira uburinganire bw’ikinyabiziga kandi ishobora gukubita abandi bagenzi.
explain.en: Loads on bicycles, mopeds, motorcycles and three- or four-wheeled cycles may not stick out more than 50 cm behind the vehicle. A longer overhang upsets the vehicle's balance and can strike other road users.

q.rw: Itara ndanganyuma rigomba gushyirwa aha hakurikira:
q.en: Where must the rear position light be fitted?

options.en: Close to the left corner of the vehicle
Close to the right corner of the vehicle
At the rear, at the left end of the vehicle
None of the answers is correct

explain.rw: Itara ndanganyuma rigomba gushyirwa ahegereye inguni y’ibumoso y’ikinyabiziga, ari rwo ruhande rwegereye hagati y’umuhanda kuko bagendera iburyo, kugira ngo abandi bayobozi bamenye aho ikinyabiziga kigarukira. Igisubizo cyemewe ni icya mbere; icya gatatu cyanditse nabi mu nyandiko y’umwimerere.
explain.en: The rear position light must be fitted near the left corner of the vehicle – the side nearest the middle of the road, since traffic keeps to the right – so other drivers can judge where the vehicle ends. The official answer is the first option; the third option is garbled in the source.

q.rw: Nta tara na rimwe cyangwa utugarurarumuri bishobora kuba bifunze kuburyo igice cyabyo cyo hasi cyane kimurika kitaba kiri hasi ya cm 40 kuva ku butaka igihe ikinyabiziga kidapakiye ariko ibyo ntibikurikizwa ku matara akurikira:
q.en: No lamp or reflector may be fitted so that the lowest point of its illuminating surface is less than 40 cm above the ground when the vehicle is unladen; but this does not apply to the following lamps:

options.rw: A na B ni ibisubizo by’ukuri

options.en: None of the answers is correct

explain.rw: Amatara n’utugarurarumuri ntibishobora gushyirwa munsi ya cm 40 uvuye ku butaka, ariko amatara kamenabihu n’amatara yo gusubira inyuma ntarebwa n’iryo tegeko; amatara kamenabihu by’umwihariko akora neza iyo ari hasi, munsi y’igihu. Ni yo mpamvu A na B ari ibisubizo by’ukuri.
explain.en: Lamps and reflectors may not be mounted with their lowest lit point below 40 cm from the ground, but fog lamps and reversing lamps are exempt – fog lamps in particular work best mounted low, beneath the fog. So A and B are both correct.

q.rw: Iyo tumuritswe n’amatara y’urugendo y’ikinyabiziga utugarurarumuri tugomba n’ijoro, igihe ijuru rikeye kubonwa n’umuyobozi w’ikinyabiziga kiri mu ntera ikurikira:
q.en: When lit by a vehicle's main-beam headlights, reflectors must, at night in clear weather, be visible to the driver of that vehicle from the following distance:

options.en: None of the answers is correct

explain.rw: Utugarurarumuri tumuritswe n’amatara y’urugendo tugomba kubonwa nijoro, ijuru rikeye, n’umuyobozi uri mu ntera ya metero 150. Ibi bituma ikinyabiziga gihagaze kitamurika kibonwa hakiri kare.
explain.en: Reflectors lit by main-beam headlights must be visible at night in clear weather from 150 m, so that even an unlit vehicle is seen in good time.

q.rw: Ibinyabiziga bigendeshwa na moteri, hatarimo velomoteri n’ibinyabiziga bidapakiye umuvuduko wabyo udashobora kurenga km 50 mu isaha ahateganye bigomba kuba bifite ibikoresho by’ihoni byumvikanira mu ntera ikurikira:
q.en: Motor vehicles – other than mopeds and vehicles whose unladen speed cannot exceed 50 km/h on level ground – must be fitted with a horn that can be heard from the following distance:

explain.rw: Ibinyabiziga bigendeshwa na moteri bishobora kurenza km 50 mu isaha ahateganye, uretse velomoteri, bigomba kugira ihoni ryumvikanira mu ntera ya metero 100, kugira ngo abandi bagenzi baburirwe hakiri kare. Velomoteri zo zisabwa ihoni ryumvikanira muri m 20.
explain.en: Motor vehicles that can exceed 50 km/h on the level (mopeds excepted) must have a horn audible from 100 m, so other road users are warned in time. Mopeds only need a horn audible from 20 m.

q.rw: Ahatari mu nsisiro ibyapa biburira n’ibyapa byo gutambuka mbere bigomba gushyirwa mu ntera ikurikira y’ahantu habyerekana:
q.en: Outside built-up areas, warning signs and priority signs must be placed at the following distance before the place they indicate:

options.en: None of the answers is correct

explain.rw: Ahatari mu nsisiro ibinyabiziga bigenda vuba, bityo ibyapa biburira n’ibyapa byo gutambuka mbere bishyirwa muri metero 150 kugeza kuri 200 mbere y’ahantu byerekana, kugira ngo umuyobozi abone igihe cyo kugabanya umuvuduko. Mu nsisiro iyo ntera iba ngufi.
explain.en: Outside built-up areas traffic is faster, so warning and priority signs are placed 150 to 200 m before the place they refer to, giving drivers time to slow down. Inside built-up areas the distance is shorter.

q.rw: Inkombe z’inzira nyabagendwa cyangwa z’umuhanda zishobora kugaragazwa n’ibikoresho ngarurarumuri. Ibyo bikoresho bigomba gushyirwaho ku buryo abagenzi babibona ku buryo bukurikira:
q.en: The edges of a public road or carriageway may be marked with retroreflective devices. These devices must be placed so that road users see them as follows:

options.rw: babona iburyo bwabo iby’ibara ritukura cyangwa ibisa n’icunga rihishije
options.en: On their right they see red or orange ones
On their left they see white ones

options.rw: A na B ni ibisubizo by’ukuri

options.en: None of the answers is correct

explain.rw: Ibikoresho ngarurarumuri biri ku nkombe z’umuhanda bishyirwa ku buryo umuyobozi abona iburyo bwe iby’ibara ritukura cyangwa irisa n’icunga rihishije, naho ibumoso akabona iby’ibara ryera. Ibi bimufasha kumenya nijoro inkombe z’umuhanda arimo.
explain.en: Edge reflectors are arranged so that drivers see red or orange ones on their right and white ones on their left. This helps them tell at night where each edge of the road is.

q.rw: Ahatari mu nsisiro, umuyobozi wese ugenza ikinyabiziga kimwe cyangwa ibinyabiziga bikomatanye bifite uburemere ntarengwa bwemewe burenga ibiro 3500 cyangwa bifite uburebure bwite burenga metero 10 agomba, keretse iyo anyuze cyangwa agiye kunyura ku bindi binyabiziga, gusiga hagati y’ikinyabiziga cye n’iki muri imbere umwanya uhagije kugirango ibinyabiziga bimuhiseho bishobore kuhigobeka bidateje impanuka igihe bibaye ngombwa ariko ibyo ntibikurikizwa mu bihe bikurikira:
q.en: Outside built-up areas, every driver of a vehicle or combination of vehicles with a maximum authorised weight of more than 3,500 kg or a length of more than 10 m must – unless overtaking or about to overtake – leave enough space between his vehicle and the one in front so that vehicles overtaking him can pull back in safely when necessary. This does not apply in the following cases:

options.rw: mu gihe ibigendera mu muhanda ari byinshi kimwe no mu duce tw'inzira nyabagendwa aho kunyuranaho bibujijwe
options.en: In heavy traffic, and also on sections of public road where overtaking is prohibited

options.rw: igihe ibigendera mu muhanda ari byinshi
mu duce tw’inzira nyabagendwa aho kunyuranaho bibujijwe
options.en: On sections of public road where overtaking is prohibited
None of the answers is correct

explain.rw: Ibinyabiziga binini cyangwa birebire bigomba gusiga umwanya uhagije imbere yabyo kugira ngo ikibinyuraho kibone aho kigobeka. Iryo tegeko ntirikurikizwa igihe ibigendera mu muhanda ari byinshi, kimwe no mu duce aho kunyuranaho bibujijwe. Igisubizo cya mbere ni cyo cyonyine gikubiyemo ibyo bihe byombi.
explain.en: Heavy or long vehicles must leave a gap in front so that an overtaking vehicle can pull back in safely. The rule does not apply in heavy traffic, nor on sections where overtaking is prohibited. The first option is the only one that includes both exceptions.

q.rw: Ibiziga by’ibinyabiziga bigendeshwa na moteri n’ibya velomoteri kimwe n’ibya romoruki zabyo bigomba kuba byambaye inziga zihagwa zifite amano n’ubujyakuzimu butari munsi ya milimetero imwe ku migongo yabyo yose nubudodo bwabyo ntibugire ahantu na hamwe bugaragara kandi ntibugire aho byacitse bikomeye mu mpande zabyo ariko ibyo ntibikurikizwa ku binyabiziga bikurikira:
q.en: The wheels of motor vehicles and mopeds, and of their trailers, must have pneumatic tyres whose tread pattern is at least one millimetre deep across the whole tread, with no cords showing anywhere and no serious cuts in the sidewalls; but this does not apply to the following vehicles:

options.rw: ibinyabiziga bidapakiye kandi bitajya birenza umuvuduko wa km 25 mu isaha ahateganye
options.en: Vehicles that, unladen, never exceed 25 km/h on level ground

options.rw: ibinyabiziga bya police bijya ahatarenga km 25 uvuye aho biba
options.en: Police vehicles travelling no more than 25 km from their base

options.rw: A na B ni ibisubizo by’ukuri

options.en: None of the answers is correct

explain.rw: Inziga zigomba kugira amano afite ubujyakuzimu bwa nibura milimetero imwe, ubudodo butagaragara kandi nta mpande zacitse bikomeye, kuko inziga zishaje zitakaza gufata umuhanda. Ibinyabiziga bidapakiye bitajya birenza km 25 mu isaha ahateganye ni byo byonyine bitarebwa n’iryo tegeko; ibinyabiziga bya polisi byo bigomba kuryubahiriza.
explain.en: Tyres must have at least 1 mm of tread depth across the whole tread, no visible cords and no serious sidewall cuts, because worn tyres lose grip. Only vehicles that cannot exceed 25 km/h on the level when unladen are exempt; police vehicles are not.

q.rw: Amatara ndangacyerekezo agomba kuba agizwe n’ibintu bifashe ku rumuri rumyasa, biringaniye ku buryo bigira umubare utari igiharwe ku mpande z’imbere n’inyuma z’ikinyabiziga ayo matara aba afite amabara akurikira:
q.en: Direction indicators must consist of flashing lights arranged symmetrically, in even numbers, on the front and rear of the vehicle. What colours are these lights?

options.rw: amatara y’imbere aba yera cyangwa ari umuhondo
options.en: The front ones are white or yellow

options.rw: ayinyuma aba atukura cyangwa asa n’icunga rihishije
options.en: The rear ones are red or orange

options.rw: A na B ni ibisubizo by’ukuri

explain.rw: Amatara ndangacyerekezo y’imbere agomba kuba yera cyangwa umuhondo, naho ay’inyuma akaba atukura cyangwa asa n’icunga rihishije. Igisubizo cya nyuma kivuga ibara rimwe gusa ry’inyuma, bityo ntikivuga amabara yose yemewe.
explain.en: Front direction indicators may be white or yellow, and rear ones red or orange. The last option gives only one of the permitted rear colours, so it is incomplete.

q.rw: Amahoni y’ibinyabiziga bigendeshwa na moteri agomba kohereza ijwi ry’injyana imwe rikomeza kandi ridacengera amatwi ariko ibinyabiziga bikurikira bishobora kugira ihoni ridasanzwe ridahuye n’ibivuzwe haruguru:
