q.en: Horns of motor vehicles must give a continuous, single-tone sound that is not harsh; but the following vehicles may have a special horn that does not meet these requirements:

options.rw: A na B ni ibisubizo by’ukuri

explain.rw: Ihoni risanzwe rigomba kugira ijwi ry’injyana imwe rikomeza kandi ridacengera amatwi. Ibinyabiziga ndakumirwa n’ibinyabiziga bikora ku mihanda byo byemerewe kugira ihoni ridasanzwe kugira ngo abandi bagenzi babimenye vuba. Ubugari bw’ikinyabiziga bwonyine ntibuha uburenganzira bwo kugira ihoni ridasanzwe.
explain.en: Ordinary horns must give a continuous single tone that is not harsh. Priority vehicles and road-works vehicles may have a special horn so that other road users notice them quickly. Being wide does not, by itself, entitle a vehicle to a special horn.

q.rw: Icyapa kibuza kunyura kubindi binyabiziga byose uretse ibinyamitende ibiri n’amapikipiki adafite akanyabiziga ku ruhande gifite ibimenyetso by’amabara akurikira:
q.en: The sign that prohibits overtaking all vehicles other than two-wheeled cycles and motorcycles without a sidecar has symbols in which colours?

options.rw: A na B ni ibisubizo by’ukuri

explain.rw: Icyapa kibuza kunyuranaho ni uruziga rufite umuzenguruko utukura n’ubuso bwera, kiriho ishusho y’imodoka ebyiri: imwe itukura n’indi y’umukara. Ni yo mpamvu ibimenyetso byacyo ari umutuku n’umukara. Ubururu bukoreshwa ku byapa bitegeka, si ku byapa bibuza.
explain.en: The no-overtaking sign is a circle with a red border and white background showing two cars, one red and one black – so its symbols are red and black. Blue is used on mandatory signs, not on prohibitory signs.

q.rw: Icyapa kivuga ko hatanyurwa mu byerekezo byombi kirangwa n’ubuso bw’ibara rikurikira:
q.en: The sign meaning that vehicles may not pass in either direction (road closed to all vehicles) has a background of which colour?

explain.rw: Icyapa kibuza kunyura mu byerekezo byombi ni uruziga rufite umuzenguruko utukura n’ubuso bwera butagira ikindi kirango. Ntukacyitiranye n’icyapa kibuza kwinjira, gifite ubuso butukura n’umurongo wera hagati.
explain.en: The 'closed to all vehicles in both directions' sign is a circle with a red border and a plain white background. Don't confuse it with the 'no entry' sign, which has a red background with a white bar across it.

q.rw: Ibinyabiziga bikurikira bigomba kugira ibikoresho by’ihoni byumvikanira mu ntera ya m 20:
q.en: Which of the following vehicles must be fitted with a horn that can be heard from 20 m?

options.en: None of the answers is correct

explain.rw: Velomoteri zigomba kugira ihoni ryumvikanira mu ntera ya m 20. Amapikipiki n’ibindi binyabiziga bigendeshwa na moteri bishobora kurenza km 50 mu isaha bisabwa ihoni ryumvikanira muri m 100.
explain.en: Mopeds must have a horn audible from 20 m. Motorcycles and other motor vehicles that can exceed 50 km/h need a horn audible from 100 m.

q.rw: Imirongo y’ingabo z’igihugu zigendera kuri gahunda n’utundi dutsiko twose tw’abanyamaguru nk’imperekerane cyangwa udutsiko tw’abanyeshuri iyo bitagishoboka kubona neza muri m200, bagaragazwa ni itara ryera imbere naho inyuma ni itara ry’umutuku ariko iyo uburebure bwiyo mirongo cyangwa bw’utwo dutsiko burenga m6 impande zatwo cyangwa zayo zigaragazwa ku buryo bukurikira:
q.en: When it is no longer possible to see clearly for 200 m, columns of soldiers marching in formation and all other groups of pedestrians, such as processions or groups of pupils, are shown by a white light at the front and a red light at the rear; but when such a column or group is longer than 6 m, its sides must be shown as follows:

options.en: All of the answers are correct

explain.rw: Itsinda ry’abanyamaguru rirerire (rirenga m 6) rigomba kugaragazwa no ku mpande zaryo, kugira ngo abayobozi bamenye uburebure bwaryo. Izo mpande zishobora kugaragazwa n’itara rimwe cyangwa menshi yera, ay’umuhondo cyangwa asa n’icunga rihishije, bityo ibisubizo byose ni byo.
explain.en: A long group of pedestrians (over 6 m) must also be marked along its sides so drivers can see how long it is. The side lights may be white, yellow or orange, so all of the answers are correct.

q.rw: Amatara ndangambere na ndanganyuma y’imodoka zitarengeje m 6 z’uburebure na m 2 z’ubugari habariwemo imitwaro kandi nta kindi kinyabiziga kiziritseho ashobora gusimburwa n’amatara yo guhagarara umwanya munini iyo ibyo binyabiziga bihagaze umwanya muto cyangwa munini mu nsisiro bibangikanye ku ruhande rw’umuhanda. Ayo matara arangwa n’amabara akurikira:
q.en: The front and rear position lights of cars not exceeding 6 m in length and 2 m in width, load included, with no other vehicle hitched to them, may be replaced by parking lights when these vehicles are stopped or parked in a built-up area parallel to the edge of the road. What colours are these lights?

options.en: White or yellow at the front
Red or yellow at the rear

options.rw: A na B ni ibisubizo by’ukuri

options.en: None of the answers is correct

explain.rw: Amatara yo guhagarara umwanya munini agaragaza imodoka ihagaze: imbere aba yera cyangwa umuhondo, inyuma akaba atukura cyangwa umuhondo. Kubera ko A na B byombi ari ukuri, igisubizo ni “A na B ni ibisubizo by’ukuri”.
explain.en: Parking lights mark a parked car: white or yellow at the front, red or yellow at the rear. Since both A and B are true, the answer is 'A and B are correct'.

q.rw: Amatara ndangaburumbarare agomba kubonwa nijoro igihe ijuru rikeye n’umuyobozi w’ikinyabiziga kiri mu ntera ya :
q.en: Side-marker lamps must be visible at night in clear weather to the driver of a vehicle at a distance of:

explain.rw: Amatara ndangaburumbarare agaragaza ubugari bw’ikinyabiziga kinini, bityo agomba kubonwa nijoro, ijuru rikeye, n’umuyobozi uri nibura muri m 200. Ibi bifasha abandi bayobozi kumenya hakiri kare ubugari bw’icyo kinyabiziga.
explain.en: Side-marker lamps show other drivers the width of a large vehicle, so they must be visible at night in clear weather from at least 200 m. This lets other drivers judge its width in good time.

q.rw: Uretse ku byerekeye imihanda iromboreje y’ibisate byinshi n’imihanda yimodoka igice cy’umuhanda kiri hakurya y’umurongo mugari wera ucibwa ku muhanda ngo ugaragaze inkombe mpimbano zawo kigenewe ibi bikurikira:
q.en: Except on motorways and motor-vehicle-only roads, the part of the road beyond the wide white line marked to show the notional edge of the carriageway is intended for:

options.en: None of the answers is correct

explain.rw: Igice kiri hakurya y’umurongo mugari wera ugaragaza inkombe mpimbano z’umuhanda kigenewe guhagararwamo umwanya muto n’umunini, kugira ngo ibinyabiziga bihagaze bitabangamira ibigenda. Ibi ntibikurikizwa ku mihanda irombereje y’ibisate byinshi no ku mihanda y’imodoka.
explain.en: Except on motorways and motor-vehicle-only roads, the strip beyond the wide white edge line is meant for both stopping and parking, so stationary vehicles do not obstruct moving traffic.

q.rw: Ibimenyetso by’agateganyo bigizwe n’imitemeri y’ibara risa n’icunga rihishije bishobora gusimbura ibi bikurikira:
q.en: Temporary markings made of orange studs may replace the following:

options.en: Continuous and broken white longitudinal lines
Broken and continuous lines running side by side
None of the answers is correct

explain.rw: Ibimenyetso by’agateganyo bigizwe n’imitemeri y’ibara risa n’icunga rihishije bishobora gusimbura imirongo yera irombereje, yaba idacagaguye cyangwa icagaguye (urugero mu gihe cy’imirimo ku muhanda). Iyo bihari, umuyobozi agomba kubikurikiza aho gukurikiza imirongo yera isanzwe.
explain.en: Temporary orange studs (for example during roadworks) may replace both continuous and broken white longitudinal lines. Where they are present, drivers must follow them rather than the usual white lines.

q.rw: Iyo bitagishoboka kubona muri m 200 imodoka zikuruwe n’inyamaswa, ingorofani, inyamaswa zitwaye imizigo cyangwa zigenderwamo kimwe n’amatungo bigomba kurangwa na :
q.en: When it is no longer possible to see for 200 m, animal-drawn vehicles, handcarts, pack or riding animals and livestock must be shown by:

options.en: At the front, a white light

options.rw: imbere ni itara ry’umuhondo cyangwa risa n’icunga rihishije
options.en: At the front, a yellow or orange light
At the rear, one red light
All of the answers are correct

explain.rw: Iyo kubona muri m 200 bitagishoboka, imodoka zikururwa n’inyamaswa, ingorofani n’inyamaswa ziri mu muhanda bigomba kugaragazwa imbere n’itara ryera, iry’umuhondo cyangwa irisa n’icunga rihishije, naho inyuma bikagaragazwa n’itara rimwe ritukura. Ni yo mpamvu ibisubizo byose ari ukuri.
explain.en: When visibility is under 200 m, animal-drawn vehicles, handcarts and animals on the road must show a white, yellow or orange light at the front and one red light at the rear. So all of the answers are correct.

q.rw: Uretse igihe hari amategeko yihariye akurikizwa muri ako karere ikinyabiziga cyose gihagaze umwanya muto cyangwa munini, iyo gihagaze mu mwanya wo kuruhande wagenewe abanyamaguru, kugirango bashobore kugenda batagombye kunyura mu muhanda, umuyobozi agombye kubasigira akayira gafite byibura ibipimo bikurikira by’ubugari:
q.en: Unless special local rules apply, when any vehicle is stopped or parked on the side space reserved for pedestrians, the driver must leave them a path of at least the following width, so that they can walk without having to go into the road:

options.en: None of the answers is correct

explain.rw: Ikinyabiziga gihagaze ku ruhande rugenewe abanyamaguru kigomba kubasigira akayira gafite nibura m 1 z’ubugari, kugira ngo batajya mu muhanda aho bahurira n’ibinyabiziga. Igice cya metero (m 0.5) ntigihagije.
explain.en: A vehicle stopped or parked on the pedestrian side space must leave a path at least 1 m wide, so pedestrians are not forced into the road among moving traffic. Half a metre is not enough.

q.rw: Icyapa cyerekana ahantu hagenewe guhagararwamo n’imodoka nini zagenewe gutwara abantu cyirangwa n’ubuso bw’amabara akurikira:
q.en: The sign showing a place reserved for buses (large passenger vehicles) to stop has a background of which colours?

options.en: None of the answers is correct

explain.rw: Dukurikije igisubizo cyemewe, nta bara na rimwe muri aya (ubururu, umweru cyangwa umutuku) ryonyine risobanura ubuso bw’icyapa cyerekana aho imodoka nini zitwara abantu zihagarara. Ni byiza kumenya icyo cyapa ukireba ku ishusho yacyo aho gukeka ibara ryacyo.
explain.en: According to the official key, none of the colours offered (blue, white or red) on its own is the background of the bus-stop sign, so the answer is 'none of the answers is correct'. Learn this sign from its picture rather than guessing its colour.

q.rw: Icyapa cyerekana ko inzira giteyeho mu ntangiriro idakomeza kigaragazwa n’ikirango (ikimenyetso) cy’amabara akurikira:
q.en: The sign showing that the road at whose entrance it stands is a dead end (no through road) has a symbol in which colours?

options.en: None of the answers is correct

explain.rw: Icyapa cyerekana inzira idakomeza ni icyapa cy’ubururu cya mpande enye, kiriho ikirango cy’umweru (umuhanda) gifunzwe n’akarongo gatukura ku mpera yacyo. Ni yo mpamvu ikirango cyacyo kigizwe n’umweru n’umutuku.
explain.en: The dead-end (no through road) sign is a blue square sign with a white symbol of the road closed off by a red bar at its end – so the symbol is white and red.

q.rw: Buri modoka yagenewe gutwara abantu, ariko umubare wabo ntarengwa ukaba munsi ya 6 umuyobozi abariwemo igomba kugira imikandara yo kurinda ibyago igenewe aba bakurikira:
q.en: Every car designed to carry passengers, with a maximum capacity of fewer than 6 people including the driver, must have seat belts for the following:

options.en: The passenger sitting in the front seat

options.rw: ishobora no kugira imikandara kuzindi ntebe z’inyuma
options.en: It may also have seat belts on the other, rear seats
All of the answers are correct

explain.rw: Imodoka itwara abantu batageze kuri 6, umuyobozi abariwemo, igomba kugira imikandara yo kurinda ibyago y’umuyobozi n’iy’umugenzi wicaye ku ntebe y’imbere, kandi ishobora no kuyigira ku ntebe z’inyuma. Imikandara igabanya cyane ibikomere iyo habaye impanuka, bityo ibisubizo byose ni ukuri.
explain.en: A car carrying fewer than 6 people (driver included) must have seat belts for the driver and the front-seat passenger, and may also have them on the rear seats. Seat belts greatly reduce injuries in a crash, so all of the answers are correct.

q.rw: Usibye ibinyabiziga by'ingabo z'Igihugu, Ikinyabiziga kigendeshwa na moteri kiriho ibyuma ntamenwa cyangwa ikindi cyose gituma gikoreshwa mu gutera cyangwa mu kwitabara ntigishobora kugenda mu nzira nyabagendwa kidafite uruhushya rwihariye. Urwo ruhushya rutangwa naba bakurikira:
q.en: Except for vehicles of the national armed forces, a motor vehicle fitted with armour, or with anything else that allows it to be used for attack or defence, may not travel on a public road without a special permit. Who issues this permit?

options.en: The minister in charge of transport

explain.rw: Ikinyabiziga kiriho ibyuma ntamenwa cyangwa ibindi bituma gikoreshwa mu gutera cyangwa mu kwitabara, kitari icy’ingabo z’igihugu, kigomba kugira uruhushya rwihariye rutangwa na minisitiri ushinzwe gutwara abantu n’ibintu. Ibinyabiziga by’ingabo z’igihugu byo ntibisabwa urwo ruhushya.
explain.en: A non-military armoured vehicle, or one equipped for attack or defence, needs a special permit to use public roads, and that permit is issued by the minister in charge of transport. Vehicles of the national armed forces do not need it.

q.rw: Iyo umukumbi ugizwe n’amatungo maremare arenze ane cyangwa amatungo magufi arenze atandatu mu nzira nyabagendwa iyo hatakibona neza kuburyo umuyobozi abona muri m 200 ugomba kugaragazwa kuburyo bukurikira:
q.en: When a herd of more than four large animals or more than six small animals is on a public road and visibility is so poor that a driver cannot see for 200 m, it must be shown as follows:

options.rw: itara ry’urumuri rwera cyangwa rusa n’icunga rihishije imbere y’umukumbi
options.en: A white or orange light at the front of the herd

options.rw: itara ry’urumuri rutukura cyangwa umuhondo ritwawe inyuma y’umukumbi
options.en: A red or yellow light carried at the rear of the herd

options.rw: A na B ni ibisubizo by’ukuri

options.en: None of the answers is correct

explain.rw: Dukurikije igisubizo cyemewe, nta na kimwe mu bisubizo byatanzwe gisobanura neza uko umukumbi ugaragazwa. By’umwihariko, inyuma y’umukumbi hagomba itara ritukura, si iry’umuhondo, bityo igisubizo cya kabiri n’icya gatatu si byo, kandi n’icya mbere ntikemewe uko cyanditse.
explain.en: According to the official key, none of the options describes the required lighting exactly. In particular the rear of a herd must be shown by a red light, not a yellow one, so the second and third options are wrong, and the key does not accept the first option as worded either.

q.rw: Ibinyabiziga biherekeranyije mu butumwa ntibishobora gutonda uburebure burenga umurongo wa m 500. Iyi bibaye bityo ibinyabiziga biherekeranye mu butumwa bishobora kugabanwamo amatsinda atonze umurongo atarengeje m 50 z’uburebure kdi hagati yayo hakaba byibura m 50 ariko ibyo ntibikurikizwa kubinyabiziga bikurikira:
q.en: Vehicles travelling together in an escorted convoy may not form a line longer than 500 m. If that happens, the convoy may be split into groups no longer than 50 m, with at least 50 m between them; but this does not apply to the following vehicles:

options.en: Escorted military convoys in built-up areas

options.rw: A na B ni ibisubizo by’ukuri

options.en: None of the answers is correct

explain.rw: Ibinyabiziga biherekeranyije mu butumwa ntibigomba kurenza umurongo wa m 500; bishobora kugabanywamo amatsinda atarenza m 50 asiga hagati yayo nibura m 50, kugira ngo ibindi binyabiziga bibone uko binyura. Dukurikije igisubizo cyemewe, iryo tegeko ntirikurikizwa ku binyabiziga by’abasirikare biherekeranyije mu nsisiro.
explain.en: A convoy must not be longer than 500 m; it may be split into groups of at most 50 m with gaps of at least 50 m, so other traffic can get through. According to the official key, this does not apply to military convoys in built-up areas; police convoys are not exempt.

q.rw: Iyo ikinyabiziga gikururwa n’inyamaswa nacyo gikuruye ikindi uburebure bw’ibikururwa bukaba burenga m 18 hatabariwemo icyo kinyabiziga cya mbere kiziritseho hagomba ibi bikurikira:
q.en: When an animal-drawn vehicle is itself towing another, and the length of the towed vehicles exceeds 18 m (not counting the first vehicle to which they are hitched), the following is required:

options.en: An attendant for the second vehicle

options.rw: A na B ni ibisubizo by’ukuri

options.en: None of the answers is correct

explain.rw: Iyo ibikururwa n’ikinyabiziga gikururwa n’inyamaswa birengeje m 18 z’uburebure, ikinyabiziga cya kabiri kigomba kugira umuherekeza ugikurikirana, kugira ngo hirindwe impanuka. Itegeko risaba umuherekeza w’ikinyabiziga cya kabiri, si abaherekeza babiri.
explain.en: When the vehicles towed behind an animal-drawn vehicle are longer than 18 m, the second vehicle must have an attendant to watch over it. The rule requires an attendant for the second vehicle, not two attendants.

q.rw: Ibinyabiziga bikurikira ntibitegetswe kugira ibimenyetso bibyerekana iyo byambukiranya umuhanda cyangwa bigenda ku ruhande rwawo:
q.en: Which of the following are not required to carry lights or markings when crossing the road or moving along its edge?

options.rw: A na B ni ibisubizo by’ukuri

options.en: None of the answers is correct

explain.rw: Ibinyabiziga bito bigendwamo n’abana n’ibigendwamo n’abamugaye ntibitegetswe kugira ibimenyetso bibigaragaza iyo byambukiranya umuhanda cyangwa bigenda ku ruhande rwawo. Kubera ko bigenda buhoro kandi bishobora kutagaragara neza nijoro, umuyobozi agomba kubyitondera cyane.
explain.en: Children's carriages and wheelchairs are not required to carry lights or markings when crossing the road or moving along its edge. Because they are slow and can be hard to see at night, drivers must watch out for them.

q.rw: Icyapa cy’inyongera kigaragaza ikibanza cy’ingando cyangwa cy’abantu benshi bagendera ku nyamaswa kirangwa n’amabara akurikira:
q.en: An additional sign indicating a camping site or a caravan site (literally 'a site for many people travelling on animals') has which colours?

options.en: green, yellow and a black symbol
None of the answers is correct

explain.rw: Ibyapa byerekana serivisi cyangwa ahantu hihariye nk’ikibanza cy’ingando bigira ubuso bw’ubururu, igice cy’umweru n’ikirango cy’umukara. Umuhondo n’icyatsi kibisi si amabara y’ibyo byapa.
explain.en: Signs pointing out facilities such as a camping site have a blue background with a white panel carrying a black symbol. Yellow and green are not used on these signs.

q.rw: Icyapa cyerekana ahantu amategeko y’Umuhanda urombeje w’ibice byinshi atangirira gukurikizwa, kirangwa n’ibirango (ibimenyetso) by’amabara akurikira:
q.en: The sign marking where motorway rules begin to apply has symbols in which colours?

options.en: None of the answers is correct

explain.rw: Icyapa cyerekana intangiriro y’umuhanda urombereje w’ibisate byinshi ni icyapa cyerekana gifite ubuso bw’ubururu n’ikirango cy’umweru. Nta na kimwe mu bisubizo a, b na c kirimo ubururu, bityo nta gisubizo cy’ukuri kirimo.
explain.en: The motorway sign is an information sign with a blue background and a white symbol. None of options a, b and c includes blue, so none of them is correct.

q.rw: Igihe ikorwa ry’imirimo ribangamiye cyane cyangwa buke uburyo bwo kugenda mu nzira nyabagendwa, ahakorerwa imirimo hagaragazwa ku buryo bukurikira:
q.en: When roadworks obstruct traffic on a public road, whether a lot or a little, how is the work site indicated?

options.rw: icyapa cyera cya mpande enye, zingana zifite uruhande rwa metero 0.30
options.en: a white square sign with sides of 0.30 m
a barrier at the right-hand end

options.rw: A na B ni ibisubizo by’ukuri

options.en: None of the answers is correct

explain.rw: Ahakorerwa imirimo hamenyeshwa mbere n’icyapa kiburira cyerekana imirimo (mpandeshatu ifite umuzenguruko utukura). Icyapa cyera cya mpande enye zingana gifite uruhande rwa cm 30 gikoreshwa ku kizirikisho cy’ikinyabiziga gikururwa, si ahakorerwa imirimo, bityo nta gisubizo cy’ukuri kirimo.
explain.en: A work site is announced in advance with the 'road works' warning sign (a triangle with a red border). The white square plate with 30 cm sides is used to mark a tow rope or chain between two vehicles, not a work site, so none of the answers is correct.

q.rw: Iyo mu muhanda, imirimo yihariye ubugari butuma abayobozi bagomba kuva mu mwanya wabo usanzwe kugirango bakomeze urugendo, ahategetswe kunyurwa hagaragazwa n’ikimenyetso gishyirwa aho imirimo irangirira mu ruhande rugenderwamo. Icyo kimenyetso kirangwa n’amabara akurikira:
q.en: When roadworks take up so much of the width that drivers must leave their normal position to continue, the side on which they must pass is shown by a sign placed where the works end, on the side used by traffic. What colours does that sign have?

options.en: blue background with a white symbol

options.rw: umuzenguruko w’umutuku, ubuso umweru n’ikirango cy’umukara
options.en: red border, white background and a black symbol

options.rw: umuzenguruko w’umutuku, ubuso mu ibara ryera, ikirango mu ibara ry’umutuku n’umukara
options.en: red border, white background, symbol in red and black
None of the answers is correct

explain.rw: Icyo kimenyetso ni icyapa gitegeka (nk’icyerekana uruhande bategetswe kunyuramo), kandi ibyapa bitegeka bigira ishusho y’uruziga, ubuso bw’ubururu n’ikirango cy’umweru. Umuzenguruko utukura n’ubuso bwera biranga ibyapa bibuza cyangwa biburira.
explain.en: That sign is a mandatory sign (such as one showing which side to pass), and mandatory signs are round with a blue background and a white symbol. A red border on a white background belongs to prohibitory or warning signs.

q.rw: Icyapa cyerekana ko hari amabwiriza yihariye mu buryo bwo kugendera mu cyambu cyangwa ku kibuga cy’indege giteye ku buryo bukurikira:
q.en: The sign showing that special traffic rules apply inside a port or an airport looks like this:

options.rw: ishusho mpandeshatu, ubuso mu ibara ryera, ikirango mu ibara ry’umukara
ishusho mpandenye, ubuso mu ibara ry’ubururu n’ikirango kiri mu ibara ryera
options.en: rectangular, blue background with a white symbol

options.rw: ishusho y’uruziga mu ibara ry’ubururu ni ikirango kiri mu ibara ryera
options.en: round and blue, with a white symbol
None of the answers is correct

explain.rw: Icyapa kimenyesha ko winjiye ahantu hari amabwiriza yihariye, nk’icyambu cyangwa ikibuga cy’indege, ni icyapa cyerekana: gifite ishusho mpandenye, ubuso bw’ubururu n’ikirango cyera. Uruziga rw’ubururu ni icyapa gitegeka, naho mpandeshatu ni icyapa kiburira.
explain.en: A sign announcing that special rules apply in an area such as a port or airport is an information sign: rectangular, with a blue background and a white symbol. A blue circle is a mandatory sign, and a triangle is a warning sign.

q.rw: Nijoro igihe ijuru rikeye, itara ribonesha icyapa kiranga numero y’ikinyabiziga rigomba gutuma izo numero zisomerwa nibura mu ntera ikurikira:
q.en: At night in clear weather, the lamp lighting the vehicle's number plate must make the number readable from at least:

explain.rw: Itara ribonesha icyapa kiranga numero y’ikinyabiziga rigomba gutuma numero zisomerwa nibura muri m 20 nijoro igihe ijuru rikeye, kugira ngo ikinyabiziga kibashe kumenyekana. Intera nini nka m 50 cyangwa m 150 si zo zisabwa kuri iri tara.
explain.en: The number-plate lamp must make the registration number readable from at least 20 m at night in clear weather, so the vehicle can be identified. Longer distances such as 50 m or 150 m are not what the rule requires for this lamp.

q.rw: Ibyapa byerekana icyago cyidahoraho kandi bigenewe kwerekana aho bagana cyangwa aho berekeza umuhanda nk’igihe cy’impanuka cyangwa hari imirimo ikorwa mu muhanda birangwa n’amabara akurikira:
q.en: Signs warning of a temporary danger, and signs showing directions or diversions, for example after an accident or during roadworks, have which colours?

options.en: None of the answers is correct

explain.rw: Ibyapa by’agateganyo (nk’ibishyirwaho igihe cy’impanuka cyangwa imirimo) bigomba gutandukana n’ibyapa bisanzwe bihoraho, kandi amabara avugwa muri a, b na c si yo ateganywa kuri byo. Ni yo mpamvu nta gisubizo cy’ukuri kirimo.
explain.en: Temporary signs (such as those put up after an accident or for roadworks) must stand out from permanent signs, and the colour combinations in a, b and c are not the ones prescribed for them. That is why none of the answers is correct.

q.rw: Birabujijwe kubangamira imigendere isanzwe y’ibindi binyabiziga kubera ibi bikurikira:
q.en: It is forbidden to hinder the normal flow of other vehicles by:

options.rw: gukacira feri bidatewe no kwirinda ibyago
options.en: braking sharply when there is no danger to avoid

options.rw: A na B ni ibisubizo by’ukuri

options.en: None of the answers is correct

explain.rw: Umuyobozi ntagomba kubangamira abandi agabanya umuvuduko bidasanzwe nta mpamvu, cyangwa akacira feri bitari ukwirinda icyago. Ibyo byombi bishobora gutuma ibinyabiziga bimukurikiye bimugonga inyuma, bityo A na B ni ukuri.
explain.en: A driver must not obstruct other traffic by slowing down abnormally for no reason, or by braking sharply when there is no danger to avoid. Both can cause the vehicles behind to run into you, so A and B are correct.

q.rw: Iyo kuva bwije kugeza bukeye cyangwa bitewe n’uko ibihe bimeze bitagishoboka kubona neza muri m 200, mu nzira nyabagendwa, romoruki iziritse kuri velomoteri cyangwa ipikipiki idafite akanyabiziga ku ruhande, uretse velomoteri idafite umuyobozi, kandi uburumbarare bwayo, cyangwa bw’ibyo yikoreye bukaba butuma itara ry’ikinyabiziga biyikurura ritagaragara, iyo romoruki igaragazwa ku buryo bukurikira:
q.en: From dusk to dawn, or whenever conditions make it impossible to see clearly over 200 m, if a trailer on a public road is hitched to a moped or to a motorcycle without a sidecar (except a moped without a rider), and its width or its load hides the towing vehicle's light, how must the trailer be marked?

options.rw: itara ryera riri kuri romoruki inyuma
options.en: a white light at the rear of the trailer

options.rw: itara ry’umuhondo riri kuri romoruki inyuma
options.en: a yellow light at the rear of the trailer

options.rw: itara risa n’icunga riri kuri romoruki inyuma
options.en: an amber light at the rear of the trailer
All of the answers are correct

explain.rw: Iyo romoruki cyangwa ibyo yikoreye bihishe itara ry’ikinyabiziga kiyikurura, romoruki ubwayo igomba kugira itara inyuma kugira ngo igaragare. Nk’uko igisubizo cyemewe kibivuga, iryo tara rishobora kuba ryera, iry’umuhondo cyangwa irisa n’icunga, ni yo mpamvu ibisubizo byose ari ukuri.
explain.en: When the trailer or its load hides the towing vehicle's light, the trailer itself must carry a light at the rear so it can be seen. According to the official key, that light may be white, yellow or amber, so all of the answers are correct.

q.rw: Amatara maremare y’ikinyabiziga agomba kuzimwa mu bihe bikurikira:
q.en: A vehicle's main-beam headlights must be switched off in the following situations:

options.rw: iyo umuhanda umurikiwe hose kandi umuyobozi ashobora kubona nibura mu ntera ingana na metero 200
options.en: when the road is lit all along and the driver can see at least 200 m ahead

options.rw: iyo ikinyabiziga gikurikiye mu ntambwe zitagera muri m100 keretse iyo umuyobozi wacyo ashaka kunyura kucyo akurikiye acana azimya vuba vuba amatara maremare
options.en: when following another vehicle at less than 100 m, unless the driver wants to overtake it and flashes the main beams on and off quickly

options.rw: A na B ni ibisubizo by’ukuri

options.en: None of the answers is correct

explain.rw: Amatara maremare azimwa iyo atagikenewe cyangwa ashobora guhumisha abandi: iyo umuhanda umurikiwe hose umuyobozi akabona muri m 200, n’iyo akurikiye ikindi kinyabiziga ku ntera itagera kuri m 100. Gucana no kuzimya vuba vuba amatara maremare byemewe gusa kugira ngo umenyeshe uwo ukurikiye ko ushaka kumunyuraho.
explain.en: Main beams are switched off when they are not needed or would dazzle others: when the road is lit all along and the driver can see 200 m, and when following another vehicle at less than 100 m. Flashing them briefly is allowed only to tell the driver ahead that you want to overtake.

q.rw: Iyo akanyabiziga gasunikwa cyangwa ibyo gatwaye bidatuma umuyobozi abona neza imbere ye, uwo muyobozi agomba gukora ibi bikurikira:
q.en: When a hand-pushed cart, or its load, prevents the person driving it from seeing clearly ahead, that person must:

options.rw: A na B ni ibisubizo by’ukuri

options.en: None of the answers is correct

explain.rw: Usunika akanyabiziga agomba kureba imbere ye neza. Iyo akanyabiziga cyangwa ibyo gatwaye bimubuza kureba, ntagomba gukomeza kugasunika ahubwo agomba kugakurura, akagenda imbere yako areba inzira. Gushaka umuherekeza si byo itegeko risaba.
explain.en: Someone pushing a hand cart must be able to see the road ahead. If the cart or its load blocks the view, they must stop pushing it and pull it instead, walking in front where they can see the way. Finding an attendant is not what the rule requires.

q.rw: Uretse igihe hari amategeko yihariye akurikizwa muri ako karere cyangwa imitunganyirize bwite y’aho, ikinyabiziga cyose cyangwa inyamaswa ihagaze umwanya muto cyangwa munini igomba kuba iri aha hakurikira:
q.en: Unless special local rules or local arrangements apply, every vehicle or animal that is stopped or parked must be:

options.rw: mu kaboko k’iburyo hakurikijwe aho yaganaga uretse igihe ari mu muhanda w’icyerekezo kimwe
options.en: on the right-hand side relative to its direction of travel, except on a one-way road

options.rw: ahegereye bishobotse akayira k’abanyamaguru iyo umuhanda ugafite ariko umwanya w’ibiziga n’akayira ntube urenga santimetero 50
options.en: as close as possible to the footpath, if the road has one, with no more than 50 cm between the wheels and the footpath

options.rw: A na B ni ibisubizo by’ukuri

options.en: None of the answers is correct

explain.rw: Ikinyabiziga gihagaze kigomba kuba iburyo ukurikije icyerekezo cyacyo (uretse mu muhanda w’icyerekezo kimwe), kandi kikegera akayira k’abanyamaguru ku buryo hagati y’ibiziga n’akayira hatarenga cm 50. Ibyo byombi bituma kitabangamira abandi bagenzi, ni yo mpamvu A na B ari ukuri.
explain.en: A stopped or parked vehicle must be on the right relative to its direction of travel (except on a one-way road) and as close as possible to the footpath, with no more than 50 cm between the wheels and the footpath. Both conditions keep it out of other traffic's way, so A and B are correct.

q.rw: Iyo ikinyabiziga gihagaritswe n’ijoro ku buryo abayobozi bakigana badashobora kumenya ko kibabereye imbogamizi, kigomba kurangirwa kure n’ikimenyetso cyabigenewe kiri ahantu hagaragara kugirango kiburire hakiri kare abandi bayobozi baza bagisanga, ariko ntibireba ibinyabiziga bikurikira:
q.en: When a vehicle is stopped at night in such a way that approaching drivers cannot tell it is an obstacle, it must be signalled from a distance with the prescribed warning device, placed where it is clearly visible, to warn approaching drivers in good time. This does not apply to which vehicles?

options.rw: A na B ni ibisubizo by’ukuri

options.en: None of the answers is correct

explain.rw: Ikinyabiziga gihagaze nijoro kikaba imbogamizi abandi batabona kigomba kuburirwa kure n’ikimenyetso cyabigenewe (nka mpandeshatu iburira). Iryo tegeko ntirireba velomoteri n’ipikipiki idafite akanyabiziga ku ruhande, bityo A na B ni ukuri.
explain.en: A vehicle stopped at night that forms an obstacle others cannot see must be signalled well in advance with the prescribed warning device (such as a warning triangle). Mopeds and motorcycles without a sidecar are exempt from this rule, so A and B are correct.

q.rw: Abanyamaguru batatanye cyangwa bagize udutsiko tudafatanyije gahunda kdi batanayobowe n’umwarimu bategetswe kunyura mu tuyira turi ku mpande z’umuhanda no ku nkengero zigiye hejuru uretse ubutaka butsindagiye butandukanya imihanda ibiri bwo kunyurwamo gusa n’aba bakurikira:
q.en: Pedestrians walking alone, or in groups that are not organised and not led by a teacher, must use the footways at the sides of the road and the raised verges. The central reserve separating two carriageways may be used only by:

options.rw: abanyamaguru bashaka guhagarara akanya gato igihe bambukiranya umuhanda
options.en: pedestrians who need to wait briefly while crossing the road

options.rw: A na B ni ibisubizo by’ukuri

options.en: None of the answers is correct

explain.rw: Ubutaka butsindagiye butandukanya imihanda ibiri ntibugenewe kugenderwamo n’abanyamaguru; bwemerewe gusa abanyamaguru bambukiranya umuhanda bakeneye kuhahagarara akanya gato mbere yo gukomeza kwambuka. Udutsiko tw’abantu benshi ntitwemerewe kubunyuramo.
explain.en: The central reserve between two carriageways is not a walkway; it may be used only by pedestrians crossing the road who need to wait there briefly before finishing the crossing. Large groups of pedestrians may not walk along it.

q.rw: Ibinyabiziga biherekeranyije mu butumwa ntibishobora gutonda uburebure burenga umurongo wa m 500, iyo bibaye bityo ibinyabiziga biherekeranyije mu butumwa bishobora kugabanywamo amatsinda atonze umurongo utarengeje ibipimo bikurikira:
q.en: Vehicles travelling together in a convoy may not form a line longer than 500 m. If they would, the convoy may be split into groups whose length does not exceed:

options.en: None of the answers is correct

explain.rw: Umurongo w’ibinyabiziga biherekeranyije mu butumwa ntugomba kurenza m 500. Iyo ari muremure kurusha, ugabanywamo amatsinda, buri tsinda rikaba ritonze umurongo utarengeje m 50, kugira ngo abandi bagenzi babone uko banyura hagati yayo.
explain.en: A convoy may not form a line longer than 500 m. If it would, it is split into groups, each no longer than 50 m, so that other traffic can get through between them.

q.rw: Ibyapa byereka inkomane y’inzira nyabagendwa n’inzira ya gariyamoshi bigomba iteka kumurikwa cyangwa kugarura urumuri ku buryo bigaragarira nibura mu ntera ikurikira igihe ijuru rikeye:
q.en: Signs marking a level crossing between a public road and a railway must always be lit or reflective so that, in clear weather, they are visible from at least:

options.en: None of the answers is correct

explain.rw: Ibyapa byereka inkomane y’inzira nyabagendwa n’inzira ya gariyamoshi bigomba guhora bimurikwa cyangwa bigarura urumuri kugira ngo bigaragare no mu ijoro. Ariko intera zivugwa muri a, b na c si zo ziteganywa, bityo nta gisubizo cy’ukuri kirimo.
explain.en: Level-crossing signs must always be lit or reflective so they can be seen even at night. However, none of the distances given in a, b and c is the prescribed one, so none of the answers is correct.

q.rw: Imbibi ziri ku mpera z’ubwihugiko bw’abanyamaguru kandi ziri mu muhanda kimwe n’imbibi n’ibindi bikoresho bigenewe gutuma bagenda mu muhanda nta muvundo zisigwa irangi ry’ibara rikurikira:
q.en: The kerbs at the ends of pedestrian refuge islands in the roadway, as well as other kerbs and devices intended to keep traffic moving smoothly, are painted with:

options.en: None of the answers is correct

explain.rw: Impera z’ubwihugiko bw’abanyamaguru n’ibindi bikoresho biri mu muhanda biyobora ibinyabiziga bisigwa irangi ry’umuhondo rigarura urumuri. Ibyo bituma abayobozi babibona kure, no mu ijoro, bakirinda kubigonga.
explain.en: The ends of pedestrian refuges and other traffic-guiding devices standing in the roadway are painted with yellow reflective paint. This lets drivers see them from far away, even at night, and avoid hitting them.

q.rw: Kugirango ikinyabiziga kive ahantu hari urwondo cyangwa hanyerera bidasanzwe hashobora gukoreshwa uburyo bukurikira:
q.en: To get a vehicle out of a muddy or exceptionally slippery place, the following may be used:

options.en: the tyres may be fitted with studs

options.rw: inziga zishobora gushyirwaho iminyururu irwanya ubunyerere
options.en: the tyres may be fitted with anti-skid chains

options.rw: A na B ni ibisubizo by’ukuri

options.en: None of the answers is correct

explain.rw: Kugira ngo ikinyabiziga kive mu rwondo cyangwa ahanyerera bidasanzwe, inziga zishobora gushyirwaho by’igihe gito iminyururu irwanya ubunyerere. Udushyundu si bwo buryo bwemewe, bityo igisubizo ni B gusa.
explain.en: To get a vehicle out of mud or an exceptionally slippery spot, anti-skid chains may be fitted to the tyres temporarily. Studs are not the permitted method, so only B is correct.

q.rw: Iyo imizigo igizwe n’ibinyampeke, ikawa, amakara, ubwatsi bw’amatungo bidahambiriye, ubugari bwayo bushobora kugera kuri m2 na cm75 ariko iyo iyo mizigo ijyanwa mu karere katarenga km25 uvuye aho yapakiriwe, usibye mu nsisiro, ubugari bwayo bushobora kugera ku bipimo bikurikira:
q.en: When a load consists of loose grain, coffee, charcoal or fodder, its width may reach 2.75 m; but when such a load is carried within 25 km of where it was loaded, outside built-up areas, its width may reach:

options.en: None of the answers is correct

explain.rw: Imizigo idahambiriye nk’ibinyampeke, ikawa, amakara cyangwa ubwatsi bw’amatungo isanzwe ishobora kugira ubugari bwa m 2 na cm 75. Iyo ijyanwa hafi, mu karere katarenga km 25 uvuye aho yapakiriwe kandi atari mu nsisiro, ubwo bugari bushobora kugera kuri m 3, ariko ntiburenge.
explain.en: Loose loads such as grain, coffee, charcoal or fodder may normally be up to 2.75 m wide. When carried a short distance, within 25 km of the loading point and outside built-up areas, the width may go up to 3 m but no more.

q.rw: Mu mujyi no ku mihanda y’igihugu igenwa na minisitiri ushinzwe gutwara abantu n’ibintu, ubwikorere ntarengwa ku ikamyo iyo ariyo yose ntibushobora kurenga ibipimo bikurikira:
q.en: In towns and on national roads designated by the minister responsible for transport, the maximum load of any lorry may not exceed:

options.en: None of the answers is correct

explain.rw: Nta gipimo kimwe cy’ubwikorere ntarengwa kireba ikamyo iyo ariyo yose: uburemere ntarengwa bugenwa hakurikijwe umubare w’imitambiko y’ikinyabiziga n’uko ifungwaho ibiziga. Ibipimo nka toni 16 cyangwa toni 24 bireba gusa imiterere imwe y’imitambiko, si buri kamyo, bityo nta gisubizo cy’ukuri kirimo.
explain.en: There is no single load limit for every lorry: the maximum weight depends on the number of axles and how the wheels are fitted to them. Figures such as 16 or 24 tonnes apply only to particular axle arrangements, not to every lorry, so none of the answers is correct.

q.rw: Iyo bitewe n’imiterere y’ahantu intera itandukanya icyapa n’ahantu habi iri munsi ya m150 ku buryo bugaragara, iyo ntera yerekanishwa icyapa cy’inyongera giteye ku buryo bukurikira:
q.en: When, because of the terrain, the distance between a warning sign and the dangerous place is noticeably less than 150 m, that distance is shown on an additional panel that looks like this:

options.en: a square with a white background
a rectangle with a white background
a triangle with a red border
None of the answers is correct

explain.rw: Icyapa kiburira gisanzwe gishyirwa nko muri m 150 mbere y’ahantu habi. Iyo iyo ntera ari ngufi cyane bitewe n’imiterere y’ahantu, ishyirwa ku cyapa cy’inyongera gifite ishusho y’urukiramende n’ubuso bwera, gishyirwa munsi y’icyapa kiburira.
explain.en: A warning sign is normally placed about 150 m before the hazard. When the terrain makes that distance clearly shorter, it is shown on an additional panel: a white rectangle fixed below the warning sign.

q.rw: Nijoro, amatara yo kubisikana y’ibara ryera cyangwa y’umuhondo agomba, igihe ijoro rikeye kumurika mu muhanda nibura mu ntera ikurikira:
q.en: At night in clear weather, white or yellow dipped headlights must light the road for at least:

options.en: None of the answers is correct

explain.rw: Amatara yo kubisikana amurika hafi kugira ngo adahumisha abo mubisikana, ariko agomba kumurika umuhanda nibura muri m 40 imbere y’ikinyabiziga. Intera ya m 100 ni iy’amatara maremare.
explain.en: Dipped headlights light a shorter distance so they do not dazzle oncoming drivers, but they must still light the road for at least 40 m ahead. The 100 m distance applies to main-beam headlights.

q.rw: Ikintu cyose cyatuma hahindurwa ibyanditse bireba nyirikarita cyangwa ibiranga ikinyabiziga kigomba kumenyeshwa ibiro by’umusoro haba mu magambo cyangwa mu ibaruwa ishinganye ibyo bikorwa mu gihe kingana gute:
q.en: Any change affecting the details of the registration certificate holder or of the vehicle must be reported to the tax office, in person or by registered letter, within what period?

options.en: None of the answers is correct

explain.rw: Impinduka zose ku byanditse ku ikarita y’ikinyabiziga, zaba zireba nyirayo cyangwa ibiranga ikinyabiziga, zigomba kumenyeshwa ibiro by’imisoro mu minsi 8. Amezi 2, ukwezi kumwe n’iminsi 15 birenze igihe giteganywa, bityo nta gisubizo cy’ukuri kirimo.
explain.en: Any change to the details on the registration certificate, whether about the holder or the vehicle, must be reported to the tax office within 8 days. Two months, one month and fifteen days are all longer than allowed, so none of the answers is correct.

q.rw: Kugirango berekane ahantu habi cyane, hakoreshwa ikimenyetso cy’itara ry’umuhondo rimyasa, rivuga uburenganzira bwo gutambuka icyo kimenyetso barushijeho kwitonda. Ese icyo kimenyetso gihindura iki ku mategeko agenga gutambuka mbere:
q.en: To mark especially dangerous places, a flashing amber light is used; it means traffic may pass it but with extra care. What does this signal change about the priority rules?

options.rw: abatwaye ibinyabiziga binini nibo batambuka mbere
options.en: Drivers of large vehicles have priority
None of the answers is correct

explain.rw: Itara ry’umuhondo rimyasa riburira gusa ko hari icyago, rigasaba kwitonda cyane. Ntiritanga uburenganzira bwo gutambuka mbere: amategeko asanzwe agenga gutambuka mbere, n’ibyapa bihari, akomeza gukurikizwa.
explain.en: A flashing amber light only warns of danger and calls for extra care. It gives no one priority: the normal priority rules, and any signs in place, still apply.

q.rw: Romoruki zifite ubugari ntarengwa bwa sentimetero 80 zishobora gushyirwaho akagarurarumuri kamwe gusa iyo zikuruwe n’ibinyabiziga bikurikira:
q.en: Trailers no wider than 80 cm may be fitted with only one reflector when they are towed by:

options.en: None of the answers is correct

explain.rw: Uburenganzira bwo gushyira akagarurarumuri kamwe gusa kuri romoruki ifite ubugari butarenga cm 80 bureba romoruki ikuruwe n’ipikipiki idafite akanyabiziga ku ruhande. Icyo kinyabiziga ntikiri mu bisubizo, kandi ipikipiki ifite akanyabiziga ku ruhande si yo ivugwa, bityo nta gisubizo cy’ukuri kirimo.
explain.en: The single-reflector allowance for trailers up to 80 cm wide applies to trailers towed by a motorcycle without a sidecar. That vehicle is not among the options, and a motorcycle with a sidecar is not covered, so none of the answers is correct.

q.rw: Amatara maremare y’ibara ryera cyangwa ry’umuhondo agomba nijoro igihe ijuru rikeye kumurika mu ntera ikurikira ku binyabiziga bifite moteri itarengeje ingufu zigera kuri sentimetero kibe 125
q.en: At night in clear weather, over what distance must the white or yellow main-beam headlights of vehicles with an engine of no more than 125 cc light the road?

options.en: None of the answers is correct

explain.rw: Amatara maremare asanzwe agomba kumurika nibura muri m 100 imbere y’ikinyabiziga, ariko ku binyabiziga bifite moteri itarengeje sentimetero kibe 125 iyo ntera igabanuka ikaba m 75.
explain.en: Main-beam headlights normally have to light at least 100 m ahead, but for vehicles with an engine of up to 125 cc the required distance is reduced to 75 m.

q.rw: Iyo kuva bwije kugeza bukeye cyangwa bitewe n’uko ibintu bimeze bitagishoboka kubona muri m 200, ibinyabiziga cyangwa imitwaro bifite ubugari burenga m 2.50 iyo bigenda mu nzira nyabagendwa bigaragazwa ku buryo bukurikira:
q.en: From dusk to dawn, or whenever conditions make it impossible to see over 200 m, how are vehicles or loads wider than 2.50 m marked when travelling on a public road?

options.en: two red lights at the rear

options.rw: iyo bibaye ngombwa no ku mpera y’amabondo y’ikinyabiziga cyangwa y’imitwaro ni itara ndangaburumbarare risa n’icunga rihishije cyangwa ry’umuhondo
options.en: where necessary, also an amber or yellow side-marker lamp at the ends of the sides of the vehicle or load

options.rw: A na B ni ibisubizo by’ukuri

options.en: None of the answers is correct

explain.rw: Ikinyabiziga cyangwa imitwaro bigari kurusha m 2.50 bigomba kugaragara neza mu mwijima: inyuma bigira amatara abiri atukura, kandi iyo bibaye ngombwa bikagira ku mpera z’impande amatara ndangaburumbarare asa n’icunga cyangwa ay’umuhondo, kugira ngo abandi bamenye ubugari bwabyo. Bityo A na B ni ukuri.
explain.en: Vehicles or loads wider than 2.50 m must be clearly visible in the dark: two red lights at the rear and, where necessary, amber or yellow side-marker lamps at the ends of the sides so others can judge their width. So A and B are correct.

q.rw: Igice cy’umuhanda kiri hakurya y’umurongo mugari wera udacagaguye ugaragaza inkombe mpimbano y’umuhanda kiba kigenewe ibi bikurikira:
q.en: The part of the road beyond a wide continuous white line that marks the notional edge of the carriageway is intended for:

options.rw: guhagararwamo umwanya muto n’umunini ndetse no kumihanda irombereje y’ibisate byinshi n’imihanda y’imodoka
options.en: stopping and parking, including on motorways and motor roads

options.rw: A na B ni ibisubizo by’ukuri

options.en: None of the answers is correct

explain.rw: Igice kiri hakurya y’umurongo mugari wera udacagaguye ugaragaza inkombe mpimbano y’umuhanda kigenewe guhagararwamo umwanya muto n’umunini, uretse ku mihanda irombereje y’ibisate byinshi n’imihanda y’imodoka. Igisubizo a ntikiyuzuye, naho b kirimo ikosa kuko cyongeraho iyo mihanda.
explain.en: The area beyond a wide continuous white edge line is meant for stopping and parking, except on motorways and motor roads. Option a is incomplete and option b is wrong because it includes those roads, so none of the answers is correct.

q.rw: Iminyururu n’ibindi byuma bifashisha bishobora kuvanwaho cyangwa binagana, hatabariwemo ibimenyetso byerekana ibyerekezo bigomba gutungurwa ku kinyabiziga ku buryo igihe byizunguza bitarenga impande zihera uburumbarare bw’ikinyabiziga kandi ibyo byuma bifashisha ntibigomba gukururuka ku butaka ariko ibyo ntibibujijwe ku binyabiziga bikurikira:
q.en: Chains and other removable or hanging accessories, other than direction indicators, must be fixed to the vehicle so that when they swing they do not go beyond the outer sides of the vehicle, and they must not drag on the ground. However, this is not forbidden for:

options.rw: ibinyabiziga bitwaye ibintu bidashobora gufata inkongi
options.en: vehicles carrying goods that cannot catch fire

options.rw: A na B ni ibisubizo by’ukuri

options.en: None of the answers is correct

explain.rw: Iminyururu n’ibindi byuma bimanitse ku kinyabiziga bigomba gufungwa neza kugira ngo bitarenga impande zacyo igihe byizunguza kandi ntibikururuke ku butaka. Nk’uko igisubizo cyemewe kibivuga, ibyo ntibibujijwe ku mashini zihinga.
explain.en: Chains and hanging accessories must be secured so they do not swing beyond the vehicle's sides or drag on the ground. According to the official key, agricultural machines are exempt from this rule.

q.rw: Ku binyabiziga cyangwa ibinyabiziga bikururana igice kirenga ku biziga ntigishobora kurenga ibipimo bikurikira:
q.en: For a vehicle or a combination of vehicles, the overhang beyond the wheels must not exceed:

options.rw: A na B ni ibisubizo by’ukuri

options.en: None of the answers is correct

explain.rw: Igice cy’ikinyabiziga kirenga ku biziga by’imbere ntigishobora kurenga m 2.70. Inyuma ho igipimo ntarengwa ni m 3 na cm 50, si m 3, bityo B ni yo yonyine ukuri.
explain.en: The front overhang beyond the wheels may not exceed 2.70 m. The rear limit is 3.50 m, not 3 m, so only B is correct.

q.rw: Uretse bibonewe uruhushya, ubundi birabujijwe gushyira no gukomeza kugendesha imodoka cyangwa romoruki mu nzira nyabagendwa iyo uburemere bw’ibyikorewe burenze uburemere ntarengwa bwemewe n’ikarita iranga ikinyabiziga ariko ibyo ntibikurikizwa ku binyabiziga bikurikira:
q.en: Except with a permit, it is forbidden to put or keep a motor vehicle or trailer on a public road when its load exceeds the maximum authorised weight shown on its registration certificate. However, this does not apply to:

options.en: All of the answers are correct

explain.rw: Ikinyabiziga ntikigomba gutwara ibirenze uburemere ntarengwa bwanditse ku ikarita yacyo keretse kibiherewe uruhushya. Iryo tegeko ntirireba imashini zikoreshwa mu kubaka imihanda; ibinyabiziga bya polisi n’ibihinga byo bigomba kubahiriza uburemere bwemewe.
explain.en: A vehicle may not carry more than the maximum authorised weight on its registration certificate unless it has a permit. The exception is machines used for building roads; police and agricultural vehicles must respect the authorised weight like everyone else.

q.rw: Gushyira mu muhanda ku buryo budasanzwe ibinyabiziga bikururana birenze bitatu bigomba gutangirwa uruhusa, uretse imashini ihinga iyo zigenda uregendo rutarenze km 25, ibinyabiziga bikururana bitwaye ibyamamazwa n’ibindi biteganwa n’iri teka ariko igiteranyo cy’uburebure bw’ibyo binyabiziga bikururana ntigishobora kurenga ibipimo bikurikira:
q.en: Putting combinations of more than three coupled vehicles on the road, as an exceptional movement, requires a permit, except for agricultural machines on trips of no more than 25 km, combinations carrying advertising, and other cases provided for by this decree. But the total length of such a combination may not exceed:

options.en: None of the answers is correct

explain.rw: Ibinyabiziga bikururana birenze bitatu bisaba uruhushya rwihariye, uretse ibisonewe nk’imashini zihinga zigenda urugendo rutarenze km 25. No muri ibyo bihe byose, uburebure bwose bw’ibyo binyabiziga bikururana ntibushobora kurenga m 25.
explain.en: A combination of more than three coupled vehicles needs a special permit, except in listed cases such as agricultural machines on trips of no more than 25 km. Even then, the total length of the combination may not exceed 25 m.

q.rw: Ibinyamitende itatu bifite moteri bigomba kugira amatara akurikira:
q.en: Motor tricycles must have the following lights:

options.rw: amatara abiri ndangambere n’amatara abiri ndanganyuma yerekana ko ikinyabiziga gihagaze
options.en: two front position lights and two rear position lights showing that the vehicle is stationary

options.rw: A na B ni ibisubizo by’ukuri

options.en: None of the answers is correct

explain.rw: Ikinyamitende cy’ibiziga bitatu gifite moteri kiba kigari kurusha ipikipiki, bityo kigomba kugira amatara abiri ndangambere n’abiri ndanganyuma agaragaza aho kiri n’ubugari bwacyo, hamwe n’utugarurarumuri tubiri. Byombi birasabwa, ni yo mpamvu A na B ari ukuri.
explain.en: A motor tricycle is wider than a motorcycle, so it needs two front and two rear position lights to show where it is and how wide it is, plus two reflectors. Both are required, so A and B are correct.

q.rw: Ibyapa bibuza n’ibitegeka bikurikizwa gusa aha hakurikira:
q.en: Prohibitory and mandatory signs apply only:

options.rw: mu gice cy’inzira nyabagendwa kiri hagati yaho bishinze n’inkomane ikurikiyeho ku ruhande rw’inzira bishinzeho
options.en: on the section of the public road between the sign and the next junction, on the side of the road where the sign stands

options.rw: ibyo byapa bishyirwaho hakurikijwe intera ibitandukanya
options.en: these signs are placed according to the distance between them

options.rw: B na C ni ibisubizo by’ukuri

explain.rw: Icyapa kibuza cyangwa gitegeka gikurikizwa uhereye aho gishinze kugeza ku nkomane ikurikiyeho, ku ruhande rw’umuhanda gishinzeho. Iyo urenze iyo nkomane, itegeko ryacyo rirangira keretse icyapa gisubiwemo.
explain.en: A prohibitory or mandatory sign applies from where it stands up to the next junction, on the side of the road where it is placed. After that junction its rule ends unless the sign is repeated.

q.rw: Icyapa cy’inyongera kerekana aho bagobokera ibinyabiziga kirangwa n’amabara akurikira:
q.en: The additional sign showing a vehicle breakdown service has which colours?

options.en: None of the answers is correct

explain.rw: Icyapa kimenyesha aho bagobokera ibinyabiziga ni icyapa cyerekana serivisi: gifite ubuso bw’ubururu, igice cy’umweru n’ikirango cy’umukara. Umutuku ukoreshwa ku byapa bibuza n’ibiburira, si kuri iki.
explain.en: The sign showing a breakdown service is an information sign: a blue background with a white panel and a black symbol. Red is used on prohibitory and warning signs, not on this one.

q.rw: Icyapa cyerekana uburebure bw’igice cyatera ibyago cyangwa bw’ahantu amabwiriza y’icyo cyapa agomba gukurikizwa kirangwa n’ubuso n’ibimenyetso bikurikira:
q.en: The sign showing the length of a dangerous section, or of the stretch over which a sign's rule applies, has which background and symbols?

options.en: blue background, white and black symbol
None of the answers is correct

explain.rw: Uburebure bw’igice cyatera ibyago cyangwa bw’aho itegeko ry’icyapa rikurikizwa bwerekanwa n’icyapa cy’inyongera gishyirwa munsi y’icyapa nyamukuru. Nk’icyapa cy’inyongera cyerekana intera, kigira ubuso bwera n’ibimenyetso by’umukara, nta bururu, bityo nta gisubizo cy’ukuri kirimo.
explain.en: The length of a dangerous section, or of the stretch where a sign applies, is shown on an additional panel under the main sign. Like the panel that shows a distance, it has a white background with black symbols and no blue, so none of the answers is correct.

q.rw: Umurongo w’umuhondo ucagaguye uciye ku nkombe nyayo y’umuhanda, umusezero w’inzira y’abanyamaguru cyangwa w’inkengero y’umuhanda yegutse uvuga ibi bikurikira:
q.en: A broken yellow line painted along the actual edge of the road, the kerb of a footway or a raised verge means:

options.rw: guhagarara umwanya muto birabujijwe ku burebure bw’uwo murongo
options.en: stopping is prohibited along the length of the line

options.rw: guhagarara umwanya muto n’umunini birabujijwe ku burebure bw’uwo murongo
options.en: stopping and parking are prohibited along the length of the line

options.rw: aho bahagarara umwanya munini cyangwa muto
options.en: a place for parking or stopping
None of the answers is correct

explain.rw: Umurongo w’umuhondo ucagaguye ku nkombe y’umuhanda cyangwa ku musezero w’akayira k’abanyamaguru ubuza guhagarara umwanya munini ku burebure bwawo, ariko guhagarara umwanya muto biremewe. Umurongo w’umuhondo udacagaguye ni wo ubuza guhagarara umwanya muto n’umunini. Bityo nta gisubizo muri a, b na c gihuye n’icyo uwo murongo uvuga.
explain.en: A broken yellow line along the road edge or kerb prohibits parking along its length, while stopping briefly is still allowed. It is the continuous yellow line that prohibits both stopping and parking. None of options a, b and c matches this meaning.

q.rw: Ku binyabiziga cyangwa ibinyabiziga bikururana igice kirenga ku biziga ntigishobora kurenga ibipimo bikurikira:
q.en: For a vehicle or a combination of vehicles, the overhang beyond the wheels must not exceed:

options.rw: A na B ni ibisubizo by’ukuri

options.en: None of the answers is correct

explain.rw: Igice kirenga ku biziga ntigishobora kurenga m 3 na cm 50 inyuma na m 2.70 imbere. Ibipimo bya m 3.40 na m 2.50 bitangwa hano si byo biteganywa, bityo nta gisubizo cy’ukuri kirimo.
explain.en: The overhang beyond the wheels may not exceed 3.50 m at the rear and 2.70 m at the front. The figures given here (3.40 m and 2.50 m) are not the legal limits, so none of the answers is correct.

q.rw: Mu migi no ku yindi mihanda y’igihugu igenwa na minisitiri ushinzwe gutwara abantu n’ibintu uburebure ntarengwa kuri buri mitambiko 3 ifungwaho ibiziga bine ni:
q.en: In towns and on other national roads designated by the minister responsible for transport, the maximum weight for each group of 3 axles fitted with four wheels is:

explain.rw: Uburemere ntarengwa bwemewe bugenwa hakurikijwe imitambiko y’ikinyabiziga. Mu mijyi no ku mihanda yagenwe na minisitiri, ku mitambiko 3 ifungwaho ibiziga bine, uburemere ntarengwa ni toni 24.
explain.en: Maximum authorised weights are set according to the vehicle's axles. In towns and on the designated national roads, for a group of 3 axles fitted with four wheels the limit is 24 tonnes.

q.rw: Iyo hagati y’uruhande rw’imbere rwa romoruki n’uruhande rw’inyuma rw’ikinyabiziga kiyikurura hari umwanya urenze m 3 ikibizirikanyije kigomba kugaragazwa ku buryo bukurikira iyo amatara y’ikinyabiziga agomba gucanwa:
q.en: If there is more than 3 m between the front of a trailer and the rear of the vehicle towing it, how must the coupling be marked when the vehicle's lights have to be on?

options.rw: agatambaro gatukura gafite nibura cm 50 z’uruhande
options.en: a red cloth with sides of at least 50 cm

options.rw: itara risa n’icunga rihishije rigaragara mu mbavu igihe ikibizirikanyije kimuritswe
options.en: an amber light visible from the sides when the coupling is lit

options.rw: A na B ni ibisubizo by’ukuri

options.en: None of the answers is correct

explain.rw: Iyo romoruki iri kure y’ikinyabiziga kiyikurura ho hejuru ya m 3, ikibizirikanyije gishobora kutagaragara nijoro. Ni yo mpamvu kigaragazwa n’itara risa n’icunga rihishije rigaragara mu mbavu, ikibizirikanyije kikamurikwa. Agatambaro gatukura si cyo kimenyetso giteganywa igihe amatara agomba gucanwa.
explain.en: When a trailer is more than 3 m behind its towing vehicle, the coupling may be invisible at night. That is why, when lights must be on, it is marked with an amber light visible from the sides while the coupling is lit. A red cloth is not the prescribed marking when lights must be on.

q.rw: Itara ryo guhagarara ry’ibara ritukura rigomba kuba ridahumisha, kandi rigomba kugaragarira mu ntera ikurikira:
q.en: The red stop (brake) light must not dazzle, and it must be visible from the following distance:

options.rw: nijoro igihe ijuru rikeye nibura muri m 200
options.en: at night in clear weather, at least 200 m

options.rw: ku manywa igihe cy’umucyo nibura muri m50
options.en: by day in bright light, at least 50 m

options.rw: nijoro nibura muri m 100 igihe ijuru rikeye
options.en: at night, at least 100 m in clear weather
None of the answers is correct

explain.rw: Itara ryo guhagarara rigomba kugaragara neza ariko ntirihumishe abari inyuma. Intera zitangwa muri a, b na c si zo ziteganywa n’amategeko, bityo nta gisubizo cy’ukuri kirimo.
explain.en: The brake light must be clearly visible without dazzling the drivers behind. None of the distances given in a, b and c is the prescribed one, so none of the answers is correct.

q.rw: Birabujijwe kongera ku mpande z’ikinyabiziga kigendeshwa na moteri cyangwa velomoteri ibi bikurikira:
q.en: It is forbidden to add the following to the sides of a motor vehicle or a moped:

options.rw: ibintu bifite imigongo cyangwa ibirenga ku mubyimba kandi bishobora gutera ibyago abandi bagenzi
options.en: objects with ridges or parts that stick out and could endanger other road users

options.rw: A na B ni ibisubizo by’ukuri

options.en: None of the answers is correct

explain.rw: Ku mpande z’ikinyabiziga ntihagomba kongerwaho imitako cyangwa ibintu birenga ku mubyimba wacyo, kuko bishobora gufata cyangwa gukomeretsa abanyamaguru n’abandi bagenzi. Ni yo mpamvu A na B byombi bibujijwe.
explain.en: Decorations and protruding objects must not be added to the sides of a vehicle, because they can catch or injure pedestrians and other road users. Both A and B are forbidden.

q.rw: Ikintu cyose cyatuma hahindurwa ibyanditswe bireba nyirikarita cyangwa ibiranga ikinyabiziga kigomba kumenyeshwa ibiro by’imisoro haba mu magambo cyangwa mu ibaruwa ishinganye. Ibyo bikorwa mu gihe kingana gute:
q.en: Any change affecting the details of the registration certificate holder or of the vehicle must be reported to the tax office, in person or by registered letter. Within what period must this be done?

options.en: None of the answers is correct

explain.rw: Impinduka zose ku byanditse ku ikarita y’ikinyabiziga, zaba zireba nyirayo cyangwa ibiranga ikinyabiziga, zigomba kumenyeshwa ibiro by’imisoro mu minsi 8, haba mu magambo cyangwa mu ibaruwa ishinganye. Ibyo bituma amakuru ari mu bitabo bya Leta ahora ari ukuri.
explain.en: Any change to the details on the registration certificate, whether about the holder or the vehicle, must be reported to the tax office within 8 days, in person or by registered letter. This keeps the official records accurate.

q.rw: Iyo ubugari bw’inzira nyabagendwa igenderwamo n’ibinyabiziga budahagije kugirango bibisikane nta nkomyi abagenzi bategetswe:
q.en: When the carriageway is too narrow for vehicles to pass each other without difficulty, road users must:

options.en: use the footpaths at the sides of the road

explain.rw: Iyo umuhanda ari muto ku buryo ibinyabiziga bitabisikana neza, buri muyobozi agomba korohera undi: kwegera iburyo uko bishoboka, kugabanya umuvuduko, no guhagarara iyo ari ngombwa. Ntibemerewe kunyura mu nzira z’abanyamaguru, kandi guhagarara gusa ntibikemura ikibazo.
explain.en: When the road is too narrow for vehicles to pass easily, each driver must make way for the other: keep as far right as possible, slow down, and stop if necessary. Drivers may not use the footpaths, and simply stopping does not solve the problem.

q.rw: Icyapa cyerekana umuvuduko ntarengwa ikinyabiziga kitagomba kurenza gishyirwa ku binyabiziga bifite uburebure ntarengwa bukurikira:
q.en: The plate showing the maximum speed a vehicle must not exceed is fitted on vehicles whose maximum authorised weight is:

options.en: None of the answers is correct

explain.rw: Icyapa cyerekana umuvuduko ntarengwa gishyirwa ku binyabiziga biremereye kugira ngo abandi bamenye umuvuduko bitagomba kurenza. Ariko uburemere bugenwa n’amategeko si toni 1, toni 2 cyangwa toni 24, bityo nta gisubizo cy’ukuri kirimo.
explain.en: A speed-limit plate is fitted on heavy vehicles so other road users know the speed they may not exceed. However, the legal weight threshold is not 1, 2 or 24 tonnes, so none of the answers is correct.

q.rw: Ahatari mu nsisiro umuvuduko ntarengwa wa velomoteri mu isaha ni:
q.en: Outside built-up areas, the maximum speed of a moped is:

options.en: None of the answers is correct

explain.rw: Velomoteri ifite umuvuduko ntarengwa wayo wihariye: ahatari mu nsisiro ntigomba kurenza km 50 mu isaha. Km 40 na km 30 si byo bipimo biteganywa ahatari mu nsisiro.
explain.en: A moped has its own speed limit: outside built-up areas it may not exceed 50 km/h. 40 and 30 km/h are not the limits set for outside built-up areas.

q.rw: Birabujijwe guhagarara akanya kanini aha hakurikira:
q.en: Parking is prohibited in the following places:

options.rw: A na B ni ibisubizo by’ukuri

options.en: None of the answers is correct

explain.rw: Uduhanda tw’abanyamagare n’utwagenewe velomoteri tugenewe kugenderwamo n’abo twagenewe gusa. Kuhahagarara umwanya munini byatuma abo bagenzi bajya mu muhanda w’ibindi binyabiziga, bityo birabujijwe muri utwo duhanda twombi.
explain.en: Cycle tracks and moped tracks are reserved for those riders. Parking on them would force the riders out into the main traffic, so it is prohibited on both.

q.rw: Amatara maremare y’ikinyabiziga agomba kutamurika mu bihe bikurikira:
q.en: A vehicle's main-beam headlights must not be on in the following situations:

options.rw: iyo umuhanda umurikiwe umuyobozi abasha kureba muri m 200
options.en: when the road is lit and the driver can see 200 m ahead
when the vehicle is about to pass an oncoming vehicle
All of the answers are correct

explain.rw: Amatara maremare ahumisha abayobozi baturutse imbere, bityo agomba kuzimwa igihe ugiye kubisikana n’ikindi kinyabiziga, ugacana amatara yo kubisikana. Kuba uri mu nsisiro byonyine si byo bituma uzimya amatara maremare.
explain.en: Main beams dazzle oncoming drivers, so they must be switched off, and dipped headlights used, when you are about to pass an oncoming vehicle. Being in a built-up area is not by itself a reason to switch them off.

q.rw: Uburyo bukoreshwa kugirango ikinyabiziga kigende gahoro igihe feri idakora neza bwitwa:
q.en: The device used to slow a vehicle down when the brakes are not working properly is called:

options.en: None of the answers is correct

explain.rw: Feri yo gutabara ni yo ikoreshwa kugabanya umuvuduko no guhagarika ikinyabiziga igihe feri y’urugendo idakora neza. Feri y’urugendo ni yo ikoreshwa buri gihe mu kugenda, naho feri yo guhagarara ifata ikinyabiziga gihagaze.
explain.en: The emergency brake is used to slow down and stop the vehicle when the service brake fails or works poorly. The service brake is the one used in normal driving, and the parking brake holds a vehicle that is already stationary.

q.rw: Nta mwanya n’umwe feri ifungiraho ushobora kurekurana n’ibiziga keretse:
q.en: No braking surface may be capable of being disconnected from the wheels, except:

options.en: In the case of the service brake
When the disconnection is only momentary

options.rw: iyo bireba feri yo guhagarara umwanya munini, ubwo kurekurana bikaba bidashoboka bidakozwe n'umuyobozi
options.en: In the case of the parking brake, where disconnection is impossible without action by the driver
All of the answers are correct

explain.rw: Muri rusange feri igomba guhora ifatanye n’ibiziga. Amategeko yemera kurekurana gusa ku feri y’urugendo iyo ari ibyakanya gato, no ku feri yo guhagarara umwanya munini iyo kurekurana bidashoboka umuyobozi atabikoze. Ni yo mpamvu ibisubizo byose ari ukuri.
explain.en: As a rule, braked surfaces must stay connected to the wheels. The exceptions are the service brake when the disconnection is only momentary, and the parking brake when it cannot be disconnected without the driver acting, so all the options together describe the exception.

q.rw: Ikinyabiziga ntigishobora kugira amatara arenze abiri y’ubwoko bumwe keretse kubyerekeye amatara akurikira:
q.en: A vehicle may not have more than two lamps of the same type, except for the following lamps:

options.en: All of the answers are correct

explain.rw: Amatara ndangamubyimba, amatara ndangacyerekezo n’amatara ndangaburumbarare ashobora kurenga abiri kuko agomba kwerekana inguni, impande n’uburebure bw’ikinyabiziga. Andi matara y’ubwoko bumwe ntashobora kurenga abiri.
explain.en: Width lamps, direction indicators and side-marker lamps may number more than two because they have to show the vehicle’s corners, sides and length. For other lamp types, no more than two of the same kind are allowed.

q.rw: Itara ndanganyuma rigomba gushyirwa aha hakurikira:
q.en: The rear position lamp (tail lamp) must be fitted:

options.en: At the right-hand corner of the vehicle
On the rear part of the vehicle
Near the left-hand corner of the vehicle
All of the answers are correct

explain.rw: Mu Rwanda ibinyabiziga bigendera iburyo, bityo uruhande rw’ibumoso ni rwo rwegereye hagati y’umuhanda. Itara ndanganyuma rishyirwa ahegereye inguni y’ibumoso kugira ngo abari inyuma n’abashaka kunyuranaho babone neza aho ikinyabiziga kigarukira.
explain.en: In Rwanda traffic keeps to the right, so the left side of a vehicle is the side nearest the centre of the road. The rear position lamp is fitted near the left-hand corner so drivers behind, and those about to overtake, can see where the vehicle’s outline ends.

q.rw: Nibura ikinyabiziga gitegetswe kugira uduhanagurabirahuri dukurikira:
q.en: At minimum, how many windscreen wipers must a vehicle have?

options.en: None of the answers is correct

explain.rw: Ikinyabiziga gitegetswe kugira nibura agahanagurakirahure kamwe gakora neza, kugira ngo umuyobozi abone neza igihe cy’imvura. Gishobora kugira twinshi, ariko itegeko risaba nibura kamwe.
explain.en: A vehicle must have at least one working windscreen wiper so the driver can see clearly in rain. More may be fitted, but the legal minimum is one.

q.rw: Ibiziga by’ibinyabiziga bigendeshwa na moteri n’ibya velomoteri kimwe n’ibya romoruki zabyo bigomba kuba byambaye inziga zihagwa zifite amano n’ubujyakuzimu butari munsi ya milimetero imwe ku migongo yabyo yose, n’ubudodo bwabyo ntibugire ahantu na hamwe bugaragara kandi ntibigire aho byacitse bikomeye mu mpande zabyo. Ariko ibyo ntibikurikizwa ku binyabiziga bikurikira:
q.en: The wheels of motor vehicles and mopeds, and of their trailers, must be fitted with pneumatic tyres whose tread grooves are at least one millimetre deep over the whole tread; the cords must not show anywhere and the sidewalls must have no deep cuts. However, this does not apply to the following vehicles:

options.rw: ibinyabiziga bidapakiye kandi bitajya birenza umuvuduko wa km 25 mu isaha ahateganye
options.en: Unladen vehicles that never exceed 25 km/h on level ground

options.rw: ibinyabiziga bya police bijya ahatarenga km 25 uvuye aho biba
options.en: Police vehicles travelling no more than 25 km from their base

options.rw: A na B ni ibisubizo by’ukuri

options.en: None of the answers is correct

explain.rw: Inziga zihagwa zigomba kugira amano afite ubujyakuzimu bwa nibura milimetero imwe, ubudodo butagaragara kandi nta bice byacitse bikomeye ku mpande. Ibisonewe ni ibinyabiziga bidapakiye kandi bidashobora kurenza km 25 mu isaha ahateganye; ibinyabiziga bya polisi ntibisonewe, ni yo mpamvu B na C atari byo.
explain.en: Pneumatic tyres must have tread grooves at least 1 mm deep, no exposed cords and no deep sidewall cuts. The exemption covers unladen vehicles that cannot exceed 25 km/h on level ground; police vehicles are not exempted, so B and therefore C are wrong.

q.rw: Birabujijwe kugenza ibinyabiziga bigendeshwa na moteri na za romoruki zikururwa nabyo, iyo ibiziga byambaye inziga zidahagwa cyangwa inziga zikururuka zifite umubyimba uri hasi ya cm 4. Ariko ibyo ntibikurikizwa ku binyabiziga bikurikira:
q.en: It is forbidden to drive motor vehicles, and the trailers they tow, whose wheels have non-pneumatic tyres or solid (elastic) tyres less than 4 cm thick. However, this does not apply to the following vehicles:

options.rw: ibinyabiziga bihinga iyo bigendeshwa mu karere katarenga km 25 uvuye aho ziba
options.en: Agricultural vehicles used within 25 km of their base
None of the answers is correct

explain.rw: Inziga zidahagwa cyangwa inziga zikururuka zifite umubyimba uri munsi ya cm 4 zibujijwe ku binyabiziga bigendeshwa na moteri na za romoruki zabyo. Ibisonewe ni ibinyabiziga bihinga iyo bikoreshwa mu karere katarenga km 25 uvuye aho biba; ibinyabiziga by’ingabo n’ibya polisi ntibisonewe.
explain.en: Motor vehicles and their trailers may not run on non-pneumatic tyres or on solid tyres less than 4 cm thick. The exemption is for agricultural vehicles used within 25 km of their base; military and police vehicles are not exempted.

q.rw: Imirongo yera iteganye n’umurongo ugabanya umuhanda mo kabiri mu burebure bwawo ugaragaza:
q.en: White stripes painted parallel to the road’s centre line, along its length, indicate:

options.en: A crossing for bicycles and mopeds
A crossing for handcarts and cycles
None of the answers is correct

explain.rw: Inzira y’abanyamaguru igaragazwa n’imirongo yera migari isizwe mu muhanda, iteganye n’umurongo ugabanya umuhanda mo kabiri. Ahanyurwa n’amagare cyangwa ibinyamitende hagira ibimenyetso byaho byihariye.
explain.en: A pedestrian (zebra) crossing is marked by wide white stripes laid parallel to the centre line, across the carriageway. Crossings for bicycles or other cycles use different markings.

q.rw: Iyo harimo indi myanya birabujijwe gutwara ku ntebe y’imbere y’imodoka abana badafite imyaka ikurikira:
q.en: When other seats are available, it is forbidden to carry children below the following age on the front seat of a car:

options.en: None of the answers is correct

explain.rw: Abana bari munsi y’imyaka 12 ntibemerewe kwicara ku ntebe y’imbere iyo hari indi myanya mu modoka, kuko imyanya y’inyuma ibarinda kurushaho igihe habaye impanuka.
explain.en: Children under 12 must not sit in the front seat when other seats are available, because the rear seats protect them better in a crash.

q.rw: Iyo ikinyabiziga kitagikora cyangwa cyoherejwe mu mahanga burundu ibyapa ndanga bigomba gukurwaho bikoherezwa mu biro by’imisoro, ibyo bikorwa mu gihe kingana gute:
q.en: When a vehicle is permanently taken out of use or exported, its registration plates must be removed and sent to the tax office. Within what period must this be done?

options.en: None of the answers is correct

explain.rw: Iyo ikinyabiziga kitagikora cyangwa cyoherejwe mu mahanga burundu, ibyapa ndanga byacyo bigomba gukurwaho bigasubizwa mu biro by’imisoro mu gihe cy’amezi abiri.
explain.en: When a vehicle is permanently withdrawn from use or exported, its registration plates must be removed and returned to the tax office within two months.

q.rw: Inkombe z’inzira nyabagendwa cyangwa z’umuhanda zishobora kugaragazwa n’ibikoresho ngarurarumuri. Ibyo bikoresho bigomba gushyirwaho ku buryo abagenzi babibona ku buryo bukurikira:
q.en: The edges of a public road or carriageway may be marked with reflective devices. These devices must be placed so that road users see them as follows:

options.rw: babona gusa ibumoso bwabo iby’ibara ryera
options.en: On their left they see only white ones

options.rw: iburyo babona iby’ibara ritukura cyangwa risa n’icunga rihishije gusa
options.en: On their right they see only red or amber ones

options.rw: A na B ni ibisubizo by’ukuri

options.en: None of the answers is correct

explain.rw: Ibikoresho ngarurarumuri byo ku nkombe z’umuhanda bishyirwa ku buryo umugenzi abona iby’ibara ryera gusa ibumoso bwe, n’iby’ibara ritukura cyangwa risa n’icunga rihishije gusa iburyo bwe. Ayo mabara amufasha kumenya nijoro uruhande rw’umuhanda ari ho, bityo A na B byombi ni ukuri.
explain.en: Road-edge reflectors are placed so that road users see only white reflectors on their left and only red or amber reflectors on their right. The colours tell a driver at night which edge of the road is which, so both A and B are correct.

q.rw: Iyo kuyobya umuhanda ari ngombwa bigaragazwa kuva aho uhera no kuburebure bwawo n’icyapa gifite ubuso bw’amabara akurikira:
q.en: When a road diversion is necessary, it is signed from its start and along its length by a sign with a background of the following colour:

options.en: None of the answers is correct

explain.rw: Ibyapa byerekana inzira yo kuyobya umuhanda bifite ubuso bw’ibara ry’ubururu. Kubera ko ubururu butari mu bisubizo byatanzwe (umukara, umweru, umutuku), igisubizo ni “nta gisubizo cy’ukuri kirimo”.
explain.en: Diversion signs have a blue background. Blue is not among the colours offered (black, white, red), so the answer is “None of the answers is correct”.

q.rw: Ku mihanda yagenwe na minisitiri ubifite mu nshingano ibyapa biburira n’ibyapa byerekana bigomba kugaragazwa kuva bwije kugera bukeye n’urumuri rwihariye cyangwa amatara ku mihanda cyangwa ibintu ngarurarumuri. Igihe ijuru rikeye intera y’ahagaragara igomba kuba nibura:
q.en: On roads designated by the competent minister, warning signs and information signs must be made visible from dusk to dawn by special lighting, street lights or reflective materials. In clear weather, the visibility distance must be at least:

options.en: None of the answers is correct

explain.rw: Kuri iyo mihanda, ibyapa biburira n’ibyapa byerekana bigomba kugaragara nijoro bimurikiwe cyangwa bifite ibintu ngarurarumuri. Intera ntoya bigomba kubonekeraho igihe ijuru rikeye yagenwe n’amategeko si m 50, m 120 cyangwa m 150, bityo nta gisubizo cy’ukuri kirimo.
explain.en: On those roads, warning and information signs must stay visible at night through lighting or reflective materials. The minimum clear-weather visibility distance set by the rules is not 50 m, 120 m or 150 m, so none of the answers is correct.

q.rw: Ibizirikisho by’iminyururu cyangwa by’insinga kimwe n’ibindi by’ingoboka bikoreshwa gusa igihe nta kundi umuntu yabigenza kandi nta kindi bigiriwe uretse gusa kugirango ikinyabiziga kigere aho kigomba gukorerwa kandi nturenze na rimwe km 20 mu isaha, ibyo bizirikisho bigaragazwa ku buryo bukurikira:
q.en: Chain or cable couplings and other makeshift couplings may be used only when there is no other way, solely to bring the vehicle to where it is to be repaired, and never at more than 20 km/h. How must such couplings be made visible?

options.en: A red cloth 50 cm from the road surface

options.rw: icyapa cyera cya mpande enye zingana gifite cm 30 kuri buri ruhande
options.en: A white square plate measuring 30 cm on each side
None of the answers is correct

explain.rw: Ibizirikisho by’ingoboka bikoreshwa gusa kugeza ikinyabiziga cyapfuye aho gikorerwa, umuvuduko utarenze km 20 mu isaha. Bigomba kugaragazwa n’icyapa cyera cya mpande enye zingana gifite cm 30 kuri buri ruhande, kugira ngo abandi bakoresha umuhanda bamenye ko ibinyabiziga bibiri biziritse.
explain.en: Makeshift tow links are allowed only to bring a broken-down vehicle to a repair place, at no more than 20 km/h. They must be made visible with a white square plate measuring 30 cm on each side, so other road users can see that the two vehicles are linked.

q.rw: Uretse mu mijyi, ku yindi mihanda yagenywe na minisiteri ushinzwe gutwara ibintu n’abantu, uburemere ntarengwa bwemewe ku binyabiziga bifatanye bifite imitambiko itatu ni:
q.en: Except in towns, on other roads designated by the ministry responsible for transport, the maximum authorised weight for coupled (combined) vehicles with three axles is:

options.en: None of the answers is correct

explain.rw: Hanze y’imijyi, ku mihanda yagenwe na minisiteri, ibinyabiziga bifatanye bifite imitambiko itatu ntibigomba kurenza uburemere bwa toni 12. Toni 16 ni uburemere bugenewe ibinyabiziga bifite imitambiko itatu cyangwa irenga bitari makuzungu.
explain.en: Outside towns, on the roads designated by the ministry, coupled vehicles with three axles may not exceed 12 tonnes. The 16-tonne figure applies to non-articulated vehicles with three or more axles.

q.rw: Uretse mu mujyi ku yindi mihanda yajyenwe na minisitiri ushinzwe gutwara abantu n’ibintu, uburemere ntarengwa ku binyabiziga bifite imitambiko itatu cyangwa irenga hatarimo mukuzungu ni:
q.en: Except in towns, on other roads designated by the minister responsible for transport, the maximum weight for vehicles with three or more axles, excluding articulated vehicles, is:

options.en: None of the answers is correct

explain.rw: Ku binyabiziga bifite imitambiko itatu cyangwa irenga bitari makuzungu, uburemere ntarengwa ni toni 16 (toni 12 ni iz’ibinyabiziga bifatanye bifite imitambiko itatu). Kubera ko toni 16 zitari mu bisubizo, nta gisubizo cy’ukuri kirimo.
explain.en: For non-articulated vehicles with three or more axles the limit is 16 tonnes (12 tonnes is the figure for three-axle coupled vehicles). Since 16 tonnes is not offered, none of the answers is correct.
