q.rw: Iyo nta mategeko awugabanya by’umwihariko umuvuduko ntarengwa ku modoka zidafite ibizibuza kwiceka kuberako ariko zakozwe ni:
q.en: Unless specific rules set a lower limit, the maximum speed for vehicles that, by their construction, have no suspension is:

explain.rw: Imodoka zidafite ibizibuza kwiceka kubera uko zakozwe ntizishobora kugenda vuba zitekanye, ni yo mpamvu umuvuduko wazo ntarengwa ari km 25 mu isaha, keretse amategeko yihariye awugabanyije kurushaho.
explain.en: Vehicles built without suspension cannot travel safely at speed, so their maximum speed is 25 km/h unless specific rules set a lower limit.

q.rw: Iyo nta mategeko awugabanya by’umwihariko umuvuduko ntarengwa ku modoka zidafite ibizibuza kwiceka kuberako ariko zakozwe ni:
q.en: Unless specific rules set a lower limit, the maximum speed for vehicles that, by their construction, have no suspension is:

options.en: None of the answers is correct

explain.rw: Umuvuduko ntarengwa w’imodoka zidafite ibizibuza kwiceka kubera uko zakozwe ni km 25 mu isaha. Kubera ko km 25 zitari mu bisubizo byatanzwe, nta gisubizo cy’ukuri kirimo.
explain.en: The maximum speed for vehicles built without suspension is 25 km/h. Since 25 km/h is not offered here, none of the answers is correct.

q.rw: Ikinyabiziga kibujijwe guhagarara akanya kanini aha hakurikira:
q.en: Parking a vehicle is prohibited at the following place:

options.rw: imbere y’ahantu nyabagendwa hinjirwa n’ahasohokerwa n’abantu benshi
options.en: In front of public entrances and exits used by large numbers of people

options.rw: mu muhanda aho ugabanyijemo ibisate bigaragazwa n’imirongo icagaguye
options.en: On a road divided into lanes marked by broken lines

options.rw: A na B ni ibisubizo by’ukuri

options.en: None of the answers is correct

explain.rw: Birabujijwe guhagarara akanya kanini imbere y’aho abantu benshi binjirira n’aho basohokera, kuko byababuza kugenda neza kandi bigateza akaga. Imirongo icagaguye yonyine ntibuza guhagarara; ahabujijwe ni aho ibisate bigaragazwa n’imirongo idacagaguye.
explain.en: Parking is prohibited in front of entrances and exits used by many people, because it obstructs them and creates danger. Broken lane lines do not by themselves ban parking; the ban applies where lanes are marked by continuous lines.

q.rw: Iyo kuva bwije kugeza bukeye cyangwa bitewe n’uko ibihe bimeze nk’igihe cy’ibihu cyangwa cy’imvura bitagishoboka kubona neza muri m 200, udutsiko twose tw’abanyamaguru nk’imperekerane cyangwa udutsiko tw’abanyeshuri bari ku murongo bayobowe n’umwarimu, iyo bagenda mu muhanda ku isonga hakaba hari abantu barenze umwe bagomba kugaragazwa kuburyo bukurikira:
q.en: From dusk to dawn, or whenever fog or rain makes it impossible to see clearly within 200 m, every group of pedestrians, such as processions or lines of pupils led by a teacher, walking on the road with more than one person at the front, must be made visible as follows:

options.rw: imbere ni itara ry’umuhondo ritwariwe ibumoso
options.en: At the front, a yellow light carried on the left

options.rw: inyuma ni itara ry’umutuku ritwariwe ibumoso n’umuntu uri ku murongo w’inyuma hafi y’umurongo ugabanya umuhanda mo kabiri
options.en: At the rear, a red light carried on the left by the person in the last row nearest the centre line of the road

options.rw: A na B ni ibisubizo by’ukuri

options.en: None of the answers is correct

explain.rw: Udutsiko tw’abanyamaguru tugaragazwa n’itara ryera imbere n’itara ry’umutuku inyuma, atwarwa ku ruhande rw’ibumoso n’abantu bari ku murongo w’imbere n’uw’inyuma hafi y’umurongo ugabanya umuhanda mo kabiri. Igisubizo A si cyo kuko imbere hakoreshwa itara ryera, si iry’umuhondo.
explain.en: Pedestrian groups are shown by a white light at the front and a red light at the rear, carried on the left by people in the front and last rows nearest the centre line. A is wrong because the front light must be white, not yellow.

q.rw: Imburira zimurika zemerewe gukoreshwa kugirango bamenyeshe umuyobozi ko bagiye kumunyuraho aha hakurikira:
q.en: Flashing light warnings may be used to let a driver know you are about to overtake them:

options.en: In built-up areas or anywhere else
None of the answers is correct

explain.rw: Imburira zimurika zishobora gukoreshwa mu nsisiro no hanze yayo kugira ngo umuyobozi uri imbere amenye ko ugiye kumunyuraho. Ntizigarukira hafi y’inyamaswa zikurura cyangwa amatungo; aho ho ugomba kwitonda kugira ngo utabikanga.
explain.en: Flashing headlight warnings may be used both inside and outside built-up areas to tell the driver ahead that you are about to overtake. They are not limited to places near draught animals or livestock, where you must take care not to startle them.

q.rw: Ibinyabiziga bifite ubugari bufite ibipimo bikurikira bigomba kugira amatara ndangaburumbarare:
q.en: Vehicles of the following width must be fitted with side-marker lamps:

options.en: None of the answers is correct

explain.rw: Igipimo cy’ubugari gisaba ko ikinyabiziga kigira amatara ndangaburumbarare ni metero 2 na cm 10. Kubera ko icyo gipimo kitari mu bisubizo byatanzwe, nta gisubizo cy’ukuri kirimo.
explain.en: The width threshold for requiring side-marker lamps is 2.10 m. That value is not offered, so none of the answers is correct.

q.rw: Nta tara na rimwe cyangwa akagarurarumuri bishobora kuba bifunze kuburyo igice cyabyo cyo hasi cyane kimurika kiba kiri hasi y’ibipimo bikurikira kuva ku butaka igihe ikinyabiziga kidapakiye:
q.en: No lamp or reflector may be mounted so that the lowest part of its illuminating surface is below the following height above the ground when the vehicle is unladen:

options.en: None of the answers is correct

explain.rw: Igice cyo hasi cyane kimurika cy’amatara n’utugarurarumuri ntikigomba kuba munsi ya cm 40 uvuye ku butaka igihe ikinyabiziga kidapakiye (amatara kamena-bihu n’ayo gusubira inyuma ni yo asonewe). Kubera ko cm 40 zitari mu bisubizo, nta gisubizo cy’ukuri kirimo.
explain.en: The lowest illuminating part of lamps and reflectors must be at least 40 cm above the ground on an unladen vehicle (fog lamps and reversing lamps are exempt). As 40 cm is not offered, none of the answers is correct.

q.rw: Ahari hejuru cyane y’ubuso bumurika h’amatara ndangambere na ndanganyuma ntihashobora kuba aharenze ibipimo bikurikira hejuru y’ubutaka iyo ikinyabiziga kidapakiye:
q.en: The highest point of the illuminating surface of front and rear position lamps may not be higher than the following above the ground when the vehicle is unladen:

options.en: None of the answers is correct

explain.rw: Ahari hejuru cyane y’ubuso bumurika h’amatara ndangambere na ndanganyuma ntihagomba kurenga metero 1 na cm 90 uvuye ku butaka. Icyo gipimo ntikiri mu bisubizo, bityo nta gisubizo cy’ukuri kirimo.
explain.en: The top of the illuminating surface of front and rear position lamps must be no more than 1.90 m above the ground. That value is not offered, so none of the answers is correct.

q.rw: Buri modoka cyangwa buri romoruki ikuruwe n’iyo modoka bishobora kugira itara risa n’icyatsi kibisi bituma umuyobozi yerekana ko yabonye ikimenyetso cy’uwitegura kumunyuraho. Iryo tara rigomba gushyirwa aha hakurikira:
q.en: Every motor vehicle, or trailer towed by it, may have a green lamp that the driver uses to show they have seen the signal of someone preparing to overtake. Where must this lamp be fitted?

options.en: Near the left-hand corner of the vehicle
At the rear, near the left-hand edge of the vehicle
At the rear, near the right-hand corner
None of the answers is correct

explain.rw: Iryo tara ry’icyatsi kibisi rigenewe umuyobozi uri inyuma ushaka kunyuranaho. Kubera ko kunyuranaho bikorerwa ibumoso, rishyirwa inyuma hafi y’impera y’ibumoso bw’ikinyabiziga kugira ngo uwo muyobozi aribone neza. Igisubizo A ntikivuga ko riri inyuma.
explain.en: This green lamp is meant for the driver behind who wants to overtake. Since overtaking is done on the left, it is fitted at the rear near the left-hand edge, where that driver can see it. Option A does not say it is at the rear.

q.rw: Ubugari bw’imizigo yikorewe n’ipikipiki ifite akanyabiziga ko kuruhande kimwe n’ubwa romoruki ikuruwe na bene icyo kinyabiziga ntibushobora kurenza ibipimo bikurikira ku bugari bw’icyo kinyabiziga kidapakiye:
q.en: The width of the load carried by a motorcycle with a sidecar, and of a trailer towed by such a vehicle, may not exceed the unladen width of that vehicle by more than:

options.en: None of the answers is correct

explain.rw: Ku ipikipiki ifite akanyabiziga ko ku ruhande, imizigo cyangwa romoruki ntibishobora kurenza ubugari bw’icyo kinyabiziga kidapakiye ho cm 30. Igipimo cya m 1.25 ni icy’ubugari bw’imizigo ku ipikipiki idafite akanyabiziga ko ku ruhande.
explain.en: For a motorcycle with a sidecar, the load or trailer may not be more than 30 cm wider than the unladen vehicle. The 1.25 m figure is the load-width limit for a motorcycle without a sidecar.

q.rw: Mu gihe telefone yawe ihamagawe utwaye imodoka wakora iki?
q.en: Your phone rings while you are driving. What should you do?

options.en: Pull over to the side of the road and then answer it

options.rw: B na C ni ibisubizo by’ukuri

explain.rw: Kuvugira kuri telefone utwaye birakurangaza kandi biteza impanuka. Niba ugomba kwitaba, banza ushyire imodoka ku ruhande ahantu hatekanye kandi hemewe, uhagarare, hanyuma witabe. Guhagarara ako kanya mu muhanda nabyo ni bibi kuko bishobora guteza impanuka.
explain.en: Using a phone while driving is distracting and causes crashes. If you need to answer, first pull over and stop somewhere safe and legal, then take the call. Stopping abruptly in the road is also dangerous.

q.rw: Niki wakora mbere y’uko uhindura icyerekezo?
q.en: What should you do before changing direction?

options.rw: Gutanga ikimenyetso cy’ukuboko no gukoresha amatara ndangacyerekezo.
options.en: Give an arm signal and use your direction indicators.

options.rw: Itegereze neza niba icyapa kikwemerera guhindura icyerekezo.
options.en: Check carefully that the signs allow you to change direction.
None of the answers is correct

explain.rw: Mbere yo guhindura icyerekezo ugomba kumenyesha abandi bakoresha umuhanda icyo ugiye gukora ukoresheje amatara ndangacyerekezo n’ikimenyetso cy’ukuboko, kandi ukareba niba ibyapa bikwemerera guhindura icyerekezo aho. Ni yo mpamvu A na B byombi ari ukuri.
explain.en: Before changing direction you must tell other road users what you intend to do, using your direction indicators and an arm signal, and check that the signs allow the turn there. Both A and B are therefore correct.

q.rw: Niki muribi wakwirinda mugihe ushaka kunyuranaho?
q.en: Which of these should you avoid when you want to overtake?

options.rw: Nyuma y’ikona ugategereza kubona uburyo bwo kunyuranaho.
options.en: Just after a bend, while waiting for a chance to overtake.

options.rw: Aho utagomba kurenza ibirometero 30 mu isaha.
options.en: Where you must not exceed 30 km/h.
On reaching a stretch of road that is not level

explain.rw: Ntukanyuranaho ako kanya nyuma y’ikorosi (ikona) utarabona neza umuhanda uri imbere, kuko hashobora kuza ikinyabiziga giturutse imbere utakibonye. Banza ubone intera ihagije kandi itekanye mbere yo kunyuranaho.
explain.en: Don’t overtake immediately after a bend before you can see the road ahead clearly, because an oncoming vehicle may appear that you could not see. Wait until you have a long, clear and safe view before overtaking.

q.rw: Niki wakora mugihe usanze mu bimenyetso bimurika harimo ibara ry’umuhondo?
q.en: What should you do when the traffic light shows amber (yellow)?

explain.rw: Itara ry’umuhondo risobanura ko itara ry’umutuku rigiye kwaka: ugomba kwitegura guhagarara ku murongo wo guhagarara, keretse ugeze hafi cyane ku buryo guhagarara byateza impanuka. Kongera umuvuduko cyangwa gufata feri cyane bitunguranye byombi biteza akaga.
explain.en: Amber means the light is about to turn red, so prepare to stop at the stop line unless you are so close that stopping would cause a crash. Speeding up and braking harshly are both dangerous.

q.rw: Mugihe ukurikiranye na romoruki, n’ukubera iki ugomba gusiga umwanya uhagije hagati yawe nayo?
q.en: When following a trailer (a large vehicle), why should you leave enough space between you and it?

options.en: So you can take bends faster.

options.rw: Bifasha umuyobozi wa romoruki kukurebera mundorerwamo.
options.en: It helps the trailer’s driver see you in their mirrors.
It helps the trailer stop more easily.
It shelters you from the wind.

explain.rw: Iyo wegereye cyane ikinyabiziga kinini cyangwa romoruki, umuyobozi wacyo ntashobora kukubona mu ndorerwamo ze. Gusiga umwanya uhagije bituma akubona, kandi nawe ukabona neza umuhanda uri imbere.
explain.en: If you follow a large vehicle or trailer too closely, its driver cannot see you in their mirrors. Keeping well back lets the driver see you and also gives you a better view of the road ahead.

q.rw: Utegereje gukata iburyo kw’iherezo ry’umuhanda. Ukingirijwe n’imodoka ihagaze. Niki wakora?
q.en: You are waiting to turn right at the end of a road. Your view is blocked by a parked vehicle. What should you do?

options.rw: Guhagarara hanyuma ukagenda gake gake witonze kugezaho ureba neza.
options.en: Stop, then move forward slowly and carefully until you can see clearly.

options.rw: Kwihuta wegera imbere aho ushobora kureba ugafunga ikindi cyerekezo.
options.en: Move forward quickly to where you can see, blocking the other direction.

options.rw: Gutegereza abanyamaguru bakakumenyesha ko ntakibazo wakata.
options.en: Wait for pedestrians to tell you it is safe to turn.

options.rw: Guhindukiza imodoka vuba kugirango ushake indi nzira wakoresha.
options.en: Quickly turn the car round and find another route.

explain.rw: Iyo utabona neza mu masangano, hagarara, hanyuma wigire imbere gake gake witonze kugeza ubonye neza ibinyabiziga biza mu mpande zombi. Kwihuta ujya imbere bishobora gufunga inzira y’abandi cyangwa guteza impanuka, kandi ntugomba kwishingikiriza ku banyamaguru.
explain.en: When your view at a junction is blocked, stop and then creep forward slowly and carefully until you can see traffic in both directions. Rushing forward can block other traffic or cause a crash, and you should not rely on pedestrians to tell you it is safe.

q.rw: Mugihe uri murugendo rurerure mumuhanda urombereje w’ibice byinshi. Niki wakora mugihe wumva utangiye kugira ibitotsi?
q.en: You are on a long journey on a motorway. What should you do if you start to feel sleepy?

options.rw: Kwihuta cyane kugirango usoze urugendo vuba.
options.en: Drive faster to finish the journey sooner.

options.rw: Kuva mumuhanda urombereje w’ibice byinshi, ugahagarara ahantu hatekanye.
options.en: Leave the motorway and stop somewhere safe.
None of the answers is correct

explain.rw: Ibitotsi bigabanya ubushobozi bwo kwitondera umuhanda kandi bishobora gutuma usinzira utwaye. Igikwiye ni ukuva mu muhanda urombereje w’ibice byinshi ugahagarara ahantu hatekanye ukaruhuka; umuziki mwinshi cyangwa kwihuta ntibikuraho umunaniro.
explain.en: Drowsiness reduces your attention and can make you fall asleep at the wheel. The right response is to leave the motorway and stop somewhere safe to rest; loud music or driving faster does not cure tiredness.

q.rw: Kuki ugomba gucana amatara mugihe hatangiye kwijima?
q.en: Why should you switch on your lights when it starts to get dark?

options.en: So the speedometer can be seen clearly.
So that others can see you more easily.

options.rw: Kugira ngo ujyane n’abandi bayobozi b’ibinyabiziga.
options.en: To do the same as other drivers.

options.rw: Kuko amatara yo ku muhanda ari kwaka
options.en: Because the street lights are on

explain.rw: Iyo hatangiye kwijima, gucana amatara bituma abandi bakoresha umuhanda bakubona hakiri kare, kandi nawe ukabona neza. Ntibigamije gukurikiza abandi cyangwa kubona neza akerekanamuvuduko.
explain.en: As light fades, switching on your lights helps other road users see you in good time and helps you see. It is not about copying other drivers or lighting the speedometer.

q.rw: Urimo kugenda munzira nyabagendwa ni gute wanyura k’umuyobozi w’igare?
q.en: You are driving on a public road. How should you overtake a cyclist?

options.en: Sound your horn as you pass
Leave plenty of room as you pass

explain.rw: Umuyobozi w’igare ashobora kunyeganyega cyangwa guhunga umwobo mu muhanda bitunguranye, bityo ugomba gusiga umwanya uhagije hagati yawe na we igihe umunyuraho. Kuvuza ihoni bishobora kumukanga, kandi kumwegera cyane biteza akaga.
explain.en: A cyclist may wobble or swerve suddenly, for example around a pothole, so give them plenty of room as you pass. Sounding the horn can startle them, and passing close is dangerous.

q.rw: Niki wakora igihe utabona neza usubira inyuma?
q.en: What should you do if you cannot see clearly when reversing?

options.en: Wind down the window and look back
Open the door and look back

options.rw: Gushaka umuntu uri hanze y’ikinyabiziga ukuyobora
options.en: Get someone outside the vehicle to guide you

explain.rw: Iyo utabona neza inyuma, shaka umuntu uri hanze y’ikinyabiziga akuyobore, kuko we abona ahantu wowe utabona. Gufungura umuryango ugenda ni bibi, kandi indorerwamo yonyine ntigaragaza ahantu hose hihishe.
explain.en: If you cannot see properly behind, get someone outside the vehicle to guide you, as they can see the blind spots you cannot. Opening the door while moving is dangerous, and a mirror alone cannot show every hidden area.

q.rw: Igihe ukurikiwe n’ikinyabiziga gitwara abarwayi gicanye amatara y’intabaza arabagirana. Wakora iki?
q.en: An ambulance with flashing emergency lights is behind you. What should you do?

options.rw: Kugihigamira ako kanya ndetse byaba ngombwa ugahagarara
options.en: Move aside for it at once, and stop if necessary
Speed up to get away from it

explain.rw: Ibinyabiziga by’ubutabazi bicanye amatara y’intabaza bifite uburenganzira bwo gutambuka mbere. Ugomba kubiha inzira ako kanya wegera ku ruhande, ndetse ugahagarara bibaye ngombwa, ariko ukirinda guhagarara bitunguranye kuko byateza impanuka.
explain.en: Emergency vehicles using flashing warning lights have priority. Move aside to let it through straight away, stopping if needed, but avoid stopping suddenly in the road, which could cause a crash.

q.rw: Wifuza kugana ibumoso imbere yawe. Kubera iki ushaka umwanya mwiza kandi uhagije?
q.en: You intend to turn left ahead. Why should you take up the correct position in good time?

options.en: To allow other drivers to pass you

options.rw: Kugirango ubone neza ikindi kerekezo ushaka gufata
options.en: To get a clear view of the road you want to turn into

options.rw: Kugirango ufashe abandi bose bakoresha umuhanda icyo ushaka gukora
options.en: To help all other road users know what you intend to do

options.rw: Kwemerera abandi bayobozi b’ibinyabiziga kukunyura muruhande rw’ibumoso
options.en: To allow other drivers to overtake you on the left

explain.rw: Kwegera umwanya ukwiye hakiri kare (hafi y’umurongo ugabanya umuhanda mo kabiri iyo ugiye gukata ibumoso) bifasha abandi bakoresha umuhanda kumenya icyo ugiye gukora, bakitegura. Ntibigamije kwemerera abandi kukunyuraho.
explain.en: Moving into the correct position early (towards the centre line when turning left) shows all other road users what you intend to do, so they can react. It is not done to let others pass or overtake you.

q.rw: Utwaye ikinyabiziga inyuma ya romoruki. Umuyobozi wayo akaguha ikimenyetso cyo kumutambukaho iburyo kandi ugana ibumoso, wakora iki?
q.en: You are driving behind a trailer. Its driver signals you to pass him on the right, but you intend to go left. What should you do?

options.en: Slow down and let it go on

options.rw: Kugumana umuvuduko wari ufite ukamuvugiriza ihoni
options.en: Keep your speed and sound your horn at it

explain.rw: Ntukanyuranaho ukurikije gusa ikimenyetso uhawe n’undi muyobozi; ni wowe ugomba kwemeza ko bitekanye. Kubera ko ugana ibumoso, kandi ikinyabiziga gikurura romoruki gikeneye umwanya, gabanya umuvuduko ukireke kigende, hanyuma ukomeze urugendo rwawe utekanye.
explain.en: Never overtake just because another driver waves you on; you are responsible for judging whether it is safe. As you intend to go left and a vehicle with a trailer needs room, slow down, let it go on, then continue safely.

q.rw: Wegereye inzira y’abanyamaguru ugasanga bategereje kwambuka. Ugomba gukora iki?
q.en: You are approaching a pedestrian crossing and people are waiting to cross. What should you do?

options.rw: Kureka abakuze n’abafite ubumuga bagatambuka mbere
options.en: Let the elderly and disabled people cross first
Slow down and be ready to stop
Flash your lights to tell them to cross
Use hand signals to wave them across

explain.rw: Wegereye inzira y’abanyamaguru hari abategereje kwambuka, gabanya umuvuduko witegure guhagarara kugira ngo bambuke batekanye. Ntukabamenyeshe kwambuka ukoresheje amatara cyangwa amaboko, kuko bashobora kwambuka batabonye ibindi binyabiziga biza.
explain.en: When people are waiting at a pedestrian crossing, slow down and be ready to stop so they can cross safely. Don’t flash your lights or wave them across, because they might step out in front of other traffic.

q.rw: Uri hafi kunyura k’umuyobozi w’ikinyamitende. Muri ibi byapa bikurikira nikihe wakwitondera?
q.en: You are about to overtake a cyclist. Which of these signs should make you take particular care?

options.rw: Icyapa kiburira umuyaga mwinshi uturuka mu ruhande
Icyapa kibuza guhagarara akanya gato n’akanya kanini

explain.rw: Igisubizo cyemewe ni icyapa cyerekana inzira y’icyerekezo kimwe. Mu nzira y’icyerekezo kimwe ibinyabiziga bishobora kugenda mu bisate birenze kimwe, bityo mbere yo kunyura ku muyobozi w’ikinyamitende ugomba kwitonda, ukareba neza impande zose kandi ugasiga umwanya uhagije.
explain.en: The official answer is the one-way road sign. On a one-way road traffic may use more than one lane, so before passing a cyclist there you must check all around you carefully and leave plenty of room.

q.rw: Kumanywa urumuri rudahagije hatabona neza. Ni ayahe matara y’urugendo ugomba gukoresha?
q.en: In daytime, when the light is poor and visibility is low, which lights should you drive with?

explain.rw: Igisubizo cyemewe ni amatara kamena-bihu y’imbere: iyo kumanywa hatabona neza kubera ibihu cyangwa imvura nyinshi, amatara kamena-bihu y’imbere amurikira umuhanda hafi y’ubutaka kandi atuma abandi bakubona. Amatara kamena-bihu y’inyuma yonyine ntamurikira umuhanda uri imbere.
explain.en: The official answer is front fog lamps: when daytime visibility is poor because of fog or heavy rain, front fog lamps light the road close to the ground and make you visible. Rear fog lamps alone do not light the road ahead.

q.rw: Niyihe mpamvu ituma tugomba kugabanya umuvuduko mugihe hari ibihu?
q.en: Why should you reduce your speed when there is fog?

options.en: In case you are dazzled by dipped headlights
Because of the time the engine takes to stop

options.rw: Nuko biba bitoroshye kubona ikiri imbere
options.en: Because it is harder to see what is ahead

explain.rw: Mu bihu ntubasha kubona kure ibiri imbere nk’ibinyabiziga, abanyamaguru cyangwa inzitizi. Kugabanya umuvuduko bituma ushobora guhagarara mu ntera ubasha kubona.
explain.en: In fog you cannot see far ahead, so hazards appear late. Slowing down lets you stop within the distance you can see.

q.rw: Niki ugomba gukora igihe uhagaze ku muhanda igihe cy’ibihu?
q.en: What should you do when you are stopped on the road in fog?

options.rw: Kureka amatara yo kubisikana na kamena-bihu akaguma yaka
options.en: Leave your dipped headlights and fog lamps on

options.rw: Kureka amatara yo kubisikana akaguma yaka

explain.rw: Iyo uhagaze ku muhanda mu bihu, siga amatara ndanga yaka kugira ngo abandi babone aho ikinyabiziga cyawe kiri n’ubunini bwacyo. Amatara yo kubisikana, kamena-bihu n’ay’urugendo ni ayo kugenda; ashobora guhuma abandi no gutuma bibwira ko ikinyabiziga kigenda.
explain.en: When stopped on the road in fog, leave your position lamps (sidelights) on so others can see where your vehicle is and how big it is. Dipped, fog and main-beam lights are for driving; they can dazzle others and make them think you are moving.

q.rw: Iki cyapa cyivuga iki?
q.en: What does this sign mean?

options.en: End of the compulsory minimum speed.
End of the minimum speed requirement

explain.rw: Icyapa cy’uruziga cy’ubururu kiriho umubare cyerekana umuvuduko muke utegetswe; iyo gisibishijwe n’umurongo utukura, kiba cyerekana iherezo ry’uwo muvuduko muke utegetswe (km 30 mu isaha). Umuvuduko ntarengwa wo ugaragazwa n’icyapa cy’uruziga cyera gifite umuzenguruko utukura.
explain.en: A round blue sign with a number sets a compulsory minimum speed; crossed by a red diagonal bar it marks the end of that minimum speed (30 km/h). A maximum speed limit is shown on a white disc with a red border.

sign.rw: Iherezo ry’umuvuduko muke utegetswe (km 30 mu isaha)

q.rw: Icyapa gikurikira kivuze iki?
q.en: What does the following sign mean?

explain.rw: Icyapa cy’uruziga gifite ubuso bw’ubururu, umuzenguruko utukura n’umurongo umwe utukura ugicamo kibuza guhagarara umwanya munini. Iyo gifite imirongo ibiri itukura ikoze X, kiba kibuza no guhagarara akanya gato.
explain.en: A round sign with a blue background, a red border and a single red diagonal bar means no parking. With two red bars forming an X it also bans stopping.

q.rw: Inzira nyabagendwa ifite ibyerekezo bibiri, uruhande rw’ibumoso rudufasha iki?
q.en: On a two-way public road, what may the left-hand half of the road be used for?

options.en: Only for overtaking, without returning to your right
Only fast vehicles may use it
Only for turning right, without overtaking

explain.rw: Mu Rwanda tugendera iburyo bw’umuhanda. Mu muhanda w’ibyerekezo bibiri ufite umurongo wera ucagaguye hagati, uruhande rw’ibumoso rukoreshwa gusa iyo unyuranaho cyangwa ukatira ibumoso, kandi iyo urangije ugomba gusubira iburyo bwawe.
explain.en: In Rwanda we drive on the right. On a two-way road with a broken white centre line, the left half may be used only to overtake or to turn left, and you must return to the right afterwards.

sign.rw: Umurongo wera ucagaguye ugabanya umuhanda mo kabiri

q.rw: Ni hehe byemewe kunyuranaho munzira y’icyerekezo kimwe?
q.en: Where may you overtake on a one-way road?

options.en: In the left-hand lane of the road

options.rw: Ku gisate kiri iburyo bw’umuhanda gusa

options.en: In either the left or the right lane

explain.rw: Mu Rwanda kunyuranaho bikorerwa ibumoso bw’ikinyabiziga unyuraho. Igisubizo cyemewe kigaragaza ko no mu nzira y’icyerekezo kimwe ugomba gukoresha igisate kiri ibumoso bw’umuhanda.
explain.en: In Rwanda overtaking is done on the left of the vehicle being overtaken. The official answer applies this to one-way roads too: overtake using the left-hand lane.

q.rw: N’uwuhe muntu ushobora gusimbura ibimenyetso byo mumuhanda, dutegetswe kubaha?
q.en: Who can take the place of traffic signs and signals, and must be obeyed?

explain.rw: Umukozi ubifitiye ububasha, nk’umupolisi ushinzwe umutekano wo mu muhanda, ashobora gutanga amabwiriza asimbura ibimenyetso bimurika n’ibyapa, kandi abakoresha umuhanda bose bategetswe kuyubahiriza.
explain.en: An authorised official, such as a traffic police officer, can give directions that take precedence over traffic lights and signs, and all road users must obey them.

q.rw: Iki cyapa gisobanura iki?
q.en: What does this sign mean?

options.rw: Iherezo ry’ibibuzwa byose mu karere ku binyabiziga bigenda
options.en: End of all local prohibitions for moving vehicles
None of the answers is correct

explain.rw: Icyapa cy’uruziga cyera kirimo umurongo w’umukara uberamye kimenyesha iherezo ry’ibibuzwa byose byari byashyizweho ku binyabiziga bigenda, nko kubuzwa kunyuranaho cyangwa umuvuduko ntarengwa. Ntaho gihuriye no kubuza guhagarara; icyo ni icyapa cy’ubururu gifite umuzenguruko utukura.
explain.en: A white disc crossed by a black diagonal band marks the end of all local prohibitions previously imposed on moving vehicles, such as a no-overtaking ban or a speed limit. It has nothing to do with stopping: no-stopping signs are blue with a red border.

q.rw: Ibyapa bitegeka bikozwe mu yihe shusho?
q.en: What shape are mandatory signs?

options.en: Rectangle with a pointed, arrow-like end

explain.rw: Ibyapa bitegeka bikozwe mu ishusho y’uruziga; akenshi ni iby’ubururu birimo ikimenyetso cyera. Mpandeshatu ikoreshwa ku byapa biburira ibyago, naho urukiramende n’icyapa gisongoye nk’umwambi bikoreshwa ku byapa bitanga amakuru cyangwa byerekana icyerekezo.
explain.en: Mandatory signs are circular, usually blue with a white symbol. Triangles are used for danger warning signs, while rectangles and arrow-shaped plates are used for information and direction signs.

q.rw: Ni ikihe cyapa cyerekana ko nta kinyabiziga gifite moteri cyemerewe kuhanyura?
q.en: Which sign shows that no motor vehicle is allowed to go through?

options.rw: Icyapa cy’ubururu gifite umuzenguruko n’umusaraba bitukura
options.en: Blue sign with a red border and a red X

options.rw: Icyapa cy’uruziga gifite umuzenguruko utukura kirimo ipikipiki n’imodoka
options.en: Red-bordered circle showing a motorcycle and a car

options.rw: Icyapa cy’uruziga cyera kirimo umurongo w’umukara uberamye
options.en: White disc with a black diagonal band

options.rw: Icyapa cy’uruziga gifite umuzenguruko utukura kirimo imodoka itukura n’iy’umukara
options.en: Red-bordered circle showing a red car and a black car

explain.rw: Icyapa cy’uruziga gifite umuzenguruko utukura kirimo ipikipiki n’imodoka kibuza ibinyabiziga byose bifite moteri kuhanyura. Icyapa cy’ubururu gifite umusaraba utukura kibuza guhagarara, icyera gifite umurongo w’umukara kimenyesha iherezo ry’ibibuzwa, naho icy’imodoka ebyiri kibuza kunyuranaho.
explain.en: The red-bordered circle showing a motorcycle and a car closes the road to all motor vehicles. The blue sign with a red X bans stopping and parking, the white disc with a black band ends prohibitions, and the sign with two cars bans overtaking.

q.rw: Iki cyapa gisobanura iki?
q.en: What does this sign mean?

explain.rw: Icyapa cy’uruziga gifite umuzenguruko utukura kirimo imodoka itukura iruhande rw’iy’umukara gisobanura ko birabujijwe kunyuranaho. Uburenganzira bwo gutambuka mbere bwo bwerekanwa n’icyapa cy’umuhondo gifite ishusho ya mpande enye zihagaze ku isonga.
explain.en: A red-bordered circle showing a red car beside a black car means no overtaking. Priority (right of way) is shown by a different sign, the yellow diamond.

q.rw: Imbere yawe, iki cyapa kikubwiye iki?
q.en: What is this sign ahead of you telling you?

options.rw: Guhagarara umwanya munini n’umwanya muto ntibyemewe
options.en: Parking and stopping are not allowed

explain.rw: Icyapa cy’ubururu gifite umuzenguruko n’umusaraba bitukura kibuza guhagarara akanya gato n’akanya kanini aho gishyizwe. Icyapa nk’icyo gifite umurongo umwe utukura uberamye cyo kibuza guhagarara umwanya munini gusa.
explain.en: A blue sign with a red border and a red X prohibits both stopping and parking where it applies. A similar sign with a single red diagonal bar prohibits parking only.

sign.rw: Birabujijwe guhagarara akanya gato n’akanya kanini

q.rw: Iki cyapa gisobanura iki?
q.en: What does this sign mean?

explain.rw: Mpandeshatu irimo imyambi itatu ikoze uruziga iburira ko imbere hari aho banyura bazenguruka. Gabanya umuvuduko kandi witegure kwinjira muri ako gace witonze.
explain.en: A warning triangle with three arrows forming a circle warns of a roundabout ahead. Slow down and get ready to enter it carefully.

q.rw: Iki cyapa gisobanura iki?
q.en: What does this sign mean?

explain.rw: Mpandeshatu irimo umurongo ufite ibibyimba iburira ko imbere umuhanda utaringaniye, ufite ibibyimba cyangwa ibinogo. Gabanya umuvuduko kugira ngo ikinyabiziga gikomeze kuyoborwa neza kandi ntikangirike.
explain.en: A warning triangle showing a bumpy line warns that the road ahead is uneven, with bumps or dips. Slow down so the vehicle stays under control and is not damaged.

q.rw: Iki cyapa gisobanura iki?
q.en: What does this sign mean?

explain.rw: Mpandeshatu irimo umufuka uhuhwa n’umuyaga iburira ko imbere hashobora kuba umuyaga ukomeye uturuka ku ruhande. Fata neza ikiyobora kandi ugabanye umuvuduko, cyane cyane niba ikinyabiziga cyawe ari kirekire cyangwa cyoroshye.
explain.en: A warning triangle showing a windsock warns of strong side winds ahead. Hold the steering firmly and slow down, especially in a high-sided or light vehicle.

q.rw: Iki cyapa gisobanura iki?
q.en: What does this sign mean?

options.rw: A na B ni ibisubizo by’ukuri

explain.rw: Icyapa cy’ubururu kirimo ishusho y’umuhanda urombereje w’ibisate byinshi, kiriho umurongo utukura uberamye, kimenyesha iherezo ry’uwo muhanda. Kuva aho, amategeko yihariye y’umuhanda urombereje ntaba agikurikizwa.
explain.en: The blue motorway symbol crossed by a red diagonal bar marks the end of the motorway. From that point the special motorway rules no longer apply.

q.rw: Iki cyapa gisobanura iki?
q.en: What does this sign mean?

explain.rw: Mpandeshatu irimo imirongo ibiri yegerana iburira ko umuhanda ugiye gufungana ku mpande zombi. Gabanya umuvuduko kandi witegure kubisikana n’ibinyabiziga biturutse imbere ahantu hafunganye.
explain.en: A warning triangle with two lines drawing closer warns that the road narrows on both sides. Slow down and be ready to meet oncoming traffic in the narrower space.

q.rw: Iki cyapa gisobanura iki?
q.en: What does this sign mean?

options.en: None of the answers is correct

explain.rw: Icyapa cy’ubururu kirimo umurongo wera uhagaze ufite umutwe utukura kimenyesha ko imbere ari inzira idakomeza. Si isangano rifite ishusho ya T; iryo riburirwa n’icyapa cya mpandeshatu.
explain.en: The blue sign with a white upright bar topped by a red bar means a dead end: the road ahead has no through route. It is not a T-junction warning, which would be a red-bordered triangle.

q.rw: Iki cyapa gisobanura iki?
q.en: What does this sign mean?

explain.rw: Mpandeshatu irimo umunyamaguru wambuka ku mirongo y’abanyamaguru iburira ko wegereye aho abanyamaguru bambukira. Gabanya umuvuduko kandi witegure guhagarara ureke abanyamaguru bambuke. Kubuza abanyamaguru byo byerekanwa n’icyapa cy’uruziga gifite umuzenguruko utukura.
explain.en: A warning triangle showing a person on a zebra crossing warns that you are approaching a pedestrian crossing. Slow down and be ready to stop for people crossing. A ban on pedestrians would be a red-bordered circle instead.

q.rw: Wakora iki ubonye iki cyapa?
q.en: What would you do when you see this sign?

options.en: Stop only when vehicles are approaching
Stop even if you see no vehicles

options.rw: Guhagarara gusa niba hari abana bategereje kwambuka
options.en: Stop only if children are waiting to cross

options.rw: Guhagarara gusa igihe ikimenyetso cyaka ari umutuku
options.en: Stop only when the traffic light is red

explain.rw: Icyapa STOP gitegeka guhagarara burundu ku murongo wo guhagarara cyangwa ku nkombe y’isangano igihe cyose, n’iyo nta kinyabiziga ubona. Nyuma yo guhagarara, utanga inzira ku binyabiziga byose biri mu muhanda winjiramo.
explain.en: A STOP sign requires a complete stop at the stop line or the edge of the junction every time, even if no other traffic is in sight. After stopping, give way to all traffic on the road you are entering.

q.rw: Iki cyapa gisobanura iki?
q.en: What does this sign mean?

options.rw: Uguhinguka ku mwaro cyangwa ku nkombe cyangwa ahegereye icyome
options.en: Road leading onto a quay, shore or river bank

options.rw: Inzira nyabagendwa iri ku musozi ucuramye
options.en: Public road on a steep hillside

explain.rw: Mpandeshatu irimo imodoka igwa mu mazi iburira ko umuhanda ugana ku mwaro, ku nkombe cyangwa ahegereye icyome, aho ikinyabiziga gishobora kugwa mu mazi. Gabanya umuvuduko kandi witonde.
explain.en: A warning triangle showing a car dropping into water warns that the road leads onto a quay or river bank, where a vehicle could go into the water. Slow down and take great care.

q.rw: Iki cyapa gisobanura iki?
q.en: What does this sign mean?

explain.rw: Icyapa cy’uruziga gifite umuzenguruko utukura kirimo ipikipiki kibuza amapikipiki kuhanyura. Ibinyabiziga bitagaragara kuri icyo cyapa ntibibujijwe nacyo.
explain.en: A red-bordered circle showing a motorcycle closes the road to motorcycles. Vehicles not shown on the sign are not affected by it.

q.rw: Icyapa gitanga uburenganzira bwo gutambuka mbere kigira iyihe shusho?
q.en: What shape is the sign that requires you to give way (give others priority)?

options.en: Inverted triangle with a red border

explain.rw: Icyapa gitegeka gutanga uburenganzira bwo gutambuka mbere ni mpandeshatu icuramye, isonga ireba hasi, ifite umuzenguruko utukura. Mpandeshatu ireba hejuru ni iy’ibyapa biburira, naho icyapa cy’impande umunani (STOP) gitegeka guhagarara burundu mbere yo gutanga inzira.
explain.en: The give-way sign is an inverted triangle (point down) with a red border. An upright triangle is a warning sign, and the octagon is the STOP sign, which requires a full stop before giving way.

q.rw: Iki cyapa gisobanura iki?
q.en: What does this sign mean?

options.rw: Ahegereye amasangano y’inzira nyabagendwa n’inzira ya gari ya moshi ibambiye
options.en: Approaching a level crossing with barriers
Road without barriers and not closed

explain.rw: Mpandeshatu irimo uruzitiro iburira ko wegereye aho inzira nyabagendwa ihurira n’inzira ya gari ya moshi ibambiye, ni ukuvuga ifite ibikingira bifunga inzira. Gabanya umuvuduko kandi witegure guhagarara igihe ibyo bikingira bifunze cyangwa birimo gufunga.
explain.en: A warning triangle showing a gate warns of a level crossing with barriers ahead. Slow down and be ready to stop when the barriers are down or closing.

sign.rw: Ahegereye amasangano n’inzira ya gari ya moshi ibambiye

q.rw: Iki cyapa gisobanura iki?
q.en: What does this sign mean?

explain.rw: Mpandeshatu irimo ubutaka bumanuka n’umubare 10% iburira ko imbere hari agacuri gahanamye kateza ibyago. Gabanya umuvuduko mbere yo kumanuka kandi ukoreshe vitesi nto kugira ngo feri zidashyuha cyane. Icyapa cy’akazamuko gahanamye cyo kigaragaza ubutaka buzamuka.
explain.en: A warning triangle showing a slope marked 10% warns of a steep, dangerous descent. Slow down before going down and use a low gear so the brakes do not overheat. A steep-ascent sign shows the slope rising instead.

q.rw: Iki cyapa gisobanura iki?
q.en: What does this sign mean?

options.rw: Guhindura icyerekezo ibumoso ugana aho bahagarara
options.en: Turn left towards a parking area

options.rw: Guhindura icyerekezo ibumoso ugana ku cyome

explain.rw: Iki cyapa cy’ubururu cyerekana ko umuhanda uhinguka ibumoso ari umuhanda udakomeza, naho umuhanda munini ukomeza. Ntikibuza guhindura icyerekezo kandi ntikigaragaza aho bahagarara.
explain.en: This blue sign shows that the side road branching off to the left is a dead end (no through road), while the main road continues. It does not ban turning, nor does it indicate parking.

sign.en: No through road on the side road to the left

q.rw: Mu bimenyetso bimurika, itara ritukura rivuga iki?
q.en: What does a red traffic light mean?

options.rw: Hagarara keretse niba ushaka gukata ibumoso
options.en: Stop unless you want to turn left

options.rw: Hagarara niba ubona nta byago byaguteza
options.en: Stop if you see that doing so poses no danger
You must not go past the signal

options.rw: Wemerewe kugenda niba aho asohokera mu masangano y’umuhanda hafunze
options.en: You may go if the exit of the intersection is blocked

explain.rw: Itara ritukura risobanura ko birabujijwe kurenga icyo kimenyetso cyangwa umurongo wo guhagarara wacyo. Ugomba guhagarara ugategereza itara ry’icyatsi, uko icyerekezo ushaka kujyamo cyaba kimeze kose.
explain.en: A red light means you must not go past the signal or its stop line. You must stop and wait for the green light, whichever direction you want to go.

q.rw: Mu bimenyetso bimurika, itara ry’umuhondo risobanura iki?
q.en: What does an amber (yellow) traffic light mean?

options.rw: Birabujijwe gutambuka umurongo wo guhagarara umwanya muto cyangwa, igihe uwo murongo udahari, icyo kimenyetso ubwacyo
options.en: You must not cross the stop line or, where there is no stop line, the signal itself

options.rw: A na B ni ibisubizo by’ukuri

options.en: None of the answers is correct

explain.rw: Itara ry’umuhondo risobanura ko birabujijwe kurenga umurongo wo guhagarara, cyangwa ikimenyetso ubwacyo iyo uwo murongo udahari. Umuyobozi wenyine wemerewe gukomeza ni uri hafi cyane ku buryo atabasha guhagarara mu mutekano. Ntirisobanura “itegure kugenda”.
explain.en: An amber light means you must not cross the stop line, or the signal itself if there is no line. Only a driver already so close that they cannot stop safely may continue. It does not mean 'get ready to go'.

q.rw: Mu bimenyetso bimurika, itara ry’icyatsi risobanura iki?
q.en: What does a green traffic light mean?

options.en: Permission to go past the signal

options.rw: Hagarara niba inzira isohoka mu isangano ry’imihanda ifunze
options.en: Stop if the exit road from the intersection is blocked
None of the answers is correct

explain.rw: Itara ry’icyatsi risobanura ko uhawe uburenganzira bwo kurenga icyo kimenyetso. Ntirisobanura “kwitegura kugenda”; naho kwirinda kwinjira mu isangano igihe aho usohokera hafunze ni ubwitonzi busanzwe bukurikizwa mu isangano iryo ari ryo ryose, si byo itara ry’icyatsi risobanura.
explain.en: A green light means you have permission to go past the signal. It does not mean 'get ready to go', and not entering a junction whose exit is blocked is a general precaution that applies at any junction, not the meaning of the green light.

q.rw: Umurongo wera ucagaguye mu muhanda usobanura iki?
q.en: What does a broken white line on the road mean?

explain.rw: Igisubizo cyemewe muri iki gitabo cy’ibibazo ni “Birabujijwe kuwurenga”. Menya ariko ko mu mategeko asanzwe umurongo wera ucagaguye ushobora kurengwa, urugero kunyuranaho cyangwa guhindura igisate cy’umuhanda, iyo nta byago bihari; umurongo wera udacagaguye ni wo utemewe kurengwa.
explain.en: The official answer in this question bank is 'It must not be crossed'. Be aware that under standard road rules a broken white line may be crossed, for example to overtake or change lanes, when it is safe; it is the continuous white line that must not be crossed.

q.rw: Iki cyapa gisobanura iki?
q.en: What does this sign mean?

options.en: None of the answers is correct

explain.rw: Mpandeshatu irimo imyambi ibiri ireba mu byerekezo bitandukanye iburira ko imbere ari umuhanda ubisikanirwamo, ni ukuvuga ko ibinyabiziga bigenda mu byerekezo byombi. Gumana iburyo kandi witegure guhura n’ibinyabiziga biturutse imbere.
explain.en: A warning triangle with two opposing arrows warns of two-way traffic ahead: vehicles travel in both directions. Keep to the right and expect oncoming vehicles.

q.rw: Iki cyapa gisobanura iki?
q.en: What does this sign mean?

options.en: A service area is 30 metres away.

options.rw: Umuvuduko munini ntarengwa utegetswe ni 30 km/h.
options.en: The compulsory maximum speed is 30 km/h.

options.rw: Umuvuduko muto ntarengwa utegetswe ni 30 km/h.
options.en: The compulsory minimum speed is 30 km/h.

options.rw: Aho ibinyabiziga bihagarara ni imbere mu birometero 30.
options.en: The place where vehicles stop is 30 kilometres ahead.

explain.rw: Icyapa cy’uruziga cy’ubururu ni icyapa gitegeka; umubare uriho werekana umuvuduko muto ntarengwa ugomba kugenderaho, hano ni 30 km/h. Umuvuduko munini ntarengwa werekanwa n’icyapa cy’uruziga cyera gifite umuzenguruko utukura.
explain.en: A blue circular sign is mandatory; the number on it is the minimum speed you must keep, here 30 km/h. A maximum speed limit is shown on a white circle with a red border.

q.rw: Iki cyapa gisobanura iki?
q.en: What does this sign mean?

options.en: Approaching a danger not otherwise specified.

explain.rw: Mpandeshatu irimo akamenyetso (!) iburira icyago kidasobanuye ukundi, ni ukuvuga icyago kitagira icyapa cyacyo cyihariye. Akenshi gishyirwaho akandi kapapuro gasobanura icyo cyago; gabanya umuvuduko kandi witonde.
explain.en: A warning triangle with an exclamation mark warns of a danger not covered by any specific sign ('other danger'). A plate beneath it may describe the hazard; slow down and take care.

q.rw: Iki cyapa gisobanura iki?
q.en: What does this sign mean?

options.rw: Imbere hari inzira ya gari ya moshi.
Ahegereye amasangano y’inzira nyabagendwa n’inzira ya gari ya moshi hatabambiye
options.en: Approaching a level crossing without barriers

explain.rw: Mpandeshatu irimo gari ya moshi iburira ko wegereye aho inzira nyabagendwa ihurira n’inzira ya gari ya moshi hatabambiye, ni ukuvuga nta bikingira bifunga inzira. Gabanya umuvuduko, urebe neza impande zombi mbere yo kwambuka. Ahabambiye herekanwa n’icyapa kirimo uruzitiro.
explain.en: A warning triangle showing a locomotive warns of a level crossing without barriers ahead. Slow down and look carefully both ways before crossing. A crossing with barriers is shown by a sign with a gate symbol instead.

sign.rw: Ahegereye amasangano n’inzira ya gari ya moshi itabambiye

q.rw: Muri iri sangano ry’umuhanda hari icyapa gisobanura “guhagarara” n’umurongo wera urombereje mu nzira. Ni iyihe mpamvu hari iki cyapa cyo “guhagarara” hano?
q.en: At this junction there is a STOP sign and a continuous white line across the road. Why is there a STOP sign here?

options.rw: Biragoye kubona neza mu muhanda munini
options.en: It is hard to see properly into the main road
The speed limit on the main road has been lifted

options.rw: Ni mu isangano ry’umuhanda rikoreshwa cyane
options.en: It is a very busy junction
There are lines warning of sudden dangers

explain.rw: Icyapa STOP n’umurongo wera udacagaguye bishyirwa ahantu umuyobozi atabasha kubona neza ibinyabiziga biri mu muhanda munini atabanje guhagarara. Niyo mpamvu ategekwa guhagarara burundu, akareba neza, hanyuma agatanga inzira.
explain.en: A STOP sign with a continuous stop line is placed where drivers cannot see properly into the main road without stopping first. That is why you must stop completely, look carefully and then give way.

q.rw: Ni iki gikenewe muri ibi bikurikira kugira ngo ubashe gutwara imodoka mu muhanda biteganywa n’itegeko?
q.en: Which of the following do you need in order to drive a car on the road as the law requires?

options.rw: Uruhushya rwa burundu rwo gutwara ibinyabiziga rugifite agaciro

explain.rw: Kugira ngo utware imodoka mu muhanda mu buryo bwemewe n’itegeko, ukenera uruhushya rwo gutwara ibinyabiziga rugifite agaciro, ubwishingizi bw’ikinyabiziga bugifite agaciro n’icyemezo cy’iyandikwa ry’ikinyabiziga. Kubura kimwe muri ibyo ni ikosa, ni yo mpamvu ibisubizo byose ari ukuri.
explain.en: To drive a car on the road legally you need a valid driving licence, valid vehicle insurance and the vehicle registration certificate. Missing any one of them is an offence, which is why all the answers are correct.

q.rw: Ikinyabiziga gishya gikenerwa gusuzumwa bwa mbere nyuma y’igihe kingana iki?
q.en: After how long does a new vehicle need its first technical inspection?

options.rw: A na B ni ibisubizo by’ukuri

options.en: None of the answers is correct

explain.rw: Nk’uko igisubizo cyemewe kibivuga, ikinyabiziga gishya gisuzumwa bwa mbere nyuma y’imyaka ibiri. Nyuma yaho, kigomba gukomeza gusuzumwa mu bihe biteganywa n’itegeko.
explain.en: According to the official answer, a new vehicle has its first technical inspection after two years. After that it must keep being inspected at the intervals set by law.

q.rw: Ni ryari ushobora kwakiriza icyarimwe amatara yose ndangacyerekezo y’ikinyabiziga?
q.en: When may you switch on all of a vehicle's direction indicators at the same time?

options.rw: Mu gihe ushaka kuburira abandi bakoresha umuhanda
options.en: When you want to warn other road users

options.rw: Mu gihe ikinyabiziga cyawe gishobora guteza ibyago
options.en: When your vehicle may be a danger to others

options.rw: A na B ni ibisubizo by’ukuri

options.en: None of the answers is correct

explain.rw: Kwakiriza icyarimwe amatara yose ndangacyerekezo (amatara yo kuburira) bikorwa kugira ngo uburire abandi bakoresha umuhanda iyo ikinyabiziga cyawe gishobora guteza ibyago, urugero iyo cyapfiriye mu muhanda cyangwa gihagaze ahantu hateje ibyago. Ni yo mpamvu A na B byombi ari ukuri.
explain.en: Switching on all the direction indicators together (hazard warning lights) warns other road users when your vehicle may be a danger, for example when it has broken down or is stopped in a dangerous place. Both A and B describe this use, so 'A and B' is correct.

q.rw: Ugeze ahabereye impanuka yo mu muhanda bwa mbere ugasanga abakomeretse bikomeye. Wakiriza icyarimwe amatara y’ibyerekezo byombi; ni iki kindi ushobora gukora?
q.en: You are the first to arrive at the scene of a road crash and find people seriously injured. You switch on your hazard warning lights. What else can you do?

options.en: Make sure an ambulance has been called

options.rw: Guhagarika ibinyabiziga bindi no kubasaba ubufasha
options.en: Stop other vehicles and ask them for help

options.rw: A na B ni ibisubizo by’ukuri

options.en: None of the answers is correct

explain.rw: Iyo ugeze bwa mbere ahabereye impanuka hari abakomeretse bikomeye, icy’ingenzi ni ukwizera ko imbangukiragutabara n’inzego z’ubutabazi byahamagawe. Guhagarika ibinyabiziga mu muhanda ubisaba ubufasha bishobora guteza indi mpanuka, ni yo mpamvu atari cyo gisubizo cyemewe.
explain.en: When you are first at a crash with seriously injured people, the priority is to make sure an ambulance and the emergency services have been called. Stopping other vehicles in the road to ask for help can cause another collision, which is why it is not the official answer.

q.rw: Umuyobozi w’ikinyabiziga cyikoreye ibintu bishobora gufata inkongi, ni ikihe cyapa cyerekana ko ibyo atwaye biturika byafata inkongi?
q.en: A driver's vehicle is carrying goods that can catch fire. Which plate shows that the load is explosive or flammable?

options.rw: Icyapa cy’icunga kiriho imibare (2YE, 1089) n’ikimenyetso gitukura cya mpande enye
options.en: Orange plate with codes (2YE, 1089) and a red diamond label
Red warning triangle with an exclamation mark

options.rw: Icyapa kirambuye cya mpandeshatu gifite imirongo itukura n’iyera
options.en: Long triangular plate with red and white stripes

explain.rw: Ibinyabiziga bitwaye ibintu biteje ibyago, nk’ibishobora gufata inkongi cyangwa guturika, bishyirwaho icyapa cy’icunga kiriho imibare iranga ibyo bintu, hamwe n’ikimenyetso cya mpande enye kigaragaza ubwoko bw’icyago (urugero ikirimi cy’umuriro). “LONG VEHICLE” yerekana ikinyabiziga kirekire, naho mpandeshatu irimo (!) ni icyapa cyo ku muhanda kiburira icyago kidasobanuye ukundi.
explain.en: Vehicles carrying dangerous goods, such as flammable or explosive loads, display an orange plate with identification numbers together with a diamond-shaped label showing the type of hazard (for example a flame). 'LONG VEHICLE' marks a long vehicle, and the triangle with '!' is a road sign for other dangers.

q.rw: Wakoze impanuka yo mu muhanda, ni ikihe cyangombwa polisi ishobora kugusaba kucyerekana?
q.en: You have been involved in a road accident. Which document can the police ask you to show?

options.rw: Uruhushya rwa burundu rwo gutwara ikinyabiziga

explain.rw: Iyo wakoze impanuka, polisi ishobora kugusaba kwerekana uruhushya rwa burundu rwo gutwara ikinyabiziga kugira ngo yemeze ko wemerewe gutwara. Uruhushya rw’agateganyo ni urwo kwigiraho gutwara, naho “imikorere y’ikinyabiziga” si icyangombwa.
explain.en: After an accident, the police can ask you to show your full driving licence to check that you are entitled to drive. A provisional licence is only for learning to drive, and 'the vehicle's working condition' is not a document.

q.rw: Uhuye n’ingorane utwaye ikinyabiziga mu muhanda ufite ibyerekezo bibiri, ufite ikimenyetso kiburira cya mpandeshatu. Wagishyira mu ntera ingana iki uvuye aho ikinyabiziga cyahagaze?
q.en: Your vehicle breaks down on a two-way road and you have a warning triangle. How far from the stopped vehicle should you place it?

explain.rw: Nk’uko igisubizo cyemewe kibivuga, iyo ikinyabiziga cyagize ingorane kigahagarara mu muhanda w’ibyerekezo bibiri, ikimenyetso kiburira cya mpandeshatu gishyirwa mu ntera ya metero 25 uvuye aho cyahagaze, kugira ngo abandi bayobozi bakibone kare bagabanye umuvuduko. Metero 5 ni hafi cyane ku buryo abandi batabona umwanya wo kwitegura.
explain.en: According to the official answer, when your vehicle breaks down and stops on a two-way road you place the warning triangle 25 metres from it, so approaching drivers see it in time to slow down. At 5 metres it would be too close to give them a proper warning.

q.rw: Umuyobozi usunika ipikipiki agomba gufatwa nka:
q.en: A person pushing a motorcycle must be regarded as:

options.rw: A na B ni ibisubizo by’ukuri

explain.rw: Nk’uko igisubizo cyemewe kibivuga, umuntu usunika ipikipiki afatwa nk’umuyobozi w’ikinyabiziga, ntafatwa nk’umunyamaguru cyangwa umugenzi. Bityo agomba kubahiriza amategeko agenga abayobozi b’ibinyabiziga.
explain.en: According to the official answer, a person pushing a motorcycle is treated as the driver of a vehicle, not as a pedestrian or a passenger. They must therefore follow the rules that apply to drivers.

q.rw: Icyapa gikoze mu ishusho ya mpandeshatu kimenyesha:
q.en: A triangular sign indicates:

options.en: None of the answers is correct

explain.rw: Ibyapa bikozwe mu ishusho ya mpandeshatu bifite umuzenguruko utukura ni ibyapa biburira ibyago biri imbere. Ibibujijwe n’ibitegetswe byo byerekanwa n’ibyapa by’uruziga.
explain.en: Triangular signs with a red border warn of a danger ahead. Prohibitions and obligations are shown on circular signs.

q.rw: Iki cyapa gisobanura:
q.en: This sign means:

options.rw: Uburenganzira bwo gutambuka mbere mu yandi masangano y’umuhanda akwegereye
options.en: Priority at the other intersections you are approaching

options.rw: Ibyago imbere mu masangano y’umuhanda ukwegereye
A na B ni ibisubizo by’ukuri

explain.rw: Icyapa cy’umuhondo gifite ishusho ya mpande enye zihagaze ku isonga n’umuzenguruko wera gisobanura uburenganzira bwo gutambuka mbere ku muhanda ugenderamo, kugeza ku cyapa kimenyesha iherezo ryabwo. Igisubizo cyemewe ni “uburenganzira bwo gutambuka mbere” gusa; uburenganzira bwo gutambuka mbere mu isangano rikurikira bwo bumenyeshwa n’icyapa cya mpandeshatu, kandi iki cyapa ntikiburira ibyago.
explain.en: The yellow diamond with a white border is the priority sign: you have right of way on the road you are on until a sign ends it. The official answer is simply 'priority'; priority at the next intersection alone is announced by a triangular warning sign, and this sign does not warn of danger.

sign.rw: Umuhanda ufite uburenganzira bwo gutambuka mbere

q.rw: Iki cyapa gisobanura:
q.en: This sign means:

options.rw: B na C ni ibisubizo by’ukuri

explain.rw: Icyapa cy’uruziga gifite umuzenguruko utukura kirimo umunyamaguru kibuza abanyamaguru kuhanyura. Akayira k’abanyamaguru kerekanwa n’icyapa cy’ubururu gitegeka, naho aho abanyamaguru bambukira herekanwa n’ibindi byapa.
explain.en: A red-bordered circle showing a pedestrian means no pedestrians. A footpath is shown by a blue mandatory sign, and pedestrian crossings by other signs.

q.rw: Urenze mu nsisiro, ukahasanga ibyapa bibiri iburyo bwawe bimenyesha ko irangira ry’imirimo. Bitewe n’icyo ibyo byapa bimenyesha, wagendera ku wuhe muvuduko?
q.en: Having left the built-up area, you find two signs on your right showing the end of road works. Given what these signs indicate, at what speed may you drive?

explain.rw: Icyapa cyera gifite umurongo w’umukara uberamye gikuraho ibibuzwa byose byari byashyizweho, harimo n’umuvuduko wa 30 km/h wari washyizweho kubera imirimo. Kubera ko uri ahatari mu nsisiro, wongera kugendera ku muvuduko ntarengwa usanzwe w’aho hantu; igisubizo cyemewe ni 80 km/h.
explain.en: The white disc with a black diagonal band cancels all earlier restrictions, including the 30 km/h limit set for the road works. Since you are outside a built-up area, the normal open-road limit applies again, which the official answer gives as 80 km/h.

sign.en: End of all prohibitions and end of road works

q.rw: Iki cyapa gisobanura iki?
q.en: What does this sign mean?

options.rw: B na C ni ibisubizo by’ukuri

explain.rw: Icyapa cy’ubururu kirimo inyuguti H yera kimenyesha ko hafi aho hari ibitaro. Hafi y’ibitaro, gabanya umuvuduko kandi wirinde urusaku nko kuvuza ihoni bitari ngombwa.
explain.en: A blue information sign with a white letter H indicates a hospital nearby. Near a hospital, drive slowly and avoid noise such as unnecessary use of the horn.

q.rw: Igice cy’inzira nyabagendwa gikikijwe n’imirongo ibiri y’umweru iciyemo uduce kandi iteganye:
q.en: A part of the public road bounded by two parallel broken white lines is:

options.en: An area for parking and stopping

options.rw: A na B ni ibisubizo by’ukuri

explain.rw: Igice cy’inzira nyabagendwa kigaragazwa n’imirongo ibiri yera icagaguye kandi iteganye ni inzira yagenewe ibinyamitende. Abandi bayobozi ntibagomba kuyigendamo cyangwa kuyihagararamo.
explain.en: A strip of the road bounded by two parallel broken white lines is a lane reserved for cycles. Other vehicles must not drive or park in it.

sign.en: Cycle lane (two parallel broken white lines)

q.rw: Iki cyapa kibuza abayobozi b’ibinyabiziga kunyuranaho:
q.en: This sign prohibits drivers from overtaking:

options.en: On the right and on the left
None of the answers is correct

explain.rw: Mu Rwanda ibinyabiziga bigendera iburyo, bityo kunyuranaho bikorwa unyuze ibumoso. Ni yo mpamvu icyapa kibuza kunyuranaho kibuza kunyura ibumoso ku bindi binyabiziga, uretse ibinyamitende ibiri n’amapikipiki adafite akanyabiziga ko ku ruhande.
explain.en: In Rwanda traffic keeps to the right, so overtaking is done on the left. The no-overtaking sign therefore forbids overtaking other vehicles on the left, except two-wheeled cycles and motorcycles without a sidecar.

q.rw: Iki cyapa kibuza kunyuranaho ibumoso ku binyabiziga bikurikira:
q.en: This sign prohibits overtaking on the left of the following vehicles:

options.rw: Ku binyabiziga byose uretse ibinyamitende ibiri n’amapikipiki adafite akanyabiziga ko ku ruhande
options.en: All vehicles except two-wheeled cycles and motorcycles without a sidecar
None of the answers is correct

explain.rw: Icyapa kibuza kunyuranaho kibuza kunyura ibumoso ku binyabiziga byose, uretse ibinyamitende ibiri n’amapikipiki adafite akanyabiziga ko ku ruhande. Ibyo byo bishobora kunyurwaho, ariko witonze kandi usize intera ihagije ku ruhande.
explain.en: The no-overtaking sign forbids overtaking on the left of any vehicle except two-wheeled cycles and motorcycles without a sidecar. Those may still be overtaken, carefully and with enough side clearance.

q.rw: Iki kimenyetso cyaka kinyemerera gukomeza?
q.en: Does this light allow me to continue?

options.rw: Yego, ariko utanga inzira ku banyamaguru
options.en: Yes, but give way to pedestrians

options.rw: Yego, utanga inzira ku bandi bayobozi b’ibinyabiziga baturutse mu kindi cyerekezo
options.en: Yes, giving way to other drivers coming from another direction

explain.rw: Itara ritukura ribuza kurenga icyo kimenyetso; ntiwemerewe gukomeza, n’iyo waba witeguye gutanga inzira ku banyamaguru cyangwa ku bandi bayobozi. Ugomba guhagarara ugategereza itara ry’icyatsi.
explain.en: A red light forbids going past the signal; you may not continue, even if you are ready to give way to pedestrians or other drivers. You must stop and wait for green.

q.rw: Mu muhanda ufite uruhererekane rw’amakoni, feri y’urugendo ikoreshwa ryari?
q.en: On a road with a series of bends, when should the service brake be used?

options.en: None of the answers is correct

explain.rw: Mu muhanda ufite amakoni akurikiranye, feri y’urugendo ikoreshwa mbere ya buri koni, igihe ikinyabiziga kikigenda kigororotse, kugira ngo winjire mu ikoni ufite umuvuduko ukwiye. Gufata feri cyane uri mu ikoni bishobora gutuma ikinyabiziga kinyerera cyangwa kikava mu nzira yacyo.
explain.en: On a road with a series of bends, use the service brake before each bend, while the vehicle is still travelling straight, so you enter the bend at a suitable speed. Braking hard in the bend can make the vehicle skid or run wide.

sign.en: Double bend / series of bends ahead

q.rw: Ni ikihe cyapa muri ibi kintegeka gutanga inzira?
q.en: Which of these signs requires me to give way?

options.en: None of the answers is correct

explain.rw: Icyapa B5 (uruziga rufite umuzenguruko utukura, umwambi utukura ureba imbere n’umwambi w’umukara ureba inyuma) gitegeka gutanga inzira ku binyabiziga biturutse imbere ahantu hafunganye. B6 (urukiramende rw’ubururu) cyo kiguha uburenganzira bwo gutambuka mbere y’ibiturutse imbere, naho A19 kiburira umuhanda ubisikanirwamo.
explain.en: Sign B5 (red-bordered circle with a red arrow pointing up and a black arrow pointing down) means give way to oncoming traffic at a narrow section. B6 (blue square) gives you priority over oncoming traffic, and A19 warns of two-way traffic.

q.rw: Iki cyapa gisobanura:
q.en: This sign means:

options.en: Loose chippings thrown up on the road

options.rw: A na B ni ibisubizo by’ukuri

explain.rw: Mpandeshatu irimo imodoka itera utubuye iburira ko mu muhanda hari utubuye dushobora gutaruka iyo ibinyabiziga bihanyuze. Gabanya umuvuduko kandi usige intera ihagije hagati yawe n’ikinyabiziga kikuri imbere kugira ngo utubuye tutakwangiriza, urugero ikirahure cy’imbere.
explain.en: A warning triangle showing a car throwing up stones warns of loose chippings that passing vehicles can throw up. Slow down and keep a good distance from the vehicle in front to avoid damage, for example to your windscreen.

q.rw: Uri umuyobozi wa velomoteri, uhuye n’umwe mu nshuti zawe agusaba ko wamutwara ukamusiga ku wundi muhanda. Ufite imyaka 18 ariko nta ngofero yindi yabigenewe ufite. Wamutwara?
q.en: You are riding a moped and meet a friend who asks you for a lift to another road. You are 18, but you do not have a second approved helmet. Would you carry them?

options.en: Yes, except on a long trip
Yes, except on a short trip

explain.rw: Umuntu wese uri kuri velomoteri cyangwa ipikipiki, harimo n’umugenzi, agomba kwambara ingofero yabigenewe. Niba nta ngofero ya kabiri ufite, ntiwemerewe gutwara inshuti yawe, uko urugendo rwaba rureshya kose.
explain.en: Everyone riding a moped or motorcycle, including the passenger, must wear an approved helmet. Without a second helmet you may not carry your friend, however short or long the trip.

q.rw: Ni ikihe cyapa kinyemerera gutambuka mbere mu masangano y’umuhanda?
q.en: Which sign gives me priority at intersections?

explain.rw: Icyapa B3 (cy’umuhondo gifite ishusho ya mpande enye zihagaze ku isonga) kimenyesha umuhanda ufite uburenganzira bwo gutambuka mbere, bityo ugatambuka mbere mu masangano ari kuri uwo muhanda kugeza ku cyapa kimenyesha iherezo ryabwo. A22a ni icyapa kiburira isangano rimwe rikurikira, naho A20 kiburira isangano aho ugomba gutanga inzira ku biturutse iburyo, bityo “ibisubizo byose ni ukuri” si cyo.
explain.en: Sign B3 (yellow diamond) marks a priority road, so you pass first at the intersections along it until the end-of-priority sign. A22a is a warning sign for the one intersection just ahead, and A20 warns of a crossroads where you must give way to traffic from the right, so 'all the answers are correct' is wrong.

q.rw: Mbere yo kunyura ku muyobozi w’ikinyabiziga cy’imitende ibiri, ngomba gucana akarangacyerekezo k’ibumoso?
q.en: Before overtaking the rider of a two-wheeled vehicle, must I switch on my left direction indicator?

options.en: Yes, when a vehicle is following me

options.rw: Yego, iyo nkurikiwe n’ibindi binyabiziga by’imitende ibiri
options.en: Yes, if other two-wheelers are following me

options.rw: Oya, nta na rimwe kunyura ku binyabiziga by’imitende ibiri

explain.rw: Mbere yo kunyura ku kinyabiziga icyo ari cyo cyose, harimo n’icy’imitende ibiri, ugomba buri gihe gucana akarangacyerekezo k’ibumoso kugira ngo uri imbere n’abagukurikiye bamenye icyo ugiye gukora. Abayobozi b’ibinyabiziga by’imitende ibiri bashobora guhungabana byoroshye, bityo ugomba no gusiga intera ihagije ku ruhande.
explain.en: Before overtaking any vehicle, including a two-wheeler, always switch on the left indicator so the rider ahead and the traffic behind know what you are about to do. Two-wheeler riders are easily unsettled, so also leave plenty of side clearance.

q.rw: Nshobora kunyuraho umuyobozi w’ikinyabiziga wahagaze imbere y’inzira yabanyamaguru?
q.en: May I overtake a driver who has stopped in front of a pedestrian crossing?

options.rw: yego mu gihe nkurikiwe n’ibindi binyabiziga
options.en: Yes, if other vehicles are following me

explain.rw: Ikinyabiziga gihagaze imbere y’inzira y’abanyamaguru akenshi kiba kireka abanyamaguru bambuka, kandi kikaba kibahisha. Kukinyuraho byatuma ugonga umunyamaguru utabonaga, niyo mpamvu bibujijwe; nawe ugomba guhagarara.
explain.en: A vehicle stopped in front of a pedestrian crossing is usually letting pedestrians cross, and it hides them from your view. Overtaking it could make you hit a pedestrian you cannot see, so it is forbidden; you must stop as well. Sounding the horn or being followed by other traffic changes nothing.

q.rw: Hejuru y’aka kanunga:
q.en: On top of this hump (shown by the sign):

options.rw: Nshobora kunyura ku kinyabiziga icyo aricyose mu gihe nagabanyije umuvuduko
options.en: I may overtake any vehicle provided I have reduced my speed

options.rw: nshobora kunyura gusa kubinyabiziga by’imitende ibiri
options.en: I may overtake only two-wheeled vehicles
Overtaking on the left is prohibited

options.rw: a na b ni ibisubizo by’ukuri

explain.rw: Iki cyapa kiburira ko imbere hari akanunga (aho umuhanda uzamuka ukongera ukamanuka). Hejuru y’akanunga ntubasha kubona neza ibinyabiziga biturutse imbere, bityo kunyuranaho (bikorerwa ibumoso) birabujijwe. Kugabanya umuvuduko ntibikuraho icyo cyago.
explain.en: This warning sign announces a road hump ahead. On top of a hump you cannot see oncoming traffic properly, so overtaking (which is done on the left) is prohibited there. Slowing down does not remove that danger.

sign.rw: Icyapa kiburira ko imbere hari akanunga

q.rw: Mu gihe cy’impanuka mu muhanda n’ubundi bushotoranyi ni yihe nimero ya telefone y’ubutabazi wahamagara:
q.en: In the event of a road accident or any other incident such as an assault, which emergency telephone number should you call?

explain.rw: Mu Rwanda, nimero y’ubutabazi bwihuse ni 112; uyihamagara kugira ngo polisi n’abandi batabazi bamenyeshwe vuba. 911 ikoreshwa mu bindi bihugu, si iyo mu Rwanda.
explain.en: In Rwanda the emergency number is 112; call it to alert the police and emergency services quickly. 911 is used in other countries, not in Rwanda.

q.rw: Ugeze bwa mbere ahabereye impanuka yo mu muhanda harimo inkomere wakora iki?
q.en: You are the first to arrive at a road accident with injured people. What should you do?

options.en: Pull the injured out of the vehicle
Report the accident and call emergency services
None of the answers is correct

explain.rw: Ikintu cya mbere ni ukumenyesha impanuka no guhamagara ubutabazi (112) kugira ngo inkomere zitabarwe vuba n’ababishoboye. Gusohora inkomere mu kinyabiziga cyangwa kuziha icyo kunywa bishobora kongera ibikomere byazo, keretse hari icyago gikomeye nk’inkongi y’umuriro.
explain.en: The first thing to do is report the accident and call emergency services (112) so that trained people reach the injured quickly. Pulling the injured out or giving them a drink can worsen their injuries, unless there is serious danger such as fire.

q.rw: Mugihe ikinyabiziga cyacu bakinyuzeho
q.en: When another vehicle is overtaking ours:

options.en: None of the answers is correct

explain.rw: Iyo unyuzweho, ntugomba kongera umuvuduko kuko byatuma unyuraho amara igihe kirekire mu gice cy’umuhanda cy’ibumoso, akaba yagongana n’ibiturutse imbere. Kugabanya umuvuduko gato no kwegera iburyo bimufasha kurangiza kunyuranaho vuba kandi mu mutekano.
explain.en: When you are being overtaken you must not speed up, because that keeps the overtaking vehicle longer on the left side of the road, where it may meet oncoming traffic. Easing off slightly and keeping to the right helps it finish overtaking quickly and safely.

q.rw: Ntibyemewe gukoresha telephone
q.en: Using a telephone is not allowed:

options.en: All of the answers are correct

explain.rw: Gukoresha telefoni igihe utwaye ikinyabiziga birabujijwe kuko bikurangaza: amaso, amaboko n’ibitekerezo bivanwa ku muhanda. Mu biro bya leta cyangwa ibya polisi nta tegeko ry’umuhanda ribibuza.
explain.en: Using a phone while driving is prohibited because it distracts you: your eyes, hands and attention are taken off the road. The traffic rules say nothing about phones in government or police offices.

q.rw: Mbere yo kunyura ku kindi kinyabiziga, ni ngombwa kumenya ko:
q.en: Before overtaking another vehicle, it is essential to make sure that:

options.en: No other vehicle is coming up behind me

options.rw: Umuhanda ubona neza, no kwitondera kunyuranaho
options.en: The road ahead is clearly visible, and to overtake carefully

options.rw: Ikinyabiziga kinturutse imbere gishaka gukatira I buumoso
options.en: The vehicle in front of me wants to turn left
None of the answers is correct

explain.rw: Mbere yo kunyuranaho, ugomba kubona neza umuhanda uri imbere kugira ngo umenye ko ufite umwanya uhagije wo kunyuraho nta kigutunguye, kandi ukabikora witonze. Iyo ikinyabiziga kiri imbere yawe gishaka gukatira ibumoso, ntugomba kukinyuraho ibumoso.
explain.en: Before overtaking you must have a clear view of the road ahead, so you know there is enough space to complete the manoeuvre without surprises, and you must do it carefully. If the vehicle in front wants to turn left, you must not overtake it on the left.

q.rw: Ikindi kinyabiziga kiguturutse inyuma kiguterera amatara y’urumuri rumyasa, wakora iki?
q.en: A vehicle behind you flashes its headlights at you. What should you do?

options.rw: Kongera umuvuduko kugira ngo intera iri hagati yawe n’ukuri inyuma igumeho
options.en: Speed up to keep the distance between you and the vehicle behind

options.rw: Fata feri y’urugendo kugira ngo umwereke ko ugiye guhagarara
options.en: Apply the service brake to show that you are going to stop

options.rw: Emerera icyo kinyabiziga kugutambukaho niba imbere ntacyago gihari
options.en: Let that vehicle overtake you if there is no danger ahead
None of the answers is correct

explain.rw: Gucana amatara rimwe na rimwe (kumyasa) ku kinyabiziga kiri inyuma yawe bikunze kuba ikimenyetso cy’uko ushaka kukunyuraho. Ntiwongere umuvuduko kandi ntufate feri bitunguranye; egera iburyo umworohereze gutambuka niba imbere nta cyago gihari.
explain.en: Flashing headlights from the vehicle behind usually means the driver wants to overtake you. Do not speed up or brake suddenly; keep to the right and let it pass if there is no danger ahead.

q.rw: Mu gihe Umuntu ufite ubumuga bwo kutabona yambuka umuhanda yitwaje inkoni yera y’abatabona:
q.en: When a visually impaired person is crossing the road carrying a white cane:

options.rw: Umuyobozi w’ikinyabiziga agomba gufata iyo nkoni nk’icyapa kimumenyesha ko agomba guhagarara
options.en: The driver must treat the cane as a sign telling him to stop
Sound the horn and carry on
Slow down, then carry on carefully
All of the answers are correct

explain.rw: Inkoni yera yerekana ko uwo munyamaguru atabona, bityo ntashobora kukubona cyangwa kwirinda ikinyabiziga. Umuyobozi agomba kuyifata nk’icyapa cyo guhagarara, agahagarara kugeza arangije kwambuka. Kuvuza ihoni byamutera ubwoba, kandi kugabanya umuvuduko gusa ntibihagije.
explain.en: A white cane shows that the pedestrian is blind and cannot see you or avoid your vehicle. Treat it as a stop sign and wait until the person has finished crossing. Sounding the horn would frighten them, and merely slowing down is not enough.

q.rw: Amatara y’urugendo, mu gihe cy’ibihu:
q.en: Main-beam headlights in fog:

options.rw: Ni meza kuko atuma ureba kure
options.en: Are good because they let you see far

options.rw: Ni mabi kuko arakugarukira akaguhuma amaso
options.en: Are bad because the light reflects back and dazzles you
Make sure that others can see you
None of the answers is correct

explain.rw: Mu bihu, urumuri rw’amatara y’urugendo rugarurwa n’ibihu rukaguhuma amaso, bityo ukarushaho kubona nabi. Koresha amatara yo kubisikana n’amatara kamena-bihu.
explain.en: In fog, the main-beam light is reflected back by the fog and dazzles you, so you see even less. Use dipped headlights and fog lamps instead.

q.rw: Gutwara uzungazunga mu muhanda:
q.en: Weaving (zigzagging) on the road:

options.rw: Ni bibi ku kinyabiziga cy’imitende ibiri
options.en: Is bad for a two-wheeled vehicle

options.rw: Ni bibi ku kinyabiziga cy’imitende ine
options.en: Is bad for a four-wheeled vehicle
None of the answers is correct

explain.rw: Gutwara uzungazunga bituma abandi bakoresha umuhanda batamenya aho ugana, kandi bishobora gutuma ugonga cyangwa ugongwa. Ni bibi ku kinyabiziga cyose, cyaba icy’imitende ibiri cyangwa ine.
explain.en: Weaving from side to side means other road users cannot predict where you are going, and it can lead to a collision. It is bad for every vehicle, whether it has two wheels or four.

q.rw: Telephone ngendanwa ntigomba gukoreshwa:
q.en: A mobile phone must not be used:

options.rw: Igihe utwaye ikinyabiziga Ku muvuduko wa 20km/h
options.en: While driving at a speed of 20 km/h

options.rw: A na B ni ibisubizo by’ukuri

options.en: None of the answers is correct

explain.rw: Gukoresha telefoni ngendanwa birabujijwe igihe cyose utwaye ikinyabiziga, uko umuvuduko waba ungana kose n’aho waba uri hose. Ibisubizo A na B bigabanya iryo tegeko ku hantu hamwe cyangwa ku muvuduko umwe gusa, niyo mpamvu igisubizo cyemewe ari uko nta gisubizo cy’ukuri kirimo.
explain.en: Using a mobile phone is banned whenever you are driving, at any speed and in any place. Options A and B limit the ban to one place or one particular speed, which is why the official answer is that none of them is correct.

q.rw: Kunyuranaho bibujijwe gusa igihe:
q.en: Overtaking is prohibited only when:

options.rw: Igihe mu muhanda hagati hashushanyijemo umurongo w’umweru ucagaguye.
options.en: A broken white line is painted along the middle of the road.
The road is marked with a continuous white line
The vehicle is being driven on a slippery hill
None of the answers is correct

explain.rw: Umurongo wera udacagaguye uciye hagati mu muhanda ntugomba kurengwa, bityo kunyuranaho bisaba kuwurenga birabujijwe. Umurongo wera ucagaguye wo ushobora kurengwa igihe bibaye ngombwa kandi nta cyago gihari.
explain.en: A continuous white line along the middle of the road must not be crossed, so any overtaking that would cross it is prohibited. A broken white line may be crossed when necessary and safe.

q.rw: Mu gihe utwaye ikinyabiziga ni joro ucanye amatara maremare ugahura n’ikindi kinyabiziga giturutse mu kindi cyerecyezo:
q.en: When you are driving at night with main-beam headlights on and you meet a vehicle coming from the opposite direction:

options.en: Switch off, then turn on both main-beam and dipped headlights

options.rw: Kuzimya amatara maremare kugeza ikindi kinyabiziga gitambutse
options.en: Switch off the main beam until the other vehicle has passed
None of the answers is correct

explain.rw: Amatara maremare ahuma amaso y’umuyobozi uturutse mu kindi cyerekezo. Iyo muhuye, uzimya amatara maremare ugakoresha amatara yo kubisikana (amagufi) kugeza ikindi kinyabiziga gitambutse, hanyuma ukabona kongera kuyacana.
explain.en: Main-beam headlights dazzle the oncoming driver. When you meet another vehicle, switch from main beam to dipped headlights until it has passed; then you may switch the main beam back on.

q.rw: Igihe umuyobozi w’inyamaswa, afite inyamaswa idatuje, asaba ko ibinyabiziga bihagarara:
q.en: When a person in charge of a restless animal asks vehicles to stop:

options.rw: Umuyobozi w’ikinyabiziga agomba kuvuza ihoni agukomeza
options.en: The driver must sound the horn and carry on
All of the answers are correct

explain.rw: Inyamaswa idatuje ishobora kwiruka itunguranye ikajya mu muhanda. Iyo uyiyoboye agusabye guhagarara, ugomba guhagarara ukamuha umwanya wo kuyituza no kuyikura mu nzira; kuvuza ihoni byayikanga kurushaho.
explain.en: A restless animal may bolt into the road without warning. When its keeper asks you to stop, you must stop and give them time to calm it and move it out of the way; sounding the horn would scare it even more.

q.rw: Iyo mu muhanda hashushanyijemo umurongo wera ucagaguye:
q.en: When a broken white line is painted on the road:

options.rw: Ntugomba kujya mu kindi gice cy’umuhanda
options.en: You must not move into the other part of the road

options.rw: Ushobora kujya mu kindi gice cy’umuhanda bibaye ngombwa
options.en: You may move into the other part of the road if necessary
The driver must stop the vehicle
None of the answers is correct

explain.rw: Umurongo wera ucagaguye ushobora kurengwa, urugero iyo unyuranaho cyangwa ukatira, igihe bibaye ngombwa kandi nta cyago gihari. Umurongo wera udacagaguye wo ntugomba kurengwa.
explain.en: A broken white line may be crossed, for example to overtake or to turn, when necessary and safe. It is the continuous white line that must not be crossed.

q.rw: Kuvuza ihoni bibujijwe:
q.en: Sounding the horn is prohibited:

options.rw: Ku musigiti, ku rusengero, ku rutambiro

options.en: None of the answers is correct

explain.rw: Ihoni rikoreshwa gusa mu kuburira abandi igihe hari icyago. Hafi y’ibitaro kuvuza ihoni birabujijwe kugira ngo abarwayi batabangamirwa n’urusaku.
explain.en: The horn is only for warning others of danger. Near hospitals its use is prohibited so that patients are not disturbed by the noise.

q.rw: Icyemezo cy’Isuzuma ry’ikinyabiziga kimara igihe kingana iki?
q.en: How long is a vehicle technical inspection certificate valid?

options.rw: A na B ni ibisubizo by’ukuri

explain.rw: Ibinyabiziga bikora ubucuruzi (nk’ibitwara abagenzi cyangwa ibicuruzwa) bikoreshwa cyane, bityo icyemezo cy’isuzuma cyabyo kimara amezi 6. Ibinyabiziga bidakora ubucuruzi byo bisuzumwa buri mezi 12. Ni yo mpamvu A na B ari byo bisubizo by’ukuri.
explain.en: Commercial vehicles (carrying passengers or goods for payment) are used intensively, so their inspection certificate is valid for 6 months. Non-commercial vehicles are inspected every 12 months. That is why A and B are both correct.

q.rw: N’iyihe myifatire myiza wagira ugeze aho abana bari hafi y’inzira nyabagendwa?
q.en: What is the right way to behave when you reach a place where children are close to the road?

options.rw: Itonde, witegereze ni biba ngongwa ubaburire unitegura kuba wahagarara.
options.en: Be careful, watch them, warn them if necessary and be ready to stop.

options.rw: Ihute urenge aho abo bana bari
options.en: Hurry to get past the children
Carry on, keeping to the right-hand side

explain.rw: Abana ntibamenya neza ibyago byo mu muhanda kandi bashobora kwiruka bakajya mu muhanda batarebye. Ugomba kugabanya umuvuduko, ukabitegereza, ukababurira nibiba ngombwa kandi ukitegura guhagarara. Kwihuta cyangwa kugumana umuvuduko munini byongera ibyago.
