explain.en: Children do not fully understand traffic danger and may run into the road without looking. Slow down, watch them, warn them if needed and be ready to stop. Hurrying past or keeping a high speed increases the risk.

q.rw: Umuyobozi w’ikinyabiziga yegereye aho umwana w’umuhungu utwaye akagare k’abana asezera ku nshuti ye. N’iyihe myifatire myiza wagira imbere yabo?
q.en: A driver is approaching a place where a boy riding a child's bicycle is saying goodbye to his friend. What is the right way to behave near them?

options.en: Carry on as if he had not yet reached the road

options.rw: Itegure kureka uwo mwana w’umuhungu atambuke, kuko yajya mu muhanda atitaye ku kinyabiziga cyawe
options.en: Be ready to let the boy go first, because he may ride into the road without paying attention to your vehicle

options.rw: Gabanya umuvuduko ubwire uwo mwana yambuke ukoresheje ibimenyetso
options.en: Slow down and use signals to tell the boy to cross

options.rw: Komeza nkaho uwo mwana akiri munzira y’abanyamaguru
options.en: Carry on as if the boy were still on the footpath

explain.rw: Umwana uri ku igare kandi arangariye mu gusezera ku nshuti ye ashobora kwinjira mu muhanda atarebye. Umuyobozi agomba kugabanya umuvuduko no kwitegura kumureka agatambuka. Kumuha ibimenyetso ngo yambuke nabyo byamushyira mu byago kubera ibindi binyabiziga.
explain.en: A child on a bicycle who is busy saying goodbye may ride into the road without looking. Slow down and be ready to let him go first. Signalling him to cross could put him in danger from other traffic you do not control.

q.rw: Nk’umuyobozi w’ikinyabiziga, n’iyihe myitwarire wagira?
q.en: As the driver, how should you behave here?

options.rw: Umuyobozi w’ikinyabiziga agomba kuguma mu ruhande rw’iburyo kugira ngo ahe inzira umumotari
options.en: The driver must stay on the right-hand side to give way to the motorcyclist

options.rw: Umuyobozi w’ikinyabiziga agomba gutanga inzira ayiha umu motari
options.en: The driver must give way to the motorcyclist

explain.rw: Igisubizo cyemewe gifata ko umuyobozi ari mu muhanda munini ufite uburenganzira bwo gutambuka, naho umumotari akaba aturuka mu muhanda w’ishami uri iburyo, bityo akaba ari we ugomba gutanga inzira. Umuyobozi rero akomeza urugendo rwe yitonze, areba ko umumotari amuhaye inzira koko.
explain.en: The official answer treats the driver as being on the main (priority) road, while the motorcyclist is coming out of a side road on the right and must give way. The driver therefore carries on, but carefully, checking that the motorcyclist really does give way.

q.rw: Umuyobozi w’ikinyabiziga ageze hafi y’inzira y’abanyamaguru yakwitwara ate?
q.en: How should a driver behave when approaching a pedestrian crossing?

options.rw: Kugabanya umuvuduko mu gihe cyiza, ukitegura guhagarara
options.en: Slow down in good time and be ready to stop

options.rw: Gukomeza agendera ku muvuduko uri hejuru, mu gihe umunyamaguru ategereje
options.en: Carry on at high speed while the pedestrian is waiting

options.rw: Kuguma ku muvuduko yari afite mu gihe umunyamaguru atarambuka
options.en: Keep the same speed as long as the pedestrian has not started crossing

options.rw: Kuvuza ihoni akaguma ku muvuduko yahozeho
options.en: Sound the horn and keep the same speed

explain.rw: Ku ishusho, abanyamaguru (barimo usunika igare ry’umwana) bategereje kwambuka. Umuyobozi agomba kugabanya umuvuduko hakiri kare kandi akitegura guhagarara kugira ngo bambuke mu mutekano. Kuvuza ihoni cyangwa kugumana umuvuduko bibangamira uburenganzira bwabo bwo kwambuka.
explain.en: In the picture pedestrians, one pushing a pram, are waiting to cross. Slow down early and be ready to stop so they can cross safely. Sounding the horn or keeping your speed ignores their right to cross.

q.rw: Umuyobozi w’ikinyabiziga akurikiye ibinyabiziga bibiri, yifuza kubinyuraho. N’iki yashingiraho mbere yo kubanyuraho?
q.en: A driver following two vehicles wants to overtake them. What should he consider before overtaking?

options.en: You must overtake both of them

options.rw: Sibyiza ko yazinyuraho atabasha kureba neza imbere ye
options.en: It is not wise to overtake them when he cannot see clearly ahead
The signs where he is do not allow overtaking
There is a pedestrian crossing ahead

explain.rw: Kunyura ku binyabiziga bibiri bisaba intera ndende n’igihe kirekire mu gice cy’umuhanda cy’ibumoso. Niba umuyobozi atabasha kubona neza imbere ye ngo amenye ko nta kinyabiziga kiza, ntagomba kunyuranaho.
explain.en: Overtaking two vehicles takes a long distance and a long time on the left side of the road. If the driver cannot see far enough ahead to be sure that nothing is coming, he must not overtake.

q.rw: N’iki umuyobozi w’ikinyabiziga yakora ashaka gukatira iburyo?
q.en: What should the driver do when he wants to turn right?

options.rw: Vuza ihoni umenyesha umunyegare ko ushaka gukatira iburyo
options.en: Sound the horn to tell the cyclist you want to turn right
Let the cyclist continue on his way

options.rw: Ongera umuvuuko kugira ngo umutange gukata mbere ye
options.en: Speed up so you can turn before him

explain.rw: Umunyegare uri iburyo bw’ikinyabiziga akomeje imbere, bityo iyo ukatiye iburyo ukata inzira ye. Ugomba kumureka akabanza gutambuka, hanyuma ukabona gukata. Kwihuta cyangwa kumukatira imbere byatuma umugonga.
explain.en: The cyclist on your right is going straight on, so turning right would cut across his path. Let him go past first, then turn. Speeding up or cutting in front of him could cause a collision.

q.rw: N’ayahe matara umuyobozi w’ikinyabiziga agomba gukoresha mugihe cy’ibihu?
q.en: Which lights must a driver use in fog?

options.rw: Amatara kamena bihu y’imbere n’ay’inyuma hamwe n’amatara magufi
options.en: Front and rear fog lamps together with dipped headlights

explain.rw: Mu bihu, amatara kamena-bihu y’imbere n’ay’inyuma akoreshwa hamwe n’amatara magufi (yo kubisikana): amagufi agufasha kubona umuhanda, kamena-bihu agatuma ubona kandi ukagaragara neza. Amatara kamena-bihu yonyine cyangwa amagufi yonyine ntahagije, naho amatara maremare arahuma.
explain.en: In fog, use front and rear fog lamps together with dipped headlights: the dipped beam lights the road while the fog lamps help you see and be seen. Fog lamps alone or dipped headlights alone are not enough, and main beam dazzles.

q.rw: Muri ibi binyabiziga n’ikihe gihagaze nabi?
q.en: Which of these vehicles is badly parked?

explain.rw: Guhagarara ku nzira y’abanyamaguru cyangwa hafi yayo cyane birabujijwe, kuko bihisha abanyamaguru bambuka ku binyabiziga biza. Ku ishusho, ikinyabiziga cy’icyatsi n’icy’umutuku byombi bihagaze ku mpera z’inzira y’abanyamaguru, bityo byombi bihagaze nabi.
explain.en: Stopping or parking on a pedestrian crossing or too close to it is prohibited, because it hides crossing pedestrians from approaching drivers. In the picture both the green and the red vehicle are parked right at the edges of the crossing, so both are badly parked.

q.rw: Ni gute umuyobozi w’ikinyabiziga yanyura kumunyegare hano?
q.en: How may the driver overtake the cyclist here?

options.en: Here the driver may not overtake him
Without crossing the broken white line
By crossing the broken white line
Without crossing either of the two lines

explain.rw: Iyo imirongo ibiri ibangikanye, umuyobozi yubahiriza umurongo uri ku ruhande rwe. Hano umurongo uri ku ruhande rw’umuyobozi ni ucagaguye, bityo ashobora kuwurenga kugira ngo anyure ku munyegare amusigiye umwanya uhagije, igihe nta cyago gihari. Abaturuka mu kindi cyerekezo bo ntibemerewe kurenga umurongo udacagaguye uri ku ruhande rwabo.
explain.en: With two parallel lines, each driver obeys the line on his own side. Here the line on the driver's side is broken, so he may cross it to overtake the cyclist, leaving plenty of room, when it is safe. Oncoming drivers may not cross the continuous line on their side.

sign.rw: Imirongo ibiri ibangikanye: ucagaguye ku ruhande rw’umuyobozi, udacagaguye ku rundi ruhande
sign.en: Double centre line: broken line on the driver's side, continuous line on the other side

q.rw: N’iki umuyobozi w’ikinyabiziga yakora aramutse ahumishijwe n’urumuri rw’amatara yikinyabiziga giturutse mu kindi cyerekezo?
q.en: What should a driver do if dazzled by the headlights of a vehicle coming from the opposite direction?

options.rw: humisha ikinyabiziga giturutse mu kindi cyerekezo ucana amatara maremare.
options.en: Dazzle the oncoming vehicle by switching on your main beam.

options.rw: Egera kunkombe y’iburyo bw’umuhanda nibinashobioka ugabanye umuvuduko.
options.en: Move towards the right-hand edge of the road and, if possible, slow down.

options.rw: Canira amatara ikinyabiziga kiva mukindi cyerekezo
options.en: Flash your lights at the oncoming vehicle

options.rw: Ongera umuvuduko kugira ngo usohoke mururwo rumuri vuba bishoboka
options.en: Speed up to get out of the glare as quickly as possible

explain.rw: Iyo uhumishijwe n’amatara ntubona neza umuhanda, bityo ugomba kwegera inkombe y’iburyo bw’umuhanda, ukagabanya umuvuduko ndetse ugahagarara nibiba ngombwa, ukareba ku nkombe y’iburyo aho kureba amatara. Guhumisha nawe undi muyobozi cyangwa kwihuta byongera ibyago by’impanuka.
explain.en: When dazzled you cannot see the road properly, so keep close to the right-hand edge, slow down (stop if necessary) and look towards the right edge of the road rather than at the lights. Dazzling the other driver back or speeding up only increases the risk of a crash.

q.rw: Niki ugomba gukora igihe wegereye ikimenyetso kimurika kiva mucyatsi kijya mumuhondo?
q.en: What must you do when approaching traffic lights that change from green to amber?

options.en: Speed up to complete the turn

options.rw: Komeza kuko itara ry’icyatsi rigiye kwaka.
options.en: Carry on, because the green light is about to come on.
Stop, if you can do so without causing danger

options.rw: Komeza ubwitonzi witegura guhagarara mugihe itara rihindutse umutuku
options.en: Carry on carefully, ready to stop when the light turns red

explain.rw: Itara ry’umuhondo rikurikira icyatsi risobanura ko ugomba guhagarara, keretse niba wamaze kuryegera cyane ku buryo guhagarara byateza impanuka. Ntiwongere umuvuduko ngo urenge mbere y’uko itara riba umutuku, kandi ntutegereze umutuku ngo ubone guhagarara.
explain.en: Amber after green means stop, unless you are already so close that stopping would cause an accident. Do not speed up to beat the red light, and do not wait for red before deciding to stop.

q.rw: Niki umuyobozi w’ikinyabiziga akwiriye kumenya mugihe akurikiye umuyobozi wikinyamitende ibiri kandi imodoka y’umweru iri gusubira inyuma ijya mumuhanda?
q.en: What should a driver be aware of when following a motorcyclist while a white car is reversing out into the road?

options.rw: Umuyobozi wikinyabiziga gisubira inyuma azahagarara nabona umuyobozi w’ikinyabimitende ibiri
options.en: The driver of the reversing car will stop when he sees the motorcyclist

options.rw: Umuyobozi w’ikinyamitende ibiri ashobora gusaba umuyobozi w’ikinyabiziga gisubira inyuma guhagarara
options.en: The motorcyclist can ask the driver of the reversing car to stop

options.rw: Amatara yoguhagarara ashobora kuzima ikinyabiziga gikomeza gusubira inyuma
options.en: The brake lights may go off while the car keeps reversing

explain.rw: Imodoka isubira inyuma ijya mu muhanda ishobora gutuma umumotari uri imbere yawe afata feri cyangwa agahagarara bitunguranye. Ugomba gusiga intera ihagije no kwitegura guhagarara. Ntukeke ko uyobora imodoka isubira inyuma azabona abandi agahagarara.
explain.en: A car reversing into the road may force the motorcyclist in front of you to brake or stop suddenly. Keep a good distance and be ready to stop. Do not assume the reversing driver has seen everyone and will stop.

q.rw: Aha niki umuyobozi w’ikinyabiziga yakora mugihe ashaka kujya iburyo?
q.en: What should the driver do here when he wants to turn right?

options.en: Drive on between the two pedestrians
Sound the horn and speed up
Stop and let the pedestrians cross

options.rw: Reka umunyamaguru umwe atambuke ubone umwanya wogutambuka
options.en: Let one pedestrian cross so that you get room to pass

explain.rw: Iyo ukatira mu wundi muhanda, abanyamaguru bambuka uwo muhanda winjiramo bafite uburenganzira bwo kubanza gutambuka. Umuyobozi agomba guhagarara akabareka bose bakambuka, hanyuma akabona gukata.
explain.en: When you turn into another road, pedestrians crossing the road you are entering have priority. The driver must stop, let them all cross, and only then complete the turn.

q.rw: Aha umuyobozi w’ikinyabiziga ashobora kunyura kuri aba abanyamagare?
q.en: May the driver overtake these cyclists here?

options.rw: Oya, umuyobozi ntashobora kureba imbere neza
options.en: No, the driver cannot see clearly ahead

options.rw: Yego, kuko umurongo wera ucagaguye udashobora kuba udacagaguye.
options.en: Yes, because the white line is broken, not continuous.

options.rw: Yego, abanyamagare bazumva imodoka bave munzira
options.en: Yes, the cyclists will hear the car and get out of the way

options.rw: Yego, kuko buri kinyabiziga kiva mukindi cyerekezo gishobora kuguha inzira
options.en: Yes, because any oncoming vehicle can give way to you

explain.rw: Abanyamagare bari mu ikoni, aho umuyobozi atabasha kubona ibinyabiziga biturutse imbere. Kunyura ku itsinda ry’abanyamagare bisaba intera ndende, bityo ntibyemewe aho utabona imbere neza, nubwo umurongo waba ucagaguye.
explain.en: The cyclists are on a bend, where the driver cannot see oncoming traffic. Passing a group of cyclists needs a long distance, so it must not be done where you cannot see clearly ahead, even if the line is broken.

q.rw: Aha niki umuyobozi w’ikinyabiziga yakora?
q.en: What should the driver do here?

options.en: Let the pedestrians cross the road
Sound the horn and carry on

options.rw: Tengereza munzira y’abanyamaguru kugeza imidoka izimye
options.en: Wait on the pedestrian crossing until the vehicles have switched off

options.rw: Kongera umuvuduko mbere yuko abanyamaguru bambuka
options.en: Speed up before the pedestrians cross

explain.rw: Abanyamaguru bambuka cyangwa bategereje ku nzira y’abanyamaguru bafite uburenganzira bwo kubanza. Umuyobozi agomba guhagarara mbere y’inzira y’abanyamaguru akabareka bakambuka; ntagomba guhagarara kuri iyo nzira cyangwa kubavugiriza ihoni.
explain.en: Pedestrians crossing or waiting at a pedestrian crossing have priority. The driver must stop before the crossing and let them cross; he must not stop on the crossing or sound the horn at them.

q.rw: Muri ibi binyabiziga bine ni ikihe kiri mu buryo bwiza bwo gukata ikoni ry’iburyo kiva mu muhanda munini kijya mu muto?
q.en: Of these four vehicles, which one is correctly positioned to turn right from the main road into the minor road?

options.rw: Ikinyabiziga cya mbere kiri mu buryo bwiza bwo gukata ikoni ry’iburyo
options.en: Vehicle 1 is correctly positioned to turn right

options.rw: Ikinyabiziga cya kabiri kiri mu buryo bwiza bwo gukata ikoni ry’iburyo
options.en: Vehicle 2 is correctly positioned to turn right

options.rw: Ikinyabiziga cya gatatu kiri mu buryo bwiza bwo gukata ikoni ry’iburyo
options.en: Vehicle 3 is correctly positioned to turn right

options.rw: Ikinyabiziga cya kane kiri mu buryo bwiza bwo gukata ikoni ry’iburyo
options.en: Vehicle 4 is correctly positioned to turn right

explain.rw: Mu Rwanda ibinyabiziga bigendera iburyo, bityo ushaka gukatira iburyo agomba kwegera uruhande rw’iburyo bw’umuhanda agakata ikoni rigufi. Ikinyabiziga cya 1 kiri iburyo kandi kiri kwinjira neza mu muhanda muto, naho ibindi ntibiri mu mwanya ukwiye wo gukatira iburyo.
explain.en: Traffic in Rwanda keeps to the right, so a driver turning right must keep close to the right-hand side and take a tight turn into the side road. Vehicle 1 is on the right and entering the minor road correctly; the other vehicles are not in the proper position for a right turn.

q.rw: Niki umuyobozi w’ikinyabiziga yakora mu gihe abonye icyapa kiburira cya mpande eshatu gitukura mu muhanda?
q.en: What should a driver do on seeing a red triangular warning sign on the road?

options.rw: Umuyobozi w’ikinyabiziga agomba kugabanya umuvuduko ateganya icyago imbere ye
options.en: The driver must slow down, anticipating a danger ahead
Ignore it, keep your speed and carry on

options.rw: Hagarara kuri icyo cyapa cya mpande eshatu mbere yo gukomeza
options.en: Stop at the triangular sign before continuing

explain.rw: Icyapa cya mpande eshatu gifite urubibi rutukura (cyangwa mpandeshatu itukura ishyirwa mu muhanda n’ikinyabiziga cyapfuye) kiburira ko imbere hari icyago. Umuyobozi agomba kugabanya umuvuduko, akitonda kandi akitegura guhagarara nibiba ngombwa; icyo cyapa ntigisaba guhagarara buri gihe.
explain.en: A triangular sign with a red border (or the red warning triangle placed by a broken-down vehicle) warns of danger ahead. Slow down, take care and be ready to stop if necessary; the sign itself does not require you to stop.

q.rw: Niki umuyobozi w’ikinyabiziga agomba gukora ahuye n’amatungo mu muhanda?
q.en: What must a driver do on meeting livestock on the road?

options.en: Sound the horn to make them run away

options.rw: Umuyobozi w’ikinyabiziga agomba kugabanya umuvuduko zigatambuka
options.en: The driver must slow down and let them pass

options.rw: Kwatsa amatara maremare kugirango utambuke wihuta mu buryo bushoboka bwose
options.en: Switch on main beam so you can get past as fast as possible
Sound the horn and pass carefully

explain.rw: Amatungo ntamenya amategeko y’umuhanda kandi ashobora kugira ubwoba agahindura icyerekezo bitunguranye. Ugomba kugabanya umuvuduko ukayareka agatambuka, ndetse ugahagarara nibiba ngombwa. Ihoni n’amatara maremare bishobora kuyakanga bikayatera kwiruka mu nzira yawe.
explain.en: Animals do not know the rules of the road and may panic and change direction suddenly. Slow down and let them pass, stopping if necessary. The horn or main beam can frighten them into running into your path.

q.rw: Niki umuyobozi w’ikinyabiziga yakora abonye otobisi iri kuva aho zagenewe guhagararwamo?
q.en: What should a driver do on seeing a bus pulling out of a bus stop?

options.rw: Gukomeza iruhande kuko ufite uburenganzira bwo gukomeza
options.en: Carry on alongside it because you have the right to continue
Slow down and let it move off
Try to overtake it so that it does not hold you up

options.rw: Menyesha umuyobozi wa otobisi aguhe inzira
options.en: Signal the bus driver to give way to you

explain.rw: Otobisi iva aho ihagarara iba igiye kwinjira mu muhanda, kandi hafi yayo hashobora kuba hari abagenzi bambuka. Kugabanya umuvuduko no kuyireka igakomeza ni byo bituma mwese mugenda mu mutekano; kugerageza kuyinyuraho icyo gihe ni ukwishyira mu byago.
explain.en: A bus leaving a stop is about to rejoin the traffic, and passengers may be crossing nearby. Slowing down and letting it move off keeps everyone safe; trying to overtake it at that moment is risky.

q.rw: Niki umuyobozi w’ikinyabiziga yakora mugihe ahuye n’ikinyabiziga cyakije itara ry’umuhondo rimyatsa?
q.en: What should a driver do on meeting a vehicle showing a flashing amber light?

options.rw: Mu gihe ikinyabiziga giturutse mu kindi cyerekezo kitagishoboye kugenda
options.en: When the oncoming vehicle can no longer move

options.rw: Mu gihe ikinyabiziga ndakumirwa giturutse mu kindi cyerekezo
options.en: When a priority vehicle is coming from the other direction

options.rw: Mu gihe ikinyabiziga giturutse mu cyindi cyerekezo cy’ihuta
options.en: When the oncoming vehicle is speeding

explain.rw: Itara ry’umuhondo rimyatsa ku kinyabiziga riburira ko hari icyago cyangwa ko icyo kinyabiziga gikora umurimo wihariye (nko gukurura indi modoka, gutunganya umuhanda cyangwa gutwara imizigo minini). Umuyobozi uhuye na cyo agomba kugabanya umuvuduko akitegura guhagarara.
explain.en: A flashing amber light on a vehicle warns of a hazard or shows that the vehicle is doing special work (such as towing, road maintenance or carrying an oversized load). When you meet it, slow down and be ready to stop.

q.rw: Umuyobozi w’ikinyabiziga yakara iki mu gihe anyuzweho nikindi kinyabiziga?
q.en: What should a driver do when being overtaken by another vehicle?

explain.rw: Unyuzweho agomba gukomeza ku muvuduko yari afite, ntiyongere umuvuduko kandi ntahindure icyerekezo bitunguranye, kugira ngo unyuraho arangize vuba. Kwongera umuvuduko birabujijwe kuko bituma unyuraho amara igihe kirekire mu gice cy’umuhanda cy’ibumoso.
explain.en: The driver being overtaken should keep a steady speed, without accelerating or swerving, so the overtaking vehicle can complete the manoeuvre quickly. Speeding up is forbidden because it keeps the overtaking vehicle longer on the left side of the road.

q.rw: Umurongo w’umweru urombereje uciye hagati mu muhanda uvuze iki?
q.en: What does a continuous white line along the middle of the road mean?

explain.rw: Umurongo wera udacagaguye (urombereje) uciye hagati mu muhanda ntugomba kurengwa cyangwa kugenderwaho n’umuyobozi uwo ari we wese, bityo kunyuranaho cyangwa guhindukira bisaba kuwurenga birabujijwe.
explain.en: A continuous white line along the middle of the road must not be crossed or straddled by any driver, so overtaking or turning around across it is prohibited.

sign.rw: Umurongo wera udacagaguye uciye hagati mu muhanda
sign.en: Continuous white centre line (must not be crossed)

q.rw: Umuyobozi w’ikinyabiziga ugeze mu isangano ry’umuhanda ugenzurwa ni ibimenyetso by’amatara yaka agasanga ataka (adakora), yakora iki?
q.en: A driver reaches an intersection normally controlled by traffic lights and finds them not working. What should he do?

options.rw: Guca mu isangano n’ubwitonzi nkaho ntakimenyetso kikuyobora kirimo, witondera abandi bayobozi b’ibinyabiziga
options.en: Cross the intersection carefully as if there were no signals controlling it, watching out for other drivers
Drive on without lingering in the intersection

options.rw: Guhagarara mw’isangano no guha inzira abayobozi b’ibinyabiziga baturuka iburyo bwawe
options.en: Stop in the intersection and give way to drivers coming from your right

options.rw: Gucana amatara yose ndanga cyerekezo ugakomeza
options.en: Switch on all the direction indicators and carry on

explain.rw: Iyo amatara yo mu isangano adakora, ukurikiza ibyapa bihari cyangwa amategeko asanzwe y’uburenganzira bwo gutambuka, nk’aho nta matara ahari, kandi ukagenda witonze ureba abandi bayobozi. Guhagarara hagati mu isangano byafunga inzira bigateza impanuka.
explain.en: When the traffic lights are not working, follow any signs present or the normal right-of-way rules, as if there were no lights, and proceed carefully, watching other drivers. Stopping in the middle of the intersection would block it and cause danger.

q.rw: Ni iki umuyobozi w’ikinyabiziga yakora ahuye n’ishyo ry’amatungo munzira nyabagendwa?
q.en: What should a driver do on meeting a herd of livestock on the public road?

options.rw: Kuvuza ihoni kugirango ayo matungo atambuke
options.en: Sound the horn to make the animals move along

options.rw: Umuyobozi w’ikinyabiziga agomba kugabanya umuvuduko no gutambukana ubwitonzi
options.en: The driver must slow down and pass carefully

options.rw: Kwatsa amatara maremare n’amagufi no gutambuka vuba bishoboka
options.en: Switch on main and dipped beams and get past as quickly as possible
Sound the horn and pass carefully

explain.rw: Ishyo ry’amatungo rishobora gukangwa n’urusaku cyangwa urumuri amatungo akiruka mu mpande zose. Umuyobozi agomba kugabanya umuvuduko, agasiga umwanya uhagije kandi agatambuka buhoro yitonze, ahagarara nibiba ngombwa. Ihoni ntirikenewe kandi rishobora kuyakanga.
explain.en: A herd of animals can be startled by noise or light and scatter in all directions. Slow down, leave plenty of room and pass slowly and carefully, stopping if necessary. Sounding the horn is unnecessary and may frighten them.

q.rw: Umuyobozi w’ikinyabiziga yakora iki igihe ageze ku kazamuko gashinze cyane?
q.en: What should a driver do on reaching a very steep climb?

options.rw: Umuyobozi w’ikinyabiziga agomba kugabanya umuvuduko akaguma kuruhande rw’iburyo yirinda ibyago
options.en: The driver must reduce speed and keep to the right to avoid danger

options.rw: Gukandagira ikirenge cya amburiyage no kuvuza ihoni ryo kumunyesha
options.en: Press the clutch pedal and sound the horn as a warning

options.rw: Kugumana umuvuduko n’ikirekezo wari ufite mu muhanda
options.en: Keep the speed and direction you had on the road
Stop at the top of the hill

explain.rw: Ku kazamuko gashinze ntubasha kubona neza ibiri hirya y’impinga, kandi ibinyabiziga bimanuka bishobora kuza vuba. Gabanya umuvuduko, uguma iburyo bw’umuhanda kandi wirinde kunyuranaho. Gukandagira amburiyage ku musozi bituma utakaza ubushobozi bwo kugenzura ikinyabiziga.
explain.en: On a steep climb you cannot see beyond the crest, and vehicles coming down the other side may arrive quickly. Reduce speed, keep to the right and do not overtake. Holding the clutch pedal down on a hill disconnects the engine and reduces your control of the vehicle.

q.rw: Umuyobozi w’ikinyabiziga yakora iki ahuye n’ikinyabiziga giturutse mukindi kerekezo, gicanye amatara yumuhondo aburira?
q.en: What should a driver do on meeting an oncoming vehicle showing amber warning lights?

options.rw: Umuyobozi w’ikinyabiziga agomba kugabanya umuvuduko no gutambukana ubwitonzi
options.en: The driver must slow down and pass carefully

explain.rw: Amatara y’umuhondo aburira yerekana ko hari icyago cyangwa ko icyo kinyabiziga gikora umurimo wihariye, nk’icyapfuye, igikurura ikindi cyangwa igitwaye imizigo minini. Umuyobozi uhuye na cyo agomba kugabanya umuvuduko akagitambukaho yitonze.
explain.en: Amber warning lights show there is a hazard or that the vehicle is doing special work, for example a broken-down vehicle, a tow truck or a vehicle with an oversized load. When you meet it, slow down and pass carefully.

q.rw: Niki umuyobozi w’ikinyabiziga yakora ageze hafi y’inzira ifunganye igihe ahuye n’ikindi kinyabiziga giturutse mukindi cyerekezo?
q.en: What should a driver do when approaching a narrow road and meeting a vehicle coming from the opposite direction?

options.rw: Agomba kuguma mumwanya yarimo agategereza gutambuka kwikindi kinyabiziga
options.en: He must stay where he is and wait for the other vehicle to pass

options.rw: kugabanya umuvuduko no gusiga umwanya uhagije hagati y’ibinyabiziga byombi
options.en: Slow down and leave enough space between the two vehicles

options.rw: gutegereza ko undi muyobozi w’ikinyabiziga ava mu muhanda
options.en: Wait for the other driver to leave the road

options.rw: gutwarira ikinyabiziga mu muhanda hagati kugirango abandi bayobozi bahagararare
options.en: Drive in the middle of the road so that other drivers stop

explain.rw: Ku nzira ifunganye, kubisikana bisaba kugabanya umuvuduko, kwegera iburyo uko bishoboka no gusiga umwanya uhagije hagati y’ibinyabiziga byombi; nibiba ngombwa umwe ahagarara aho umuhanda wagutse. Gutwarira hagati mu muhanda bishyira abandi mu byago.
explain.en: On a narrow road, passing an oncoming vehicle requires slowing down, keeping as far right as possible and leaving enough space between the two vehicles; if needed, one driver stops where the road is wider. Driving in the middle of the road endangers others.

q.rw: Umuyobozi w’ikinyabiziga agendera inyuma y’ikindi kinyabizaga akaba adateganya kukinyuraho yakora iki?
q.en: What should a driver do when following another vehicle without intending to overtake it?

options.rw: kuguma yicyo kinyabiziga hagati mu muhanda
options.en: Stay with that vehicle in the middle of the road

options.rw: kuguma inyuma yacyo kugirango yemerere ibindi binyabiziga gutambuka
options.en: Stay behind it, leaving room for other vehicles to overtake

options.rw: gutwarira inyuma ye umwegereye cyane kugirango ureke ibindi binyabiziga bibanyureho
options.en: Drive very close behind it so that other vehicles can overtake you both

options.rw: gutanga ibimenyetso kubindi binyabiziga ko byabanyuraho
options.en: Signal to other vehicles that they can overtake you

explain.rw: Udateganya kunyuranaho agomba kuguma inyuma y’ikinyabiziga kiri imbere asize intera ihagije, kugira ngo ibinyabiziga bimukurikiye bishaka kunyuranaho bibone umwanya wo kwinjiramo. Kwegera cyane ikiri imbere ni bibi kuko bitera impanuka, kandi kubwira abandi ko banyuranaho si inshingano yawe.
explain.en: A driver who does not intend to overtake should stay behind the vehicle ahead with a good gap, so that faster vehicles wanting to overtake have room to pull back in. Tailgating is dangerous, and it is not your job to signal others that it is safe to overtake.

q.rw: Niryari amatara ndanga cyerekezo agomba kugaragazwa kubandi bakoresha umuhanda?
q.en: When should direction indicators be shown to other road users?

options.rw: igihe gusa ari ngombwa amenyesha ibindi binyabiziga bimukurikiye
options.en: Only when it is necessary to inform the vehicles following him

options.rw: igihe gusa aringombwa kuburira abandi bayobozi bava mukindi cyerekezo
options.en: Only when it is necessary to warn oncoming drivers

options.rw: mugihe gikwiye ushaka kumenyesha abandi bakoresha umuhanda icyo ugiye gukora
options.en: In good time, whenever you want to tell other road users what you are about to do

options.rw: keretse ahari ibimenyetso byo mu muhanda byerekana icyerekezo cyawe
options.en: Except where road markings show your direction

explain.rw: Amatara ndangacyerekezo acanwa hakiri kare, igihe cyose ugiye guhindura icyerekezo cyangwa umwanya mu muhanda, kugira ngo abakoresha umuhanda bose (abagukurikiye, abaturuka imbere n’abanyamaguru) bamenye icyo ugiye gukora. Ntibigarukira ku itsinda rimwe ry’abakoresha umuhanda.
explain.en: Direction indicators must be used in good time whenever you are about to change direction or position, so that all road users (those behind, oncoming drivers and pedestrians) know what you intend to do. They are not just for one group of road users.

q.rw: Gutinda gutanga ibimenyetso ku muyobozi w’ikinyabiziga ni gute bibangamira abandi bakoresha umuhanda?
q.en: How does a driver who signals late inconvenience other road users?

options.rw: bigira ingaruka gusa kubaturuka mukindi cyerekezo
options.en: It affects only those coming from the opposite direction

options.rw: bishobora gutuma batabona igihe gihagije cyo gushyira mubikorwa icyo amenyeshejwe
options.en: They may not have enough time to act on what is being signalled

options.rw: baba bafite igihe gihagije cyo gushyira mu bikorwa ibyo bamyeshejwe
options.en: They still have enough time to act on what is being signalled
It does not affect them at all

explain.rw: Ikimenyetso gitanzwe bitinze ntigiha abandi bakoresha umuhanda igihe cyo kugabanya umuvuduko, guhagarara cyangwa guhindura icyerekezo, bityo gishobora guteza impanuka. Ni yo mpamvu ibimenyetso bigomba gutangwa hakiri kare.
explain.en: A late signal leaves other road users no time to slow down, stop or change course, so it can cause a collision. That is why signals must be given in good time.

q.rw: Ni ubuhe buryo bwiza bwakurikizwa igihe hari umuntu wakomerekeye mu mpanuka yo mu muhanda?
q.en: What is the right thing to do when someone has been injured in a road accident?

options.en: Move him to the side of the road

options.rw: Kutamukuramo keretse mugihe hari ibyago byaterwa n’inkogi y’umuriro cyangwa akaba ashobora kugongwa n’ikindi kinyabiziga no guhamagara ababishinzwe
options.en: Do not move him unless there is a danger of fire or of being hit by another vehicle, and call the emergency services

options.rw: Gusaba uwakomeretse kunyeganyeza ibice by’umubiri kugirano umenye aho ibikomere bye bigarukira
options.en: Ask the injured person to move parts of his body to find out how far the injuries extend
Comfort the injured person and give him a cold drink

explain.rw: Kwimura inkomere bishobora kongera ibikomere byayo, cyane cyane iby’umugongo n’ijosi. Uyikuramo gusa iyo hari icyago gikomeye nk’inkongi y’umuriro cyangwa kugongwa n’ikindi kinyabiziga, hanyuma ugahamagara ababishinzwe. Ntuyihe icyo kunywa kandi ntuyisabe kunyeganyeza umubiri.
explain.en: Moving an injured person can worsen their injuries, especially to the spine and neck. Only move them if there is serious danger such as fire or being hit by another vehicle, and call the emergency services. Do not give them a drink or ask them to move their limbs.

q.rw: Niki umuyobozi w’ikinyabiziga yakora igihe agize uruhare mu mpanuka yo mu muhanda, aho ntawakometese ariko ibinyabiziga bikaba byateza icyago cyangwa byafunze umuhanda?
q.en: What should a driver do when involved in a road accident where nobody is injured, but the vehicles could cause danger or are blocking the road?

options.rw: Gushushanya aho zagonganiye no kuzishyira kuruhande
options.en: Mark where the vehicles collided and move them to the side of the road

options.rw: Gukuramo abagenze ugashyiraho icyapa cya mpandeshatu girukura kumodoka
options.en: Get the passengers out and put the red warning triangle on the car

options.rw: Gutegereza ko abapolisi bahagera mbere yo gukura ibinyabiziga mu muhanda
options.en: Wait for the police to arrive before moving the vehicles off the road

options.rw: Guhagarika ibindi binyabiziga kugeza ikibazo gikemutse mukabona kubikura mu muhanda
options.en: Stop other traffic until the matter is settled, then move the vehicles off the road

explain.rw: Iyo nta wakomeretse ariko ibinyabiziga bibangamiye urujya n’uruza cyangwa byateza indi mpanuka, abayobozi babanza gushushanya (kugaragaza) aho ibinyabiziga byari biri igihe byagonganaga, hanyuma bakabikura mu muhanda bakabishyira ku ruhande. Ibyo bifungura umuhanda kandi ibimenyetso by’impanuka ntibitakare.
explain.en: When nobody is hurt but the vehicles are blocking traffic or could cause another accident, the drivers first mark the positions of the vehicles at the moment of the collision, then move them to the side of the road. This clears the road while preserving the evidence of the accident.

q.rw: Igihe umuyobozi w’ikinyabiziga agendera munzira y’icyerekezo kimwe akifuza gukata ibumoso yakora iki?
q.en: What should a driver on a one-way road do when he wants to turn left?

options.rw: gutwara yegera umurongo wo hagati mu muhanda yerekeza ibumoso
options.en: Drive close to the centre line of the road, heading left
Drive close to the right-hand side of the road

options.rw: gutwara yegera ku uruhande rw’ibumoso bw’umuhanda
options.en: Drive close to the left-hand side of the road

options.rw: Gutwarira hafi y’umurongo ugabanya umuhanda mo kabili
options.en: Drive near the line dividing the road in two

explain.rw: Mu muhanda w’icyerekezo kimwe nta binyabiziga biturutse imbere, bityo ushaka gukatira ibumoso yegera uruhande rw’ibumoso bw’umuhanda mbere yo gukata. Ku muhanda w’ibyerekezo bibiri ho, ushaka gukatira ibumoso yegera umurongo wo hagati.
explain.en: On a one-way road there is no oncoming traffic, so a driver turning left moves over to the left-hand side of the road before turning. On a two-way road, by contrast, he would position himself near the centre line.

q.rw: Umuyobozi w’ikinyabiziga uri kugendera mu muhanda w’ibyerekezo bibiri ni uruhe ruhande rw’umuhanda agomba gukoresha?
q.en: A driver travelling on a two-way road: which side of the road must he use?

options.rw: Uruhande rw’ibumoso bw’umuhanda uretse igihe atwaye imashini zihinga cyangwa zikoreshwa indi mirimo
options.en: The left-hand side of the road, except when driving farm machinery or other working machines
Whichever part of the road he likes

options.rw: Mu gice cy’iburyo bw’umuhanda uretse igihe ashaka kunyuranaho cyangwa gukata ibumoso
options.en: The right-hand part of the road, except when he wants to overtake or turn left
The left-hand side of the road

explain.rw: Mu Rwanda ibinyabiziga bigendera iburyo: mu muhanda w’ibyerekezo bibiri umuyobozi agomba kugendera mu gice cy’iburyo bw’umuhanda. Ashobora kuvamo gusa igihe akora igikorwa kibimusaba, nko kunyuranaho (bikorerwa ibumoso) cyangwa kwegera hagati ashaka gukata ibumoso.
explain.en: In Rwanda traffic keeps to the right: on a two-way road the driver must use the right-hand part of the road. He leaves it only for a manoeuvre that requires it, such as overtaking (which is done on the left) or moving towards the centre to turn left. The left-hand half belongs to oncoming traffic.

q.rw: Igihe umuyobozi w’ikinyabiziga atwaye mu muhanda urombereje w’ibice byinshi agomba kugendera mu kihe gice cy’umuhanda?
q.en: When a driver is driving on a motorway (a road with several lanes), in which part of the road must he drive?

options.rw: Kugendera mu gice icyo aricyo cyose kirimo ibinyabiziga bike
options.en: Drive in whichever lane has the least traffic

options.rw: Kugendera ku gice cy’ibumoso keretse ushaka gusohokera iburyo
options.en: Drive in the left-hand lane unless you want to exit on the right

options.rw: Kugendera mu gice cy’iburyo bw’umuhanda keretse ushaka kunyuranaho
options.en: Drive in the right-hand lane unless you want to overtake

options.rw: Ntagutwarira mu ruhande rw’iburyo bw’umuhanda kuko hagenewe imodoka ziremereye n’imodoka nini zitwara abantu.
options.en: Do not drive in the right-hand lane, because it is reserved for heavy vehicles and large passenger vehicles

explain.rw: No mu muhanda urombereje w’ibisate byinshi, itegeko ni ukugendera mu gisate cy’iburyo. Ibisate by’ibumoso bikoreshwa mu kunyuranaho, warangiza ugasubira iburyo. Igisate cy’iburyo si icy’amakamyo n’otobisi gusa.
explain.en: Even on a motorway with several lanes, the rule is to keep to the right-hand lane. The lanes further left are used for overtaking, after which you move back to the right. The right-hand lane is not reserved for lorries and buses.

q.rw: Umuyobozi w’ikinyabiziga yakora iki igihe ageze aho banyura bazenguruka?
q.en: What should a driver do on arriving at a roundabout?

options.rw: Tanga inzira ku binyabiziga byamaze kwinjira aho banyura bazenguruka
options.en: Give way to vehicles already on the roundabout

options.rw: Tanga inzira ku binyabiziga biremereye gusa
options.en: Give way to heavy vehicles only

options.rw: Tanga inzira gusa niba uri mu nzira ya kabiri n’iya gatatu isohoka
options.en: Give way only if you are taking the second or third exit

options.rw: Komeza kuko abandi bayobozi b’ibinyabiziga bagomba kuguha inzira yo gukomeza
options.en: Carry on, because other drivers must give way to you

explain.rw: Ibinyabiziga byamaze kwinjira aho banyura bazenguruka nibyo bifite uburenganzira bwo gutambuka mbere. Umuyobozi uhageze agomba kubitangira inzira, akinjira ari uko habonetse umwanya uhagije. Ubwoko bw’ikinyabiziga cyangwa aho ushaka gusohokera ntacyo bihindura.
explain.en: Vehicles already circulating on the roundabout have priority. A driver arriving must give way to them and enter only when there is a safe gap. The type of vehicle and the exit you intend to take make no difference.

q.rw: Ni kihe cyerekezo umuyobozi w’ikinyabiziga yinjiriramo iyo ageze aho banyura bazenguruka?
q.en: In which direction does a driver go when entering a roundabout?

options.rw: Ibumoso gusa igihe ayobowe n’ikimenyetso kimurika
options.en: To the left, only when directed by a traffic light
To the right or to the left

explain.rw: Kubera ko mu Rwanda bagendera iburyo, iyo winjiye aho banyura bazenguruka ukatira iburyo, ukazenguruka ikirwa cyo hagati kiri ibumoso bwawe. Niyo waba ushaka kujya ibumoso, ubanza kwinjira iburyo ukazenguruka kugeza ku nzira usohokeramo.
explain.en: Because traffic in Rwanda keeps to the right, you turn right when entering a roundabout and travel round with the central island on your left. Even if you want to go left, you enter to the right and go round until you reach your exit.

q.rw: Mbere y’uko umuyobozi w’ikinyabiziga akata ibumoso mu nzira nyabagendwa, ni he ikinyabiziga kigomba kuba kiri?
q.en: Before a driver turns left on a public road, where must the vehicle be positioned?

options.en: On the right-hand side of the road

options.rw: Gusa iburyo bwo hagati y’inzira nyabagendwa
options.en: Just to the right of the centre of the road

options.rw: Mu ruhande urwarirwo rwose rwo hagati mu nzira nyabagendwa
options.en: Anywhere in the middle of the road
On the left-hand side of the road

explain.rw: Ku muhanda w’ibyerekezo bibiri, ushaka gukata ibumoso yegera hagati y’umuhanda ariko akaguma iburyo bw’umurongo wo hagati, nk’uko umwambi uri ku ishusho ubigaragaza. Ntarenga umurongo wo hagati ngo ajye mu gice cy’ibinyabiziga biturutse imbere, kandi ntaguma ku ruhande rw’iburyo kuko yabangamira abakomeza imbere.
explain.en: On a two-way road, a driver who wants to turn left moves towards the centre of the road but stays just to the right of the centre line, as the arrow in the picture shows. He must not cross the centre line into the oncoming half, nor stay at the right-hand edge where he would block traffic going straight on.

sign.rw: Umwambi wo gukata ibumoso mu gisate cyegereye umurongo wo hagati
sign.en: Left-turn arrow marked in the lane next to the centre line

q.rw: Umuyobozi w’ikinyabiziga yakwitondera iki mbere y’uko yinjira mu nzira banyuramo bazengurutse?
q.en: What should a driver pay attention to before entering a roundabout?

options.rw: Ibinyabiziga bimuturuka inyuma, umuvuduko bifite n’uburyo bimwegereye
options.en: Vehicles coming from behind, their speed and how close they are

options.rw: Ibinyabiziga biturutse ibumoso bwe n’umuvuduko bifite n’intera iri hagati ye nabyo
options.en: Vehicles coming from his left, their speed and the distance between him and them

options.rw: Ibinyabiziga biturutse iburyo n’umuvuduko bifite n’intera iri hagati ye nabyo
options.en: Vehicles coming from the right, their speed and the distance between him and them

options.rw: Ibinyabiziga bimuturutse imbere, umuvuduko bifite n’intera iri hagati ye nabyo
options.en: Vehicles coming from in front, their speed and the distance between him and them

explain.rw: Aho banyura bazenguruka, ibinyabiziga bizenguruka bifite ikirwa cyo hagati ibumoso bwabyo, bityo ibimaze kwinjira bikugeraho biturutse ibumoso bwawe. Mbere yo kwinjira, reba ibyo binyabiziga, umuvuduko wabyo n’intera iri hagati yawe nabyo, kuko ari byo ugomba guha inzira.
explain.en: On a roundabout traffic circulates with the central island on its left, so vehicles already on it reach you from your left. Before entering, check those vehicles, their speed and how far away they are, because they are the ones you must give way to.

q.rw: Umuyobozi w’ikinyabiziga ugendera inyuma y’ikinyabiziga gitwara abagenzi gihagaze gikuramo cyangwa gishyiramo abagenzi agomba:
q.en: A driver travelling behind a passenger vehicle that has stopped to let passengers off or on must:

options.rw: A na B ni ibisubizo by’ukuri

options.en: None of the answers is correct

explain.rw: Ikinyabiziga gitwara abagenzi gihagaze kibaye nk’inzitizi; ntusabwa kuguma inyuma yacyo. Ukinyuraho ibumoso nk’uko kunyuranaho bisanzwe bikorwa, igihe umuhanda uri imbere nta kibazo, kandi ugabanya umuvuduko kuko abagenzi bashobora kwambuka imbere yacyo.
explain.en: A passenger vehicle stopped to load or unload is effectively an obstacle; you are not required to stay behind it. You pass it on the left, as for any overtaking, when the road ahead is clear, and slowly because passengers may step out in front of it.

q.rw: Igihe ubonye icyapa kigaragaza ishuli wakora iki?
q.en: What should you do when you see a sign indicating a school?

options.rw: Gukomeza n’umuvuduko uri hejuru kuko umunyeshuli agomba gutegereza
options.en: Continue at high speed, because the pupil has to wait
All of the answers are correct

explain.rw: Icyapa kiburira ko hari ishuli kimenyesha ko abana bashobora kwambuka umuhanda batunguranye. Ugomba kugabanya umuvuduko ugakomeza witonze witeguye guhagarara. Kuvuza ihoni ntibisimbura ubwitonzi kandi bishobora gutera abana ubwoba.
explain.en: A school warning sign tells you that children may cross the road unexpectedly. You must slow down and continue carefully, ready to stop. Sounding the horn does not replace care and may frighten the children.

q.rw: Umubare w’abagenzi bemewe gutwarwa mu kinyabiziga wanditswe mu:
q.en: The number of passengers a vehicle is allowed to carry is written in:

options.en: All of the answers are correct

explain.rw: Nk’uko igisubizo cyemewe kibivuga, icyemezo cy’ubwishingizi kigaragaza umubare w’abagenzi ikinyabiziga cyishingiwe gutwara. Gutwara abarenze uwo mubare birabujijwe kandi abarenze ntibaba bishingiwe. Inyemezabwishyu y’umusoro ntaho ihuriye n’umubare w’abagenzi.
explain.en: According to the official answer, the insurance certificate states how many passengers the vehicle is insured to carry. Carrying more than that number is not allowed, and the extra passengers are not covered. The tax receipt has nothing to do with passenger numbers.

q.rw: Gutwara ikinyabiziga wasinze:
q.en: Driving a vehicle while drunk:

options.rw: Biremewe ku binyabiziga byabikorera ku giti cyabo
Birabujijwe ku binyabiziga byose bifite moteri
options.en: Is prohibited for all motor vehicles
All of the answers are correct

explain.rw: Inzoga zigabanya ubushobozi bwo kubona, gutekereza no kwihutira gufata icyemezo. Niyo mpamvu gutwara wasinze bibujijwe ku binyabiziga byose bifite moteri, byaba ibyabikorera ku giti cyabo cyangwa iby’ubucuruzi, ku manywa cyangwa nijoro.
explain.en: Alcohol reduces your vision, judgement and reaction time. That is why driving while drunk is prohibited for all motor vehicles, private or commercial, by day or by night.

q.rw: Umuyobozi w’ikinyabiziga ashobora kunyuranaho:
q.en: A driver may overtake:

options.rw: Igihe umuyobozi w’ikinyabiziga kiri imbere ye amweretse ikimenyetso kimwemerera kunyuranaho
options.en: When the driver of the vehicle in front gives him a signal allowing him to overtake
None of the answers is correct

explain.rw: Kuba umuhanda umanuka cyangwa ari mugari ntibihagije ngo kunyuranaho byemerwe. Igisubizo cyemewe ni igihe umuyobozi uri imbere amweretse ikimenyetso kimwemerera kunyuranaho, kuko ari we ubona neza umuhanda uri imbere. N’ubwo bimeze bityo, uwunyuraho agomba kwigenzurira ko inzira nta nkomyi.
explain.en: A downhill slope or a wide road is not enough to make overtaking allowed. The accepted answer is when the driver in front signals that you may overtake, since he can see the road ahead. Even then, you must check for yourself that the way is clear.

q.rw: Ugeze ahari inzira y’abanyamaguru barindiriye kwambuka. Ntibatangiye kwambuka, wakora iki?
q.en: You reach a pedestrian crossing where pedestrians are waiting to cross. They have not started crossing yet. What should you do?

options.en: None of the answers is correct

explain.rw: Ku nzira y’abanyamaguru, abanyamaguru bari kwambuka cyangwa bigaragara ko bagiye kwambuka bafite uburenganzira bwo gutambuka mbere. Ugomba kwihangana ugategereza bakambuka. Kuvuza ihoni ngo bihute cyangwa gukomeza ni ukubashyira mu kaga.
explain.en: At a pedestrian crossing, pedestrians who are crossing or clearly about to cross have priority. You must be patient and wait for them to cross. Sounding the horn to hurry them or driving on puts them in danger.

q.rw: Igihe utwaye umuntu mu kinyabiziga cyawe, akibagirwa kwambara umukandara wo kwirinda ibyago ugomba:
q.en: When you are carrying someone in your vehicle and they forget to fasten their seat belt, you must:

options.rw: Gukuramo umukandara wo kwirinda ibyago wambaye mukawambara mwembi
options.en: Take off your own seat belt so that you both share it

options.rw: Kubyirengagiza wizeye ko nta mpanuka muri bukore
options.en: Ignore it, trusting that you will not have an accident

options.rw: Funga cyane umukandara wo kwirinda ibyago wawe
options.en: Fasten your own seat belt tightly

options.rw: Kubibutsa kwambara umukandara wo kwirinda ibyago
options.en: Remind them to fasten their seat belt

explain.rw: Umukandara urinda buri wese uri mu kinyabiziga, kandi umuyobozi agomba kwita ku mutekano w’abo atwaye. Iyo umugenzi yibagiwe kuwambara, umwibutsa kuwambara mbere yo gukomeza urugendo. Umukandara umwe ntushobora kurinda abantu babiri.
explain.en: A seat belt protects every occupant, and the driver must look after the safety of the people he carries. If a passenger forgets to fasten it, remind them to do so before continuing. One belt cannot protect two people.

q.rw: Igihe za otobisi zigenewe gutwara abanyeshuli zihagaze kugira ngo zibafate cyangwa bavemo ugomba:
q.en: When school buses have stopped to pick up or drop off pupils, you must:

options.en: Sound the horn and carry on

options.rw: Gukomeza ugabanyije umuvuduko n’ubwitonzi kuko bishoboka ko abanyeshuli bakwambuka bitunguranye
options.en: Carry on, slowing down and taking care, because pupils may cross suddenly
All of the answers are correct

explain.rw: Abana bava cyangwa bajya muri otobisi y’abanyeshuli bashobora kwambuka umuhanda batunguranye, akenshi banyuze imbere cyangwa inyuma yayo. Ugomba kugabanya umuvuduko ukagenda witonze witeguye guhagarara. Kuvuza ihoni ntibihagije kandi bishobora kubatera ubwoba.
explain.en: Children getting on or off a school bus may cross the road suddenly, often from in front of or behind the bus. You must slow down and drive carefully, ready to stop. Sounding the horn is not enough and may startle them.

q.rw: Igihe imodoka iparitse ku nkengero z’umuhanda mu gihe cy’ijoro:
q.en: When a car is parked at the edge of the road at night:

options.rw: Umuntu ufite uruhushya rwo gutwara ikinyabiziga agomba kuba yicaye mu mwanya w’umuyobozi
options.en: Someone holding a driving licence must be sitting in the driver’s seat

options.rw: Amatara yo guhagarara umwanya munini aguma yaka

options.en: All of the answers are correct

explain.rw: Nijoro ikinyabiziga gihagaze umwanya munini ku nkengero z’umuhanda kigomba kugaragara ku bandi bakoresha umuhanda kugira ngo batakigonga. Niyo mpamvu amatara yo guhagarara umwanya munini (amatara ndanga) agomba kuguma yaka. Gufunga imodoka cyangwa gusiga umuntu mu mwanya w’umuyobozi si byo bisabwa n’amategeko y’umuhanda.
explain.en: At night a vehicle parked at the edge of the road must be visible to other road users so that they do not run into it. That is why its parking lights (position lights) must stay on. Locking the car or leaving someone in the driver’s seat is not what the traffic rules require here.

q.rw: Mu gihe hari undi muyobozi w’ikinyabiziga ugukurikiye watangiye kukunyuraho:
q.en: When another driver behind you has started to overtake you:

options.rw: Ntugomba kugira undi muyobozi w’ikinyabiziga unyuraho
options.en: You must not overtake any other driver
You must overtake the other vehicle

options.rw: Ugomba kunyura ku kindi kinyabiziga uvugije ihoni
options.en: You must overtake the other vehicle while sounding the horn
None of the answers is correct

explain.rw: Umuyobozi ntashobora gutangira kunyuranaho igihe uwo umukurikiye yamaze gutangira kumunyuraho, kuko bombi bahurira mu gice kimwe cy’umuhanda bikaba byateza impanuka. Icyo gihe aguma mu gice cye, akegera iburyo kandi ntiyongere umuvuduko.
explain.en: A driver must not start overtaking when a driver behind him has already begun to overtake him, because both would end up in the same part of the road and could collide. He must stay in his position, keep to the right and not speed up.

q.rw: Utwaye ikinyabiziga mu muhanda ufite ibyerekezo bibiri. Ikinyabiziga imbere yawe cyiragenda buhoro, imbere yawe umuhanda nta kibazo cyo kunyuranaho, ugomba:
q.en: You are driving on a two-way road. The vehicle in front of you is moving slowly and the road ahead is clear for overtaking. You must:

options.rw: Kucyinyuraho ukoresheje uruhande urwo arirwo rwose
options.en: Overtake it on whichever side you like
All of the answers are correct

explain.rw: Kubera ko mu Rwanda bagendera iburyo, kunyuranaho bikorerwa ibumoso bw’ikinyabiziga unyuraho, igihe umuhanda uri imbere nta kibazo. Kunyura iburyo birabujijwe uretse mu bihe byihariye, nk’igihe ikinyabiziga kiri imbere cyerekanye ko kigiye gukata ibumoso.
explain.en: Because traffic in Rwanda keeps to the right, overtaking is done on the left of the vehicle being overtaken, when the road ahead is clear. Overtaking on the right is forbidden except in special cases, such as when the vehicle in front has signalled that it is turning left.

q.rw: Ibice by’umuhanda byera bigari biteganye n’umurongo ugabanya umuhanda mo kabiri bisobanura:
q.en: Wide white stripes on the road, parallel to the line dividing the road in two, mean:

options.en: Giving vehicles the right to pass
All of the answers are correct

explain.rw: Imirongo yera migari isizwe mu muhanda iteganye n’umurongo wo hagati (izwi nka ‘zebra’) igaragaza aho abanyamaguru bambukira. Umuyobozi ugeze aho agomba kugabanya umuvuduko no guha inzira abanyamaguru bari kwambuka. Ikimenyetso cyo guhagarara cyo ni umurongo umwe wera ukingamye umuhanda.
explain.en: Wide white stripes painted parallel to the centre line (a ‘zebra’ crossing) mark the place where pedestrians cross. A driver approaching must slow down and give way to pedestrians crossing. A stop line, by contrast, is a single white line across the lane.

q.rw: Uturebanyuma dukoreshwa:
q.en: Rear-view mirrors are used:

options.en: To check the traffic behind you
To watch the passengers in the back
None of the answers is correct

explain.rw: Uturebanyuma (indorerwamo) dufasha umuyobozi kubona no kugenzura ibinyabiziga n’abandi bakoresha umuhanda bari inyuma ye cyangwa ku mpande, cyane cyane mbere yo kunyuranaho, guhindura igisate cyangwa guhagarara. Ntitugenewe kwireba cyangwa kureba abagenzi.
explain.en: Rear-view mirrors let the driver see and check the vehicles and other road users behind and beside him, especially before overtaking, changing lane or stopping. They are not for looking at yourself or watching passengers.

q.rw: Kuki abanyamaguru batemerewe kwambuka umuhanda mu ikoni cyangwa hafi y’imodoka ihagaze?
q.en: Why are pedestrians not allowed to cross the road on a bend or close to a stationary vehicle?

options.en: Because of the effect on other vehicles
Because of the effect on other road users

options.rw: Abandi bayobozi b’ibinyabiziga baza bashobora kutabona abambuka umuhanda
options.en: Approaching drivers may not see the people crossing the road
All of the answers are correct

explain.rw: Mu ikoni cyangwa inyuma y’imodoka ihagaze, abayobozi baza ntibabona neza umunyamaguru kandi nawe ntababona. Niyo mpamvu abanyamaguru bagomba kwambukira ahantu hagaragara neza, kugira ngo abayobozi babone umwanya wo kubabona no guhagarara.
explain.en: On a bend or behind a stationary vehicle, approaching drivers cannot see the pedestrian clearly, and the pedestrian cannot see them. That is why pedestrians must cross where there is good visibility, so that drivers have time to see them and stop.

q.rw: Kunyuranaho mu ikoni:
q.en: Overtaking on a bend:

options.en: All of the answers are correct

explain.rw: Mu ikoni umuyobozi ntabona kure imbere ye, bityo ntashobora kumenya niba hari ikinyabiziga kiza. Kunyuranaho mu ikoni ntibyemewe, n’iyo wakwitonda, kuko ubwitonzi butakuraho ko utabona ibiri imbere.
explain.en: On a bend the driver cannot see far ahead, so he cannot know whether a vehicle is coming. Overtaking on a bend is not allowed, even carefully, because care does not make up for being unable to see ahead.

q.rw: Umuyobozi w’ikinyabiziga igihe atwaye ikinyabiziga akagira umunaniro utuma yasinzira yakora iki?
q.en: What should a driver do when, while driving, he becomes so tired that he could fall asleep?

options.rw: Gufungura ikirahure cy’ikinyabiziga cyangwa gushyira ubukonje mu modoka kugira ngo umwuka mwiza winjire mu kinyabiziga
options.en: Open the window or turn on the air conditioning to let fresh air into the vehicle

options.rw: Guhagarara akaruhuka harimo no kugendagenda niba bishoboka
options.en: Stop and rest, including walking about if possible

options.rw: Kunanura amaboko no gufunga amaso mu gihe gito
options.en: Stretch the arms and close the eyes for a moment
Turn up the heating in the vehicle

explain.rw: Umunaniro ukomeye utuma umuyobozi asinzira akanya gato ari gutwara, bigateza impanuka. Umuti nyawo ni uguhagarara ahantu hatekanye akaruhuka, akagendagenda niba bishoboka. Gufungura ikirahure bimara akanya gato gusa, kandi gufunga amaso utwaye cyangwa kongera ubushyuhe byongera ibyago.
explain.en: Severe tiredness can make a driver fall asleep for a moment at the wheel and cause a crash. The real remedy is to stop somewhere safe and rest, walking about if possible. Opening the window helps only briefly, while closing your eyes at the wheel or turning up the heating makes things worse.

q.rw: Niki umuyobozi w’ikinyabiziga yakora igihe atwaye ikinyabiziga mu gihe cy’ibihu, imvura nyinshi, umwuzure cyangwa umukungugu mwinshi?
q.en: What should a driver do when driving in fog, heavy rain, flooding or thick dust?

options.rw: Kugendera mu tuyira turi ku mpande z’umuhanda, ucunga ibimenyetso bigarura urumuri
options.en: Drive on the tracks at the sides of the road, following the reflective markers

options.rw: Kugabanya umuvuduko hanyuma ugakoresha amatara magufi
options.en: Reduce speed and use dipped headlights

options.rw: Gucana amatara maremare hanyuma ukagenda gahoro
options.en: Switch on main-beam headlights and drive slowly

options.rw: Kugendera mu murongo ugabanya umuhanda mo kabiri unareba ibimenyetso by’umuhanda bigarura urumuri
options.en: Drive along the centre line, watching the road’s reflective markers

explain.rw: Mu bihu, imvura nyinshi cyangwa umukungugu, umuyobozi atabona kure, bityo agomba kugabanya umuvuduko kugira ngo abashe guhagarara mu ntera abona. Amatara magufi (yo kubisikana) amurikira umuhanda atagarura urumuri mu maso; amatara maremare yo agarurwa n’ibihu cyangwa imvura akamuhuma. Kugendera ku murongo wo hagati cyangwa ku nkengero ni ukwishyira mu kaga.
explain.en: In fog, heavy rain or dust the driver cannot see far, so he must slow down to be able to stop within the distance he can see. Dipped headlights light the road without glare, whereas main-beam light is reflected back by fog or rain and dazzles the driver. Driving on the centre line or on the verges is dangerous.

q.rw: Muri ibi byapa ni ubuhe bwoko bw’ibyapa bitegeka byo mu muhanda?
q.en: Which of these are the regulatory (mandatory) road signs?

options.rw: Ibiri mu ishusho y’urukiramende n’umuzenguruko w’umuhondo
options.en: Rectangular signs with a yellow border

options.rw: Ibiri mu ishusho ya mpande eshatu n’umuzenguruko mu ibara ry’ubururu
options.en: Triangular signs with a blue border

options.rw: Ibiri mu ishusho y’uruziga n’umuzenguruko mu ibara ry’umutuku
options.en: Circular signs with a red border

options.rw: Ibiri mu ishusho ya mpande enye zingana mu buso bw’umukara
options.en: Square signs on a black background

explain.rw: Ibyapa by’amabwiriza (bibuza n’ibitegeka) bigira ishusho y’uruziga; mu bisubizo byatanzwe, uruziga rufite umuzenguruko utukura ni rwo rwemewe. Menya ko ibyapa bibuza ari uruziga rufite umuzenguruko utukura, naho ibitegeka ibintu runaka byo ari uruziga rw’ubururu rufite ikirango cyera. Ishusho ya mpandeshatu ni iy’ibyapa biburira.
explain.en: Regulatory signs (prohibitory and mandatory) are circular; among the options given, the circle with a red border is the accepted answer. Note that prohibitory signs are circles with a red border, while signs ordering a specific action are blue circles with a white symbol. Triangles are used for warning signs.

q.rw: Ugeze mu masangano y’umuhanda aho usanga ibimenyetso bimurika bidakora, wakora iki igihe umukozi ubifitiye ububasha aguhaye iki kimenyetso?
q.en: You arrive at an intersection where the traffic lights are not working. What should you do when an authorised officer gives you this signal?

options.en: Turn right only, then continue ahead

options.rw: Guhagarara ku murongo wo guhagarara umwanya muto

explain.rw: Umukozi ubifitiye ububasha uzamuye ukuboko hejuru aba asaba abakoresha umuhanda bose bamugana guhagarara, uretse abamaze kwinjira mu masangano bagomba kuyavamo. Ugomba guhagarara ku murongo wo guhagarara. Ibimenyetso by’umukozi ubifitiye ububasha biruta ibimenyetso bimurika n’ibyapa.
explain.en: An authorised officer raising his arm vertically is telling all road users approaching him to stop, except those already in the intersection, who must clear it. You must stop at the stop line. Signals given by an authorised officer override traffic lights and signs.

q.rw: Amatara ndangacyerekezo agomba kugaragara nijoro igihe ijuru rikeye mu ntera nibura ya:
q.en: At night in clear weather, direction indicators must be visible from a distance of at least:

explain.rw: Amatara ndangacyerekezo amenyesha abandi bakoresha umuhanda icyerekezo ugiye gufata, bityo agomba kugaragara kure bihagije. Nk’uko igisubizo cyemewe kibivuga, nijoro igihe ijuru rikeye agomba kugaragara mu ntera nibura ya metero 150.
explain.en: Direction indicators tell other road users which way you are about to go, so they must be visible from far enough away. According to the official answer, at night in clear weather they must be visible from at least 150 metres.

q.rw: Umurongo ucagaguye uvuga ko buri muyobozi abujijwe kuwurenga uretse mu gihe:
q.en: A broken line means that every driver is forbidden to cross it, except when:

options.en: He has to overtake another vehicle

options.rw: Guhindukira cyangwa kujya mu kindi gice cy’umuhanda
options.en: Turning round or moving into another lane
All of these answers are correct

explain.rw: Umurongo wera ucagaguye ugabanya ibisate by’umuhanda, kandi ubusanzwe umuyobozi aguma mu gisate cye. Ariko bitandukanye n’umurongo udacagaguye, ushobora kuwurenga igihe ukora igikorwa kibimusaba: kunyuranaho, gukatira ibumoso, guhindukira cyangwa kujya mu kindi gisate, igihe nta kaga.
explain.en: A broken white line separates lanes, and normally a driver stays in his lane. Unlike a continuous line, however, it may be crossed when a manoeuvre requires it: overtaking, turning left, turning round or changing lane, provided it is safe.

q.rw: Igice cy’inzira nyabagendwa kigarukira ku mirongo ibiri yera icagaguye ibangikanye kandi gifite ubugari budahagije kugira ngo imodoka zitambuke neza kiba ari:
q.en: A part of the public road bounded by two parallel broken white lines, and not wide enough for cars to pass properly, is:

options.rw: A na B byose ni ukuri
options.en: A and B are both correct
None of the answers is correct

explain.rw: Agahanda k’amagare gashobora kugaragazwa n’imirongo ibiri yera icagaguye ibangikanye isizwe mu muhanda, kandi ubugari bwako ntibuhagije ngo imodoka zigendemo. Kagenewe amagare (n’ibinyamitende byemerewe); imodoka ntizigomba kukagendamo.
explain.en: A cycle lane can be marked on the road by two parallel broken white lines, and its width is not enough for cars to use it. It is intended for bicycles (and the cycles allowed on it); cars must not drive in it.

q.rw: Icyapa kimenyesha kugendera mu muhanda ubisikanirwamo gifite:
q.en: The sign warning of two-way traffic (a road where you meet oncoming vehicles) has:

options.rw: Ishusho y’uruziga mu ibara ritukura, ubuso bwera n’ikirango cy’umukara
options.en: A circle with a red border, a white background and a black symbol

options.rw: Ishusho ya mpandeshatu mu ibara ritukura, ubuso bwera n’ikirango cy’umukara
options.en: A triangle with a red border, a white background and a black symbol

options.rw: Ishusho ya mpandeshatu mu ibara ritukura, ubuso bw’ubururu n’ikirango cy’umukara
options.en: A triangle with a red border, a blue background and a black symbol

options.rw: Ishusho y’uruziga mu ibara ritukura, ubuso bw’ubururu n’ikirango cy’umukara
options.en: A circle with a red border, a blue background and a black symbol

explain.rw: Icyapa kimenyesha ko umuhanda ugendwamo mu byerekezo byombi ni icyapa kiburira, bityo gifite ishusho ya mpandeshatu ifite umuzenguruko utukura, ubuso bwera n’ikirango cy’umukara (imyambi ibiri ireba mu byerekezo bitandukanye). Ishusho y’uruziga ni iy’ibyapa by’amabwiriza, si iy’ibyapa biburira.
explain.en: The sign announcing two-way traffic is a warning sign, so it is a triangle with a red border, a white background and a black symbol (two arrows pointing in opposite directions). Circles are used for regulatory signs, not warning signs.

q.rw: Ikinyabiziga kigendeshwa na moteri n’ikinyabiziga gikururwa n’inyamaswa ntibishobora gukurura:
q.en: A motor vehicle and an animal-drawn vehicle may not tow:

explain.rw: Nk’uko igisubizo cyemewe kibivuga, ikinyabiziga gifite moteri cyangwa igikururwa n’inyamaswa ntigishobora gukurura ibinyabiziga birenze bibiri. Uwo mubare ureba ibinyabiziga byose bikururwa, byaba bipakiye cyangwa bidapakiye, niyo mpamvu igisubizo kivuga ‘bipakiye’ gusa kidahagije.
explain.en: According to the official answer, a motor vehicle or an animal-drawn vehicle may not tow more than two vehicles. The limit applies to all towed vehicles, loaded or not, which is why the option mentioning only ‘loaded’ vehicles is not enough.

q.rw: Iki cyapa kivuga:
q.en: This sign means:

options.rw: Inkomane y’aho umuhanda umwe urasukira iburyo
options.en: Junction where a side road joins from the right

options.rw: A na B ni ibisubizo by’ukuri

options.en: None of the answers is correct

explain.rw: Iki cyapa kiburira kigaragaza imirongo ibiri y’umuhanda yegerana ku mpande zombi: gisobanura ko umuhanda ufunganye ku mpande zombi. Ntigisobanura amasangano cyangwa inkomane, bityo nta gisubizo cy’ukuri kirimo.
explain.en: This warning sign shows the two edges of the road coming closer on both sides: it means the road narrows on both sides. It does not mean a junction or a side road, so none of the answers is correct.

sign.rw: Icyapa kiburira ko umuhanda ufunganye ku mpande zombi
sign.en: Warning: road narrows on both sides

q.rw: Iki cyapa gisobanura ibi bikurikira:
q.en: This sign means the following:

options.rw: Gutambuka mbere kw’ibinyabiziga bituruka aho ujya
options.en: Priority for vehicles coming from the direction you are heading (oncoming traffic)

options.rw: A na B ni ibisubizo by’ukuri

options.en: None of the answers is correct

explain.rw: Iki ni icyapa cyo gutambuka mbere gifite ishusho y’uruziga n’umuzenguruko utukura, kigaragaza imyambi ibiri: umwambi utukura ugana imbere ni uwawe, umwirabura ugaruka ni uw’ibinyabiziga biturutse imbere. Kivuga ko ahantu hafunganye ugomba guha inzira ibinyabiziga biturutse aho ujya. Icyapa kibuza kunyuranaho cyo kigaragaza imodoka ebyiri.
explain.en: This is a priority sign shaped as a circle with a red border, showing two arrows: the red arrow pointing ahead is yours, the black one coming towards you is the oncoming traffic. It means that on the narrow stretch you must give way to vehicles coming from the opposite direction. The no-overtaking sign shows two cars instead.

sign.rw: Icyapa cyo gutambuka mbere kw’ibinyabiziga biturutse imbere (guha inzira ibinyabiziga biturutse imbere)
sign.en: Priority to oncoming traffic (give way to oncoming vehicles)

q.rw: Utugarurarumuri turi ku ruhande rw’imbere rw’ikinyabiziga tugomba gusa:
q.en: Reflectors on the front of a vehicle must be coloured:

options.en: None of the answers is correct

explain.rw: Utugarurarumuri tw’imbere tugomba kuba umweru kugira ngo abakoresha umuhanda bamenye ko babona imbere y’ikinyabiziga. Utw’inyuma ni umutuku, naho utw’impande ni umuhondo. Ayo mabara afasha abandi kumenya icyerekezo ikinyabiziga kirimo nijoro.
explain.en: Front reflectors must be white so that other road users can tell they are seeing the front of the vehicle. Rear reflectors are red and side reflectors amber. These colours help others tell which way a vehicle is facing at night.

q.rw: Iki cyapa kivuga:
q.en: This sign means:

options.rw: Gutambuka mbere kw’ibinyabiziga biturutse imbere aho ujya
options.en: Priority for vehicles coming from the direction you are heading
Priority over vehicles coming from the opposite direction
None of the answers is correct

explain.rw: Icyapa cy’urukiramende cy’ubururu gifite umwambi wera ugana imbere n’umwambi utukura ugaruka kimenyesha ko ahantu hafunganye ari wowe utambuka mbere y’ibinyabiziga biturutse imbere. Ni cyo gihabanye n’icyapa cy’uruziga gitegeka guha inzira ibinyabiziga biturutse imbere. N’ubwo bimeze bityo, ugomba gukomeza kwitonda.
explain.en: The blue rectangular sign with a white arrow pointing ahead and a red arrow coming towards you means that on the narrow stretch you have priority over oncoming vehicles. It is the counterpart of the circular sign that orders you to give way to oncoming traffic. You must still take care.

sign.rw: Icyapa kimenyesha gutambuka mbere y’ibinyabiziga biturutse imbere

q.rw: Iki cyapa kigizwe:
q.en: This sign consists of:

options.en: None of the answers is correct

explain.rw: Iki ni icyapa kiburira (inkomane y’umuhanda uturuka iburyo). Ibyapa biburira bigira ishusho ya mpandeshatu, ubuso bwera n’ikirango cy’umukara, bikagira n’umuzenguruko utukura. Nta cyapa kiburira kigira ubuso bw’ubururu cyangwa bw’umukara.
explain.en: This is a warning sign (side road joining from the right). Warning signs are triangles with a white background and a black symbol, with a red border. No warning sign has a blue or black background.

sign.rw: Icyapa kiburira: inkomane y’umuhanda uturuka iburyo
sign.en: Warning: side road joining from the right

q.rw: Iki cyapa kivuga:
q.en: This sign means:

options.rw: Ifungana ry’umuhanda w’akayira gasatira umuhanda ibumoso

options.en: None of the answers is correct

explain.rw: Kuri iki cyapa kiburira, umurongo w’ibumoso ni wo wegera hagati naho uw’iburyo ugakomeza ugororotse: bisobanura ko umuhanda ufunganye uturutse ibumoso. Iyo umurongo w’iburyo ari wo wegera hagati, umuhanda uba ufunganye iburyo.
explain.en: On this warning sign the left-hand edge bends inwards while the right-hand edge stays straight: it means the road narrows on the left. When it is the right-hand edge that bends in, the road narrows on the right.

sign.rw: Icyapa kiburira ko umuhanda ufunganye ibumoso
sign.en: Warning: road narrows on the left

q.rw: Umuyobozi ubonye ko hari undi umukurikiye ashaka kumunyuraho agomba kubahiriza ibi bikurikira:
q.en: A driver who sees that someone behind wants to overtake him must do the following:

options.en: Keep close to the right-hand side of the road

options.rw: A na C ni byo bisubizo by’ukuri

explain.rw: Umuyobozi unyurwaho agomba korohereza umunyuraho: yegera uko bishoboka kose uruhande rw’iburyo bw’umuhanda kandi ntiyongere umuvuduko. Ntasabwa guhagarara, kuko guhagarara bitunguranye byateza impanuka.
explain.en: A driver being overtaken must make it easier for the overtaking driver: he keeps as far to the right as possible and does not speed up. He is not required to stop, since stopping suddenly could cause a crash.

q.rw: Iki cyapa cyerekana:
q.en: This sign shows:

options.rw: Ifungana ry’umuhanda n’akayira gasatira umuhanda ibumoso

options.en: None of the answers is correct

explain.rw: Kuri iki cyapa umurongo w’iburyo ni wo wegera hagati: gisobanura ko umuhanda ufunganye iburyo. ‘Ifungana ry’umuhanda’ risobanurwa n’icyapa kigaragaza imirongo yombi yegerana, naho ifungana ry’ibumoso ryo rigaragazwa n’umurongo w’ibumoso. Kubera ko ifungana ry’iburyo ritari mu bisubizo, nta gisubizo cy’ukuri kirimo.
explain.en: On this sign the right-hand edge bends inwards: it means the road narrows on the right. ‘Road narrows’ is shown by the sign with both edges coming in, and narrowing on the left by the left edge bending. Since narrowing on the right is not offered, none of the answers is correct.

sign.rw: Icyapa kiburira ko umuhanda ufunganye iburyo
sign.en: Warning: road narrows on the right

q.rw: Iki cyapa gisobanura:
q.en: This sign means:

options.en: None of the answers is correct

explain.rw: Uruziga rufite umuzenguruko utukura n’ubuso bwera butagira ikirango ni icyapa kibuza ibinyabiziga byose kuhanyura mu byerekezo byombi. Icyerekezo kimwe kigaragazwa n’ibindi byapa, kandi uburenganzira bw’abahatuye bwandikwa ku cyapa cy’inyongera.
explain.en: A circle with a red border and a plain white background is the sign closing the road to all vehicles in both directions. One-way traffic is shown by other signs, and an exception for residents would be written on an additional panel.

sign.rw: Icyapa kibuza ibinyabiziga byose kunyura mu byerekezo byombi
sign.en: Closed to all vehicles in both directions

q.rw: Iki cyapa cyerekana:
q.en: This sign shows:

options.en: None of the answers is correct

explain.rw: Icyapa kiburira kirimo akamenyetso k’ugutangara (!) kiburira ibindi byago bitagira icyapa cyabyo cyihariye. Ifungana ry’umuhanda, umuhanda unyerera n’umuhanda utaringaniye bifite ibyapa byabyo bifite amashusho yihariye, bityo nta gisubizo cy’ukuri kirimo.
explain.en: The warning sign with an exclamation mark warns of other dangers that have no specific sign of their own. Road narrowing, slippery road and uneven road each have their own sign with a specific symbol, so none of the answers is correct.

q.rw: Iki cyapa kivuga:
q.en: This sign means:

options.rw: B na C byose ni ukuri
options.en: B and C are both correct

explain.rw: Icyapa kiburira kirimo umurongo ugoramye ugana iburyo kimenyesha ko imbere hari ikoni riri iburyo; ugomba kugabanya umuvuduko mbere yo kurigeramo. Akazamuko n’akamanuko bigaragazwa n’ibyapa biriho imodoka ku musozi n’ijanisha.
explain.en: The warning sign with a line curving to the right announces a bend to the right ahead; you must slow down before reaching it. Steep ascents and descents are shown by signs with a slope and a percentage.

q.rw: Iyo umuhanda ugabanijemo ibisate bibiri kandi ugendwamo mu byerekezo byombi umuyobozi abujijwe:
q.en: When a road is divided into two lanes and carries traffic in both directions, the driver is forbidden to:

options.en: All of the answers are correct

explain.rw: Mu muhanda w’ibisate bibiri ugendwamo mu byerekezo byombi, igisate cy’ibumoso ni icy’ibinyabiziga biturutse imbere. Umuyobozi abujijwe kukigenderamo; akijyamo gusa by’akanya gato igihe anyuranaho, iyo ntacyo bibangamiye. Kunyuranaho ubwabyo ntibibujijwe.
explain.en: On a two-lane road carrying traffic in both directions, the left-hand lane belongs to oncoming traffic. The driver is forbidden to drive in it; he enters it only briefly to overtake when it is safe. Overtaking itself is not forbidden.

q.rw: Icyapa cyerekana inzira y’amatungo itegetswe giteye:
q.en: What does the sign for a mandatory path for livestock look like?

options.rw: Uruziga mu buso bw’ubururu, ishusho y’inka mu ibara ry’umukara
options.en: A circle with a blue background and a black cow symbol

options.rw: Uruziga mu ibara ryera, ishusho y’inka mu ibara ry’ubururu
options.en: A white circle with a blue cow symbol

options.rw: Uruziga mu buso bw’ibara ry’ubururu, ishusho y’inka mu ibara ryera n’ikirango cy’umukara
options.en: A circle with a blue background, a white cow symbol and a black emblem

options.rw: Mpande eshatu mu buso bw’ibara ry’umweru n’ishusho y’inka mu ibara ry’umukara
options.en: A triangle with a white background and a black cow symbol

explain.rw: Igisubizo cyemewe ni icyapa cya mpandeshatu gifite ubuso bwera n’ishusho y’inka y’umukara (gifite n’umuzenguruko utukura): kiburira ko amatungo ashobora kuba ari mu muhanda cyangwa ari kwambuka, bityo ugomba kugabanya umuvuduko. Menya ko ibyapa bitegeka inzira runaka ubusanzwe ari uruziga rw’ubururu rufite ikirango cyera.
explain.en: The accepted answer is the triangular sign with a white background and a black cow (with a red border): it warns that livestock may be on or crossing the road, so you must slow down. Note that signs ordering a specific path are normally blue circles with a white symbol.

q.rw: Icyapa cyerekana ko bibujijwe kuvuza amahoni kirangwa na:
q.en: The sign showing that sounding the horn is prohibited is identified by:

options.rw: Ishusho y’uruziga, ubuso bw’ubururu, ikiranga cy’umukara
options.en: A circle, blue background, black symbol

options.rw: Ishusho y’uruziga, ubuso bw’ubururu, ikiranga cy’umweru
options.en: A circle, blue background, white symbol

options.rw: Ishusho y’uruziga, ubuso bw’umweru, ikiranga cy’umukara
options.en: A circle, white background, black symbol
None of the answers is correct

explain.rw: Icyapa kibuza kuvuza ihoni ni icyapa kibuza: uruziga rufite umuzenguruko utukura, ubuso bwera n’ikiranga cy’umukara (ihoni ryambukiranyijwe n’umurongo utukura). Uruziga rufite ubuso bw’ubururu ni urw’ibyapa bitegeka, si urw’ibibuza.
explain.en: The no-horn sign is a prohibitory sign: a circle with a red border, a white background and a black symbol (a horn crossed by a red bar). Circles with a blue background are mandatory signs, not prohibitory ones.

q.rw: Ibyapa biburira n’ibyo gutambuka mbere birangwa:
q.en: Warning signs and priority signs are identified by:

options.rw: Ishusho mpandeshatu mu ibara ritukura, ubuso bwera n’ikiranga mu ibara ry’umukara
options.en: A triangle with a red border, a white background and a black symbol

options.rw: Ishusho mpandeshatu mu ibara ritukura, ubuso bw’ubururu n’ikiranga mu ibara ry’umukara
options.en: A triangle with a red border, a blue background and a black symbol

options.rw: Ishusho y’uruziga mu ibara ritukura, ubuso bw’ubururu n’ikiranga mu ibara ry’umukara
options.en: A circle with a red border, a blue background and a black symbol

options.rw: Ishusho y’uruziga mu ibara ritukura, ubuso bwera n’ikiranga mu ibara ry’umukara
options.en: A circle with a red border, a white background and a black symbol

explain.rw: Ibyapa biburira, kimwe n’ibyapa bimwe byo gutambuka mbere (nk’icyapa kimenyesha gutambuka mbere mu masangano akurikira), bigira ishusho ya mpandeshatu ifite umuzenguruko utukura, ubuso bwera n’ikiranga cy’umukara. Uruziga rufite umuzenguruko utukura ubusanzwe ni urw’ibyapa bibuza. Hari ibyapa byo gutambuka mbere bifite ishusho yihariye, nka ‘STOP’ (ishusho ya mpande umunani).
explain.en: Warning signs, and some priority signs (such as priority at the next junction), are triangles with a red border, a white background and a black symbol. A circle with a red border is usually a prohibitory sign. Several priority signs have their own special shape, such as STOP (an octagon).

q.rw: Ibyapa bibuza n’ibitegeka bikurikizwa gusa:
q.en: Prohibitory and mandatory signs apply only:

options.rw: A na B ni ibisubizo by’ukuri

options.en: None of the answers is correct

explain.rw: Ibyapa bibuza n’ibitegeka bikurikizwa aho bishyizwe ku muhanda, bitareba amasangano cyangwa ibimenyetso bimurika gusa. Urugero, icyapa kibuza kunyuranaho cyangwa kigena umuvuduko ntarengwa gikurikizwa ku gice cy’umuhanda gishyizweho. Niyo mpamvu nta gisubizo cy’ukuri kirimo.
explain.en: Prohibitory and mandatory signs apply where they are placed on the road, not only at intersections or traffic lights. For example, a no-overtaking or speed-limit sign applies along the stretch of road where it is set up. That is why none of the answers is correct.

q.rw: Ibyapa biburira bibereyeho kumenyesha umugenzi:
q.en: Warning signs exist to inform the road user:

options.en: Of a danger not otherwise described
Of the nature of a sudden danger
None of the answers is correct

explain.rw: Ibyapa biburira bigenewe kumenyesha umukoresha w’umuhanda ko imbere hari icyago, kugira ngo agabanye umuvuduko kandi yitonde. Ikirango kiri ku cyapa ni cyo kigaragaza ubwoko bw’icyo cyago (ikoni, ifungana ry’umuhanda, abanyamaguru...).
