explain.en: Warning signs exist to tell the road user that there is a danger ahead, so that he slows down and takes care. The symbol on the sign shows what kind of danger it is (bend, road narrowing, pedestrians, and so on).

q.rw: Ibyapa by’inyongera bishobora kumenyesha:
q.en: Additional panels can indicate:

options.rw: Ubugerure cyangwa amarengamategeko rusange cyangwa ibibujijwe ndetse n’ibitegetswe byihariye
options.en: Limits of, or exceptions to, the general rules, or specific prohibitions and obligations

options.rw: A na B ni ibisubizo by’ukuri

options.en: None of the answers is correct

explain.rw: Ibyapa by’inyongera bishyirwa munsi y’ibindi byapa kugira ngo bisobanure neza icyo bivuga: bishobora kugaragaza aho itegeko rigarukira, ibitarebwa naryo, cyangwa ibibujijwe n’ibitegetswe byihariye (nk’amasaha cyangwa ubwoko bw’ibinyabiziga). Igisubizo kivuga ‘ibitegetswe byihariye gusa’ ni gito cyane.
explain.en: Additional panels are placed under other signs to make their meaning precise: they can show the limits of a rule, exceptions to it, or specific prohibitions and obligations (such as times or types of vehicle). The option saying ‘specific obligations only’ is too narrow.

q.rw: Ishusho y’icyapa kivuga “ugukikira bitegetswe” ni:
q.en: The shape of the sign meaning “mandatory passing side” (keep left / keep right) is:

options.en: None of the answers is correct

explain.rw: ‘Ugukikira bitegetswe’ (kunyura ku ruhande rwerekanywe n’umwambi) ni icyapa gitegeka. Ibyapa bitegeka bigira ishusho y’uruziga (rw’ubururu rufite ikirango cyera). Mpandeshatu ni iy’ibyapa biburira, naho urukiramende ni urw’ibyapa bitanga amakuru.
explain.en: ‘Mandatory passing side’ (pass on the side shown by the arrow) is a mandatory sign. Mandatory signs are circular (blue with a white symbol). Triangles are for warning signs and rectangles for information signs.

q.rw: Icyapa kivuga “icyerekezo gitegetswe” kigizwe n’ikirango cy’ibara:
q.en: The “mandatory direction” sign consists of a symbol of which colour?

explain.rw: Icyapa ‘icyerekezo gitegetswe’ ni icyapa gitegeka: uruziga rw’ubururu rufite ikirango (umwambi) cy’umweru kigaragaza icyerekezo ugomba gufata. Umutuku ukoreshwa ku byapa bibuza n’ibiburira, naho umukara ku birango by’ibyo byapa.
explain.en: The ‘mandatory direction’ sign is a mandatory sign: a blue circle with a white symbol (arrow) showing the direction you must take. Red is used on prohibitory and warning signs, and black for the symbols on those signs.

q.rw: Iki kimenyetso gitanzwe n’umukozi ubifitiye ububasha cyo guhagarara :
q.en: This signal given by an authorised officer means stop for:

options.en: Road users coming towards him from the front

options.rw: ku bakoresha umuhanda bose bamuturutse imbere n’inyuma
options.en: All road users coming from in front of him and from behind him

options.rw: ku bakoresha umuhanda bose bamuturutse inyuma
options.en: All road users coming from behind him
None of the answers is correct

explain.rw: Iyo umukozi ubifitiye ububasha azamuye ukuboko hejuru, aba ategeka abakoresha umuhanda bose guhagarara, baba bamuturutse imbere cyangwa inyuma, keretse abari basanzwe mu masangano. Iki kimenyetso ntikireba uruhande rumwe gusa, niyo mpamvu a na c bituzuye.
explain.en: When an authorised officer raises an arm vertically, all road users must stop, whether they are coming from in front of him or from behind him, except those already inside the junction. The signal is not limited to one direction, which is why a and c are incomplete.

q.rw: Ibi byapa byo mu muhanda birambuza kunyuranaho ibumoso ?
q.en: Do these road signs forbid me to overtake on the left?

options.en: Yes, if you are driving at 90 km/h
None of the answers is correct

explain.rw: Icyapa cy’uruziga gifite umupaka utukura kigaragaza imodoka itukura iri iruhande rw’imodoka y’umukara kibuza kunyuranaho, kandi hano gishyizwe ku mpande zombi z’umuhanda. Kibuza kunyuranaho (bikorerwa ibumoso) uko umuvuduko waba ungana kose; icyapa cya 90 kigena gusa umuvuduko ntarengwa.
explain.en: The round red-bordered sign showing a red car next to a black car is the no-overtaking sign, placed here on both sides of the road. It forbids overtaking (which is done on the left) whatever your speed; the 90 sign only sets the maximum speed.

q.rw: Umuhanda urombereje w’ibice byinshi. Ndashaka kunyura kuri izi kamyo ibyiri mugihe gito ibumoso icyarimwe, biremewe ?
q.en: On a motorway: I want to overtake both of these lorries on the left in one quick manoeuvre. Is this allowed?

options.en: Yes, if it is done on the left
None of the answers is correct

explain.rw: Ku muhanda urombereje w’ibice byinshi, wemerewe kunyura ku binyabiziga bibiri icyarimwe ukoresheje igisate cy’ibumoso, igihe cyose icyo gisate kidafite ikinyabiziga kandi ufite umwanya uhagije. Ugaruka iburyo ari uko umaze kubirenga byombi mu mutekano.
explain.en: On a motorway with several lanes you may overtake two vehicles in a single manoeuvre using the left-hand lane, as long as that lane is clear and you have enough room. Move back to the right only once you have safely passed both.

q.rw: K’umuyobozi w’ivatiri, iki cyapa kivuze iki ?
q.en: For the driver of a car, what does this sign mean?

options.en: It restricts me to a speed of 5 km/h

options.rw: ntaburenganzira kimpa, mugihe gikurikizwa ku binyabiziga bifite hejuru ya toni 5
options.en: It does not let me through, as it applies to vehicles of more than 5 tonnes

options.rw: ntacyo bindebaho mugihe bireba gusa zipima tone 5 no kurengaho.
options.en: It does not concern me, as it applies only to vehicles weighing 5 tonnes or more
None of the answers is correct

explain.rw: Icyapa cy’uruziga gifite umupaka utukura cyanditseho "5t" kibuza kwinjira ibinyabiziga bifite uburemere burenze toni 5. Ivatiri isanzwe ntigera kuri ubwo buremere, bityo icyo cyapa ntikiyireba. Ntabwo ari icyapa cy’umuvuduko.
explain.en: A round red-bordered sign showing "5 t" bars vehicles weighing more than 5 tonnes. An ordinary car is much lighter, so the sign does not apply to it. It is a weight limit, not a speed limit.

sign.rw: Icyapa kibuza kwinjira ibinyabiziga bifite uburemere burenze toni 5
sign.en: No entry for vehicles over 5 tonnes (weight limit)

q.rw: Ndashaka gukata iburyo. Biremewe ?
q.en: I want to turn right. Is it allowed?

options.en: None of the answers is correct

explain.rw: Icyapa cy’uruziga gifite umupaka utukura n’umwambi ukatira iburyo uciyeho umurongo kibuza gukata iburyo. Ibimenyetso bimurika bifite umwambi w’icyatsi werekeza imbere gusa, nta mwambi w’iburyo uhari, bityo gukata iburyo ntibyemewe n’iyo wabanza guhagarara.
explain.en: The round red-bordered sign with a crossed-out right-turn arrow prohibits turning right. The traffic light shows a green arrow for straight ahead only and no right arrow, so turning right is not allowed, even after stopping.

q.rw: Umuhanda wambukiranya inzira ya gariyamoshi
q.en: A road crossing a railway line (level crossing):

options.rw: nshobora gukomeza nkambuka umuhanda kubera ko uruzitiro rufunguye
options.en: I may carry on across because the barrier is open

options.rw: ngomba guhagarara munsi yitara ry’umutuku rimyatsa
options.en: I must stop at the flashing red light

options.rw: ntabwo nakomeza urugendo rwanjye. Ngomba gihita mpagarara
options.en: I cannot continue my journey; I must stop immediately
None of the answers is correct

explain.rw: Itara ry’umutuku rimyatsa ku nkomane y’umuhanda n’inzira ya gariyamoshi risobanura ko gariyamoshi yegereje: ugomba guhagarara aho itara riri, mbere y’inzira ya gariyamoshi, n’iyo uruzitiro rwaba rutaramanuka. Ntibisaba gufata feri ako kanya aho uri hose; uhagarara mu mutekano imbere y’itara.
explain.en: A flashing red light at a level crossing means a train is approaching: you must stop at the light, before the tracks, even if the barrier is not yet down. You are not required to brake abruptly wherever you are; you stop safely in front of the light.

q.rw: Kuri iki cyapa cyo mu muhanda cyambere kintegeka ?
q.en: What does the first road sign here require of me?

options.en: To drive at a speed above 30 km/h
Not to exceed a speed of 30 km/h

options.rw: birabujijwe kugendera kumuvuduko uri hejuru ya 30km/h
options.en: Driving faster than 30 km/h is forbidden
None of the answers is correct

explain.rw: Icyapa cyanditseho "ZONE" gifite uruziga rutukura rwa 30 cyerekana ko winjiye mu gace aho umuvuduko ntarengwa ari 30 km/h. Birabujijwe kugendera ku muvuduko urenze 30 km/h kugeza ubonye icyapa gisoza ako gace; si umuvuduko muto ntarengwa.
explain.en: The "ZONE 30" sign marks the start of an area where the maximum speed is 30 km/h. Driving faster than 30 km/h is forbidden until you see the end-of-zone sign; it is a maximum, not a minimum speed.

sign.en: Zone 30: start of a 30 km/h maximum speed zone

q.rw: Mpagaze mu murongo wo guhagarara umwanya muto
q.en: I have stopped at the stop line.

options.en: I may turn left or right
None of the answers is correct

explain.rw: Icyapa STOP kigutegeka guhagarara no guha inzira abandi, naho icyapa kiri munsi yacyo kibuza gukata iburyo. Umaze guhagarara no kureba ko nta kinyabiziga kiza, ushobora gukata ibumoso (cyangwa gukomeza imbere), ariko ntushobora gukata iburyo.
explain.en: The STOP sign makes you stop and give way, and the sign below it prohibits turning right. After stopping and checking the way is clear you may turn left (or go straight on), but you may not turn right.

q.rw: Ngomba :
q.en: I must:

options.rw: guhagarara igihe gito kuri icyi cyapa cy’umuhanda
options.en: Stop briefly at this road sign

options.rw: guhagarara ngatanga inzira kuri metero 100 ntaragera kuri icyi cyapa
options.en: Stop and give way 100 m ahead of this sign

options.rw: gutanga inzira nkanahagarara iyo ari ngombwa muri m100 ntaragera kuri icyi cyapa
options.en: Give way, stopping if necessary, 100 m ahead of this sign
None of the answers is correct

explain.rw: Icyapa cya mpandeshatu gicuramye (tanga inzira) gifite akapande kanditseho "STOP 100 m" kiburira ko imbere kuri metero 100 hari icyapa STOP. Aho ngaho ugomba guhagarara byanze bikunze ukabona gutanga inzira; ntabwo ari ugutanga inzira no guhagarara gusa iyo ari ngombwa nk’uko bigenda ku cyapa "tanga inzira" gisanzwe.
explain.en: The inverted triangle (give way) with the panel "STOP 100 m" warns that there is a STOP sign 100 m ahead. There you must come to a complete stop and then give way; it is not just "give way and stop if necessary", which is the rule for an ordinary give-way sign.

sign.rw: Icyapa "tanga inzira" gifite akapande "STOP 100 m": icyapa STOP kiri imbere kuri metero 100
sign.en: Give way sign with "STOP 100 m" panel: STOP sign 100 m ahead

q.rw: Ndashaka kugata ibumoso. Imodoka y’icyatsi yaje irahagarara. Ninde ufite uburenganzira bwo gutambuka mbere?
q.en: I want to turn left. The green car has arrived and stopped. Who has the right of way?

options.en: I have the right of way

options.rw: imodoka y’icyatsi ifite uburenganzira bwo gutambuka mbere
options.en: The green car has the right of way

options.rw: twembi ntaburenganzira bwo gutambuka mbere gusa tugomba gutambukana ubwitonzi
options.en: Neither of us has priority; we must both go through carefully
None of the answers is correct

explain.rw: Aho nta cyapa cyangwa ibimenyetso bimurika bigena uburenganzira bwo gutambuka, ikinyabiziga giturutse iburyo bwawe ni cyo gitambuka mbere. Imodoka y’icyatsi iturutse iburyo bwawe; kuba yahagaze ntibiyambura uburenganzira bwayo, bityo ugomba kuyiha inzira.
explain.en: Where no sign or traffic light sets priority, the vehicle coming from your right goes first. The green car is coming from your right; the fact that it has stopped does not take away its priority, so you must give way to it.

q.rw: Mfite uburenganzira bwo gutambuka muri iri sangano ?
q.en: Do I have the right of way at this junction?

options.en: Yes, if you are turning left
No, if you are turning right
None of the answers is correct

explain.rw: Imodoka igaragara ku ifoto iturutse ibumoso bwawe. Mu masangano adafite icyapa cyangwa ibimenyetso bimurika, ikinyabiziga giturutse ibumoso kigomba guha inzira igituruka iburyo bwacyo, ari cyo cyawe. Ubwo burenganzira ubufite waba ukata ibumoso cyangwa iburyo.
explain.en: The car in the picture is coming from your left. At a junction without signs or traffic lights, a vehicle coming from the left must give way to the one coming from its right, which is you. You keep that priority whether you turn left or right.

q.rw: Ndi kumuvuduko wa 20km/h. nshobora gukomeza muri iri sangano ry’umuhanda?
q.en: I am driving at 20 km/h. May I continue through this junction?

options.rw: yego, nshobora guta ibumoso cyangwa iburyo
options.en: Yes, I may turn left or right
Yes, I may turn left only

explain.rw: Imyambi y’ibumoso n’imbere iri mu mutuku, naho uw’iburyo uri mu muhondo. Itara ry’umuhondo risobanura guhagarara, keretse iyo wegereye cyane ku buryo utabasha guhagarara mu mutekano. Ku muvuduko wa 20 km/h ushobora guhagarara byoroshye, bityo ntiwemerewe gukomeza mu cyerekezo na kimwe.
explain.en: The left and straight-ahead arrows are red and the right arrow is amber. Amber means stop, unless you are so close that you cannot stop safely. At 20 km/h you can easily stop, so you may not continue in any direction.

q.rw: Umuyobozi wikinyabiziga aritegura kunyuraho ibumoso :
q.en: As the driver, I am getting ready to overtake on the left:

options.en: I may overtake him on the right

options.rw: nshobora kumunyura nciye ibumoso ariko mbonye ko mfite umwanya uhagije
options.en: I may overtake him on the left, but only once I see that I have enough room
None of the answers is correct

explain.rw: Kunyuranaho bikorerwa ibumoso; kunyura ku kinyabiziga uciye iburyo byemewe gusa mu bihe bidasanzwe, urugero iyo uri imbere yawe yegereye hagati agiye gukatira ibumoso. Mbere yo kunyuranaho ugomba kureba ko igisate ugiye kujyamo kidafite ikinyabiziga kandi ko ufite umwanya uhagije wo kurangiza no kugaruka iburyo mu mutekano.
explain.en: Overtaking is done on the left; passing on the right is allowed only in special cases, for example when the driver ahead has moved over to turn left. Before overtaking you must check that the lane you are moving into is clear and that you have enough room to pass and return safely to the right.

q.rw: Uhereye kuri ibi byapa habujijwe :
q.en: Based on these signs, what is prohibited?

options.rw: Kunyuranaho kubinyabiziga bikururwa nibinyabiziga birengeje imitende ibiri ibumoso no kugendera kumuvuduko urengeje 70 km/h
options.en: Overtaking drawn vehicles and vehicles with more than two wheels on the left, and driving faster than 70 km/h

options.rw: Kunyuranaho kubinyabiziga bikururwa cyangwa ibinyabiziga birengeje imitende ibiri ibumoso
options.en: Overtaking drawn vehicles or vehicles with more than two wheels on the left
None of the answers is correct

explain.rw: Hari ibyapa bibiri: icya mbere kigena umuvuduko ntarengwa wa 70 km/h, icya kabiri kikabuza kunyura ibumoso ku binyabiziga bifite imitende irenze ibiri n’ibikururwa. Byombi bikurikizwa icyarimwe, niyo mpamvu igisubizo gikubiyemo ibibujijwe byombi ari cyo cy’ukuri; b na c buri cyose kivuga kimwe gusa.
explain.en: There are two signs: the first sets a 70 km/h speed limit and the second prohibits overtaking, on the left, vehicles with more than two wheels and drawn vehicles. Both apply at the same time, so the answer that combines both prohibitions is correct; b and c each give only one of them.

q.rw: Ndashaka gupariki ikinyabiga iburyo kunzira y’abanyamaguru
q.en: I want to park my vehicle on the right, on the pavement (footway).

options.en: It is allowed up to this sign (before it)
It is allowed beyond this sign
It is forbidden both beyond and before this sign
None of the answers is correct

explain.rw: Icyapa P gifite akarango kari munsi yacyo cyemerera guparika ku nzira y’abanyamaguru. Akapande kari munsi y’icyapa gafite umwambi ureba hasi kerekana ko aho icyapa kireba birangirira aho, bityo guparika ku nzira y’abanyamaguru byemewe mbere yo kugera ku cyapa, si nyuma yacyo.
explain.en: This P sign, with the symbol beneath it, allows parking on the pavement. The extra panel with a downward arrow shows that the regulated stretch ends at the sign, so parking on the pavement is allowed on the section before the sign, not beyond it.

sign.rw: Icyapa cya parikingi ku nzira y’abanyamaguru gifite akapande k’umwambi ureba hasi (iherezo ry’aho kireba)
sign.en: Parking on the pavement allowed; downward-arrow panel marks the end of the regulated stretch

q.rw: Iki cyapa gisobanura iki ?
q.en: What does this sign mean?

options.en: Other vehicles must give way to you

options.rw: Gutanga umwanya ku bindi binyabiziga i buryo bwawe
options.en: Give way to vehicles on your right

explain.rw: Icyapa cy’impande umunani gitukura cyanditseho STOP gitegeka guhagarara burundu ku murongo wo guhagarara cyangwa ku nkomane, hanyuma ugaha inzira ibinyabiziga byose bigenda mu muhanda ugiye kwinjiramo. Ntikireba abanyeshuri gusa kandi ntikiguha uburenganzira bwo gutambuka mbere.
explain.en: The red octagonal STOP sign requires you to come to a complete stop at the stop line or the edge of the junction, then give way to all traffic on the road you are entering. It is not specific to school crossings and it never gives you priority.

q.rw: Iki cyapa gisobanura iki mu nkomane ?
q.en: What does this sign mean at a junction?

options.en: Slow down and give way to pedestrians

options.rw: Tanga inzira ku binyabiziga bigenda mu muhanda munini wegera
options.en: Give way to vehicles travelling on the major road you are approaching

options.rw: Tanga inzira ku ibinyabiziga biturutse iburyo bwawe
options.en: Give way to vehicles coming from your right

explain.rw: Icyapa cya mpandeshatu gicuramye gifite umupaka utukura ni "tanga inzira". Ku nkomane, kigutegeka guha inzira ibinyabiziga bigenda mu muhanda munini ugiye kwinjiramo, uko byaba biturutse kose, ugahagarara iyo ari ngombwa. Ntikireba gusa ibituruka iburyo cyangwa ibinyabiziga binini.
explain.en: The inverted red-bordered triangle is the give-way sign. At a junction it requires you to give way to traffic on the major road you are entering, from whichever side it comes, stopping if necessary. It is not limited to vehicles from the right or to large vehicles.

q.rw: Iki cyapa gisobanura iki aho banyura bazengurutse ?
q.en: What does this sign mean at a roundabout?

options.rw: Tanga inzira ku binyabiziga biri mu muhanda munini
options.en: Give way to vehicles on the major road

options.rw: Tanga inzira ku binyabiziga biturutse i bumoso
options.en: Give way to vehicles coming from the left

options.rw: Tanga inzira ku ma kamyo na za otobisi
options.en: Give way to lorries and buses

options.rw: Ibinyabiziga byose uretse amapikipiki bigomba gutanga inzira
options.en: All vehicles except motorcycles must give way

explain.rw: Iyo icyapa "tanga inzira" kiri aho winjirira mu nzira banyuramo bazengurutse, ugomba guha inzira ibinyabiziga bimaze kwinjiramo. Kubera ko tugendera iburyo kandi tukazenguruka mu cyerekezo kinyuranye n’icy’inshinge z’isaha, ibyo binyabiziga biba biturutse ibumoso bwawe.
explain.en: When a give-way sign stands at the entry to a roundabout, you must give way to vehicles already going round it. Because traffic drives on the right and circulates anticlockwise, those vehicles come from your left.

q.rw: Iki cyapa gisobanura iki ?
q.en: What does this sign mean?

explain.rw: Icyapa cy’uruziga cy’ubururu gifite umwambi wera ureba imbere ni icyapa cy’itegeko: gitegeka gukomeza imbere gusa, ntukate iburyo cyangwa ibumoso. Ntikigomba kwitiranywa n’icyapa cy’urukiramende cy’ubururu cyerekana inzira y’icyerekezo kimwe.
explain.en: A blue circular sign with a white upward arrow is a mandatory sign: you must go straight ahead only, without turning left or right. Do not confuse it with the blue rectangular sign that marks a one-way road.

q.rw: Iki cyapa gisobanura iki ?
q.en: What does this sign mean?

options.rw: Ibinyabiziga biturutse iburyo bifite uburenganzira bwo gutambuka mbere
options.en: Vehicles coming from the right have priority

explain.rw: Icyapa cy’uruziga cy’ubururu gifite umwambi wera werekeza ibumoso ni icyapa cy’itegeko: gitegeka gukata ibumoso gusa. Ntabwo ari icyapa cy’amakuru cyerekana umuhanda uyoborejwe ahandi.
explain.en: A blue circular sign with a white arrow pointing left is a mandatory sign: you must turn left. It is not an information sign announcing a diversion.

q.rw: Iki cyapa gisobanura iki ?
q.en: What does this sign mean?

options.en: Major road merging from the left

explain.rw: Icyapa cy’uruziga cy’ubururu gifite umwambi wera werekeza iburyo ni icyapa cy’itegeko: gitegeka gukata iburyo gusa. Ntigifite aho gihuriye no kunyuranaho cyangwa n’umuhanda uyoborejwe ahandi.
explain.en: A blue circular sign with a white arrow pointing right is a mandatory sign: you must turn right. It has nothing to do with overtaking or with a diversion.

q.rw: Iki cyapa gisobanura iki ?
q.en: What does this sign mean?

options.rw: Tanga inzira ku bindi binyabiziga bigenda mu gihe ugiye gukatira iburyo
options.en: Give way to other traffic when turning right

options.rw: Kata i buryo mu gihe nta bindi binyabiziga biturutse mu kindi cyerekezo
options.en: Turn right when no other vehicles are coming from the other direction

options.rw: Nta nkengero y’umuhanda yegutse iri i buryo
options.en: No raised shoulder on the right

explain.rw: Icyapa cy’uruziga gifite umupaka utukura n’umwambi ukatira iburyo uciyeho umurongo kibuza gukata iburyo kuri ayo masangano, n’iyo nta kinyabiziga cyaba kiza.
explain.en: A round red-bordered sign with a crossed-out right-turn arrow prohibits turning right at that junction, even when no other traffic is coming.

q.rw: Iki cyapa gisobanura iki ?
q.en: What does this sign mean?

options.rw: Ntihasohokerwa i bumoso mu nzira banyuramo bazengurutse
options.en: No exit to the left from the roundabout
No through road on the left

options.rw: Nta nkengero y’umuhanda yegutse iri ibumoso
options.en: No raised shoulder on the left

explain.rw: Icyapa cy’uruziga gifite umupaka utukura n’umwambi ukatira ibumoso uciyeho umurongo kibuza gukata ibumoso kuri ayo masangano. Ntabwo cyerekana umuhanda udakomeza; uwo werekanwa n’icyapa cy’ubururu gifite ishusho ya T.
explain.en: A round red-bordered sign with a crossed-out left-turn arrow prohibits turning left at that junction. It does not indicate a dead end; that is shown by the blue sign with a T symbol.

q.rw: Iki cyapa gisobanura iki ?
q.en: What does this sign mean?

explain.rw: Icyapa cy’uruziga gifite umupaka utukura n’umwambi umeze nk’inkonzo (U) uciyeho umurongo kibuza guhindukira ngo usubire mu cyerekezo uturutsemo. Ntikibuza gusubira inyuma, kandi ntigifite aho gihuriye n’umuhanda unyerera.
explain.en: A round red-bordered sign with a crossed-out U-shaped arrow prohibits making a U-turn to go back the way you came. It does not prohibit reversing, and it has nothing to do with a slippery road.

q.rw: Iki cyapa gisobanura iki ?
q.en: What does this sign mean?

options.rw: Umuhanda urombereje w’ibice byinshi ku birometero 50
Intera nto ntarengwa ya metero 50 hagati y’ibinyabiziga
options.en: Minimum distance of 50 m between vehicles

options.rw: Umuvuduko ntarengwa ugarukira ku birometero 50 mu isaha

explain.rw: Icyapa cy’uruziga gifite umupaka utukura cyanditseho umubare kigena umuvuduko ntarengwa: hano ntiwemerewe kurenza 50 km/h. Ntabwo ari intera hagati y’ibinyabiziga cyangwa umuvuduko muto.
explain.en: A round red-bordered sign with a number sets the maximum speed: here you must not exceed 50 km/h. It is neither a distance between vehicles nor a minimum speed.

q.rw: Iki cyapa gisobanura iki ?
q.en: What does this sign mean?

options.rw: Birabujijwe ku binyabiziga bitwara abakozi ba leta
Birabujijwe ku binyabiziga by’abikorera ki giti cyabo

explain.rw: Icyapa cy’uruziga gifite umupaka utukura n’inyuguti P iciyeho umurongo kibuza guhagarara umwanya munini (guparika) ku binyabiziga byose. Guhagarara akanya gato, urugero kugira ngo abagenzi binjire cyangwa basohoke, ntibibujijwe n’iki cyapa.
explain.en: A round red-bordered sign with a crossed-out P prohibits parking for all vehicles. Stopping briefly, for example to let passengers get in or out, is not prohibited by this sign.

q.rw: Iki cyapa gisobanura iki ?
q.en: What does this sign mean?

options.rw: Aho abana bagenewe kwiga gutwara amagare
options.en: Area for children learning to ride bicycles
Compulsory path for cyclists and pedestrians

options.rw: Abanyamagare bagomba kuva ku igare bakagendesha amaguru
options.en: Cyclists must get off and walk

explain.rw: Icyapa cy’uruziga cy’ubururu kigaragaza igare n’abanyamaguru ni icyapa cy’itegeko: inzira igenewe kandi itegetswe ku binyamitende n’abanyamaguru. Ibindi binyabiziga ntibyemewe kuyinyuramo.
explain.en: A blue circular sign showing a bicycle and pedestrians is a mandatory sign: the path is reserved for, and must be used by, cyclists and pedestrians. Other vehicles may not use it.

sign.en: Compulsory shared path for cyclists and pedestrians

q.rw: Iki cyapa gisobanura iki ?
q.en: What does this sign mean?

options.en: No entry for vehicles with three axles

options.rw: Hanyurwa n’ibinyabiziga bifite imitambiko itatu gusa
options.en: Only vehicles with three axles allowed

explain.rw: Icyapa cy’uruziga gifite umupaka utukura kigaragaza ikamyo kibuza kwinjira ibinyabiziga bigenewe gutwara ibicuruzwa. Nta mubare w’uburemere cyangwa w’imitambiko kigaragaza.
explain.en: A round red-bordered sign showing a lorry prohibits entry to goods vehicles. It shows no weight figure and no number of axles.

sign.rw: Icyapa kibuza kwinjira ibinyabiziga bitwara ibicuruzwa

q.rw: Iki cyapa gisobanura iki ?
q.en: What does this sign mean?

explain.rw: Icyapa cy’uruziga cy’ubururu gifite imyambi itatu izenguruka ni icyapa cy’itegeko cy’inkomane banyuramo bazengurutse: ugomba kuzenguruka ukurikije icyerekezo cy’imyambi.
explain.en: A blue circular sign with three arrows forming a circle is the mandatory roundabout sign: you must drive round in the direction shown by the arrows.

q.rw: Iki cyapa gisobanura iki ?
q.en: What does this sign mean?

explain.rw: Icyapa cya mpandeshatu cy’umuburo gifite imyambi ibiri yerekeza mu byerekezo binyuranye kiburira ko ugiye kugera mu gice cy’umuhanda ubisikanirwamo, aho ibinyabiziga biza biguturutse imbere. Ugomba kugendera iburyo bwawe.
explain.en: A triangular warning sign with two arrows pointing in opposite directions warns that you are entering a section with two-way traffic, where vehicles come towards you. Keep to the right.

q.rw: Iki cyapa gisobanura iki ?
q.en: What does this sign mean?

options.rw: Uguhinguka ku mwaro cyangwa ku nkombe

explain.rw: Icyapa cya mpandeshatu cy’umuburo gifite ishusho y’umuhanda umanuka n’ijanisha (10%) kiburira akamanuko gashobora gutera ibyago. Koresha vitesi nto kandi ugenzure umuvuduko.
explain.en: A triangular warning sign showing a downward slope with a percentage (10%) warns of a dangerous descent. Use a low gear and keep your speed under control.

q.rw: Iki cyapa gisobanura iki ?
q.en: What does this sign mean?

explain.rw: Icyapa cya mpandeshatu cy’umuburo gifite ishusho y’umuhanda uzamuka n’ijanisha (10%) kiburira akazamuko gashinze cyane. Itondere ko ushobora kutabona neza ibiri imbere hejuru y’akazamuko.
explain.en: A triangular warning sign showing an upward slope with a percentage (10%) warns of a steep ascent. Be aware that you may not see far ahead near the top of the climb.

q.rw: Iki cyapa gisobanura iki ?
q.en: What does this sign mean?

explain.rw: Icyapa cya mpandeshatu cy’umuburo kigaragaza imodoka isiga imirongo y’amapine igoramye kiburira umuhanda unyerera. Gabanya umuvuduko kandi wirinde gufata feri cyangwa gukata mu buryo butunguranye.
explain.en: A triangular warning sign showing a car leaving wavy tyre tracks warns of a slippery road. Slow down and avoid sudden braking or steering.

q.rw: Iki cyapa gisobanura iki ?
q.en: What does this sign mean?

explain.rw: Icyapa cya mpandeshatu cy’umuburo kigaragaza abana babiri biruka kiburira ko hafi aho hashobora kuba abana, urugero hafi y’amashuri. Gabanya umuvuduko kandi witegure guhagarara.
explain.en: A triangular warning sign showing two running children warns that children may be about, for example near a school. Slow down and be ready to stop.

q.rw: Iki cyapa gisobanura iki ?
q.en: What does this sign mean?

explain.rw: Icyapa cya mpandeshatu cy’umuburo kigaragaza inka kiburira ko imbere hari akayira k’amatungo, aho amatungo ashobora kwambuka umuhanda. Gabanya umuvuduko kandi witondere amatungo.
explain.en: A triangular warning sign showing a cow warns of a livestock crossing ahead, where animals may cross the road. Slow down and watch out for animals.

q.rw: Mu byapa bikurikira, ni ikihe cyerekana umuhanda udakomeza:
q.en: Which of the following signs indicates a dead end (no through road)?

explain.rw: Icyapa E14 (urukiramende rw’ubururu rufite ishusho ya T y’umweru ifite umutwe utukura) cyerekana umuhanda udakomeza. C1 ni icyapa kibuza kwinjira, C2a kibuza kunyura ibinyabiziga byose mu byerekezo byombi, naho B2a ni icyapa STOP.
explain.en: Sign E14 (blue rectangle with a white T topped by a red bar) indicates a dead end. C1 is no entry, C2a closes the road to all vehicles in both directions, and B2a is the STOP sign.

q.rw: Iki cyapa gisobanura iki ?
q.en: What does this sign mean?

explain.rw: Icyapa cya mpandeshatu gicuramye gifite umupaka utukura ni "tanga inzira": ugomba guha inzira ibinyabiziga bigenda mu muhanda ugiye kwinjiramo, ugahagarara iyo ari ngombwa.
explain.en: The inverted red-bordered triangle is the give-way sign: you must give way to traffic on the road you are entering, stopping if necessary.

q.rw: Muri ibi byapa bikurikira ni ikihe cyerekana ko umuyobozi ukibonye yemerewe gutambuka mbere y'abaturutse aho agana mu nzira ifunganye:
q.en: Which of these signs tells the driver who sees it that he may go before vehicles coming from the opposite direction on a narrow road?

explain.rw: Icyapa B6 (urukiramende rw’ubururu rufite umwambi wera ureba imbere n’umwambi utukura ureba hasi) kiguha uburenganzira bwo gutambuka mbere y’ibinyabiziga biguturutse imbere mu gice gifunganye. A19 iburira umuhanda ubisikanirwamo, B3 yerekana umuhanda w’ibanze, naho A22a iburira amasangano.
explain.en: Sign B6 (blue rectangle with a white arrow pointing up and a red arrow pointing down) gives you priority over oncoming vehicles on a narrow section. A19 warns of two-way traffic, B3 marks a priority road and A22a warns of a junction.

q.rw: Iki cyapa:
q.en: This sign:

options.en: Indicates a road with three lanes
None of the answers is correct

explain.rw: Icyapa cya mpandeshatu cy’umuburo gifite imyambi izenguruka kiburira ko imbere hari aho banyura bazengurutse. Gabanya umuvuduko kandi witegure guha inzira ibinyabiziga biri mu ruziga.
explain.en: A triangular warning sign with arrows in a circle warns of a roundabout ahead. Slow down and be ready to give way to vehicles already in the roundabout.

q.rw: Iki cyapa gisobanura iki ?
q.en: What does this sign mean?

options.en: None of the answers is correct

explain.rw: Icyapa cy’uruziga gitukura gifite umurongo wera utambitse kibuza ibinyabiziga byose kwinjira muri uwo muhanda biturutse kuri urwo ruhande; akenshi gishyirwa ku iherezo ry’inzira y’icyerekezo kimwe. Ntabwo cyerekana umuhanda udakomeza.
explain.en: A red circular sign with a white horizontal bar prohibits all vehicles from entering the road from that side; it is often placed at the far end of a one-way street. It does not indicate a dead end.

q.rw: Ni ikihe icyapa gisobanura umuhanda w'icyerekezo kimwe:
q.en: Which sign indicates a one-way road?

explain.rw: Icyapa E13a (urukiramende rw’ubururu rufite umwambi wera) ni icyapa cy’amakuru cyerekana umuhanda w’icyerekezo kimwe. D1a (uruziga rw’ubururu) itegeka gukomeza imbere gusa, C19 ibuza guhagarara, naho C1 ibuza kwinjira.
explain.en: Sign E13a (blue rectangle with a white arrow) is an information sign marking a one-way road. D1a (blue circle) means ahead only, C19 prohibits stopping, and C1 means no entry.

q.rw: Iki cyapa gisobanura iki ?
q.en: What does this sign mean?

options.rw: Inkomane y’aho umuhanda umwe urasukira iburyo
options.en: Junction where a road merges from the right
None of the answers is correct

explain.rw: Iki cyapa cya mpandeshatu cy’umuburo gifite imirongo ibiri yegerana kiburira ko umuhanda ufunganye ku mpande zombi. Nta gisubizo muri a, b na c kivuga ibyo, niyo mpamvu "nta gisubizo kirimo" ari cyo cy’ukuri.
explain.en: This triangular warning sign with two lines curving towards each other warns that the road narrows on both sides. None of a, b or c says this, so "none of the answers" is correct.

q.rw: Iki cyapa gisobanura iki ?
q.en: What does this sign mean?

options.rw: Birabujijwe kunyura mu muhanda w’ikindi cyerekezo
options.en: No driving on the carriageway of the other direction

explain.rw: Icyapa cy’ubururu kigaragaza umuhanda urombereje w’ibice byinshi uciyeho umurongo utukura kerekana iherezo ryawo: amategeko yihariye y’uwo muhanda arangirira aho, ugomba kwitegura umuvuduko n’amategeko asanzwe.
explain.en: The blue motorway sign crossed by a red diagonal bar marks the end of the motorway: the special motorway rules stop there and you must adapt to the ordinary road rules and speed limits.

q.rw: Iki kimenyetso kiri mu muhanda kivuze iki ?
q.en: What does this road marking mean?

options.en: The driver must not cross it

options.rw: Wegereye icyapa cyo guhagarara umwanya muto
options.en: You are approaching a STOP sign

explain.rw: Umurongo wera udacagaguye uri mu muhanda ntiwemerewe kuwurenga cyangwa kuwugenderaho, haba kunyuranaho cyangwa guhindukira.
explain.en: A continuous white line on the road must not be crossed or straddled, whether to overtake or to turn.

q.rw: Iki kimenyetso kiri mu muhanda kivuze iki ?
q.en: What does this road marking mean?

options.rw: Umuyobozi abujijwe kurenga umurongo wera ucagaguye cyeretse mugihe bitateza icyago
options.en: The driver must not cross the broken white line unless doing so causes no danger

options.rw: Biremewe kunyuranaho ariko nturenge umurongo wera ucagaguye
options.en: Overtaking is allowed, but do not cross the broken white line

explain.rw: Umurongo wera ucagaguye ushobora kurengwa, urugero kunyuranaho cyangwa gukata, igihe cyose bitateza icyago. Niyo mpamvu igisubizo a ari cyo cy’ukuri: kuwurenga byemewe gusa iyo nta cyago biteza.
explain.en: A broken white line may be crossed, for example to overtake or turn, provided this causes no danger. That is what option a says: crossing is allowed only when it is safe.

q.rw: Mu gihe utwaye ikinyabiziga uva kuri A ugana kuri B, Iki kimenyetso kiri mu muhanda kivuze iki ?
q.en: Driving from A to B, what does this road marking mean?

options.rw: Umuyobozi ashobora kurenga umurongo wera udacagaguye mugihe cyo guhindukira gusa
options.en: The driver may cross the continuous white line only to make a U-turn

options.rw: Umuyobozi w’ikinyabiziga abujijwe kunyuranaho, uretse gusa abayobozi b’ibinyamitende nibo bashobora kurenga umurongo wera udacagaguye
options.en: The driver may not overtake; only riders of two-wheelers may cross the continuous white line

options.rw: Umuyobozi w’ikinyabiziga abujijwe kunyuranaho arenze umurongo wera udacagaguye
options.en: The driver may not overtake by crossing the continuous white line

options.rw: Umuyobozi w’ikinyabiziga ashobora kunyuranaho mu gihe bitateza icyago
options.en: The driver may overtake when it causes no danger

explain.rw: Iyo umurongo ucagaguye ubangikanye n’udacagaguye, umuyobozi yubahiriza umurongo umwegereye. Uva kuri A ugana kuri B ugendera iburyo, umurongo ucagaguye uri ku ruhande rwawe, bityo ushobora kunyuranaho igihe bitateza icyago. Abaturuka mu kindi cyerekezo bo ntibemerewe kuwurenga.
explain.en: When a broken line runs alongside a continuous line, each driver obeys the line nearest to them. Driving on the right from A to B, the broken line is on your side, so you may overtake when it is safe. Drivers coming the other way face the continuous line and may not cross.

sign.rw: Umurongo ucagaguye ubangikanye n’udacagaguye (ucagaguye uri ku ruhande rwawe)
sign.en: Broken line alongside a continuous line (broken line on your side)

q.rw: Mu gihe utwaye ikinyabiziga uva kuri A ugana kuri B, Iki kimenyetso kiri mu muhanda kivuze iki ?
q.en: Driving from A to B, what does this road marking mean?

options.rw: Umuyobozi w’ikinyabiziga ashobora kunyuranaho arenze umurongo wera udacagaguye
options.en: The driver may overtake by crossing the continuous white line

options.rw: Umuyobozi w’ikinyabiziga abujijwe kunyuranaho arenze imirongo yera
options.en: The driver may not overtake by crossing the white lines
The driver is allowed to overtake

options.rw: Abayobozi b’ibinyamitende gusa bemerewe kunyuranaho barenze umurongo wera udacagaguye
options.en: Only riders of two-wheelers may overtake by crossing the continuous white line

explain.rw: Iyo umurongo ucagaguye ubangikanye n’udacagaguye, umuyobozi yubahiriza umurongo umwegereye. Uva kuri A ugana kuri B ugendera iburyo, umurongo udacagaguye uri ku ruhande rwawe, bityo ntiwemerewe kuwurenga ngo unyuranaho. Ibi bireba abayobozi bose, harimo n’ab’ibinyamitende.
explain.en: When a broken line runs alongside a continuous line, each driver obeys the line nearest to them. Driving on the right from A to B, the continuous line is on your side, so you may not cross it to overtake. This applies to all drivers, including riders of two-wheelers.

sign.rw: Umurongo udacagaguye ubangikanye n’ucagaguye (udacagaguye uri ku ruhande rwawe)
sign.en: Continuous line alongside a broken line (continuous line on your side)
